You will take overall responsibility for an innovative SaaS company with significant international growth potential. Your focus will be on leading the organization from the startup phase into a scale-up, with particular emphasis on accelerating sales growth, strengthening market positioning, and driving further product development.

This is more than a traditional executive position. It is a Management Buy-In opportunity, enabling the successful Managing Director to invest in the business, become a co-owner, and directly participate in the long-term value created through the company’s growth.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Growth

  • Develop and implement an ambitious growth strategy to position DPO-ONE globally as a leading privacy compliance solution.
  • Take overall responsibility for translating the company’s vision into sustainable commercial growth.

Sales & Marketing

  • Lead efforts to enter new markets, acquire customers, and deepen existing relationships.
  • Provide direction to the sales and marketing teams.
  • Drive commercial performance and create scalable routes to market.

Product Development

  • Drive innovation and work closely with the development team to continuously improve and adapt the SaaS solution to global market needs.

International Leadership

  • Expand DPO-ONE internationally and develop partnerships across different markets and sectors.
  • Build the organizational and commercial foundations required to move successfully from startup to scale-up.

Financial Management

  • Ensure a sound financial foundation through effective budget management and achievement of agreed business goals.
  • Take ownership of company-level performance and sustainable growth.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Managing Director who combines strategic vision with strong commercial execution.

You bring:

  • Demonstrable experience successfully leading companies through a scale-up journey.
  • A proven track record in driving sales growth and developing profitable products.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to take calculated risks and embrace innovation.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.
  • Dutch and Portuguese are considered advantages.
  • Affinity with privacy legislation and compliance is a plus.

What We Offer

  • A Pivotal Leadership Role
  • Take responsibility for the next stage of a growing SaaS company and play a key role in shaping its future.
  • Dynamic & Innovative Environment
  • Collaborate with a talented team and operate in a forward-thinking, internationally oriented environment.
  • Professional Growth With Global Impact
  • Lead the expansion of a product designed to address privacy compliance needs across countries, industries, and organizations.

Management Buy-In & Co-Ownership

This opportunity includes a Management Buy-In, allowing you to become a co-owner of DPO-ONE.

The equity stake investment ranges from €40,000 to €80,000, with the final investment and ownership structure to be discussed with the current co-owners.

This structure gives the Managing Director the opportunity to align their entrepreneurial vision and leadership directly with the long-term success and value creation of the company.

Compensation

  • Monthly management fee, based on seniority.
  • Performance-related bonus tied to business results and the option plan.
  • Equity participation through the Management Buy-In structure.

Take DPO-ONE Into Its Next Growth Phase

This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial Managing Director to lead the next stage of DPO-ONE’s development, accelerate international growth, shape the future of privacy compliance, and secure a position as a co-owner of a growing global SaaS company.

If you combine strategic leadership with commercial drive and want to build value not only as an executive but also as an owner, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Our flexible tool supports individual companies, from medium-sized organizations to enterprises, as well as federations and sports federations in guiding their members and clubs toward compliance with privacy legislation.

The solution is language-independent, applicable worldwide, and has already achieved success in various countries.

jobs.title: GTM Enablement & Training Lead
jobs.excerpt: Construction is the second-largest industry in the world—nearly 4x the size of SaaS—yet it still operates without the automated feedback loops that modern software teams rely on.
jobs.description:
Construction is the second-largest industry in the world—nearly 4x the size of SaaS—yet it still operates without the automated feedback loops that modern software teams rely on. Without real-time observability, issues are detected too late, contributing to over $3 Trillion in annual global waste.
Doxel brings computer vision and AI to construction, giving teams real-time visibility into progress, risk, and execution. From hospitals to data centers, and from field leaders to executive teams, Doxel is used every day to support better decisions and faster delivery. Our platform is trusted by industry leaders including Shell, Genentech, HCA Healthcare, Kaiser, Turner, and Layton.
Doxel’s automated progress tracking solution keeps teams aligned with hard facts that leave no ambiguity on where the project is today, where it will be tomorrow and what decisions need to be made to land it on schedule and on budget. This enables our customers to deliver projects, on average, 11% ahead of schedule with up to 16% savings on monthly cash flow.
Backed by Insight Partners and Andreessen Horowitz and with a rapidly growing team of engineers, scientists, construction veterans, and Enterprise go-to-market teams, we're driven to help our customers win.
Join us as we continue our journey to transform the $15T Construction Industry!

The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated Sales Enablement & Training Manager. This is not a content-management or LMS-administration role; it is fundamentally a sales training and domain-teaching position. The core mission has two parts: developing talented enterprise AEs who arrive without construction experience into sellers who can hold credible conversations with the people who run construction projects — from project executives to field superintendents — and building the systems that produce those sellers consistently as the organization scales.
Success in this role depends on two capabilities. First, the ability to learn a complex, unfamiliar industry quickly and thoroughly - and to develop genuine expertise in it. Second, the ability to teach it: translating dense field reality into training that turns a generalist seller into someone customers trust.
You will use our AI tools, including our internal Claude instance, to accelerate your own ramp into the construction domain, then teach AEs to learn the same way. You will also build out the supporting enablement function (onboarding, playbooks, certification, and tooling) as the team grows.

Your Day to Day

    Build the Enablement Function

  • As our founding enablement hire, design and operationalize the company's first formal sales enablement program, establishing its strategy, priorities, and infrastructure.
  • Create scalable onboarding programs across GTM roles: AEs first, then SDRs, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success.
  • Develop certification frameworks and role-based competency models.
  • Build repeatable, AI-supported training systems that scale with company growth, including self-service delivery and the supporting tooling and LMS stack, so quality instruction doesn't depend on a live session for every rep.

    • Training & Curriculum Development

  • Build your own deep construction expertise first: the project lifecycle, the stakeholders who run jobsites, and the metrics that govern their work. Use AI, including our Claude instance, to accelerate your ramp, then teach AEs to learn the same way.
  • Develop curricula that turn generalist AEs into construction experts: persona guides, per-persona discovery questions, and objection libraries grounded in field reality.
  • Give reps repeated, realistic practice, including AI role-play against construction personas, and gate certification on demonstrated domain fluency rather than product recall.
  • Deliver live and asynchronous training, and coach in the flow of work (call and demo reviews, deal debriefs, role-plays).
  • Use AI to accelerate content production from product releases, recorded calls, and SME interviews.

    • Sales Process & Playbooks

  • Build and maintain playbooks across the customer lifecycle: discovery frameworks, qualification, account planning, and deal inspection.
  • Develop messaging and talk tracks aligned to our ICPs and buyer personas.
  • Embed an enterprise methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, or consultative selling) and reinforce it so adoption holds.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product releases into sales-ready enablement content

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and RevOps; translate product releases into sales-ready content and surface gaps through pipeline reviews, call data, and field feedback.

    • Performance & Analytics

  • Define enablement KPIs and measure training effectiveness.
  • Analyze onboarding ramp time, time-to-domain-credibility, quota attainment, win rates, certification pass rates, discovery quality, and overall sales productivity.
  • Use feedback loops and data insights to continuously improve programs.

What Success Looks Like

    Within the first 12 months, this person will:

  • Onboarding and certification are live, with construction fluency the bar to be deal-ready.
  • New AEs reach that bar faster and more consistently.
  • Sharper, construction-grounded discovery shows up in pipeline quality and win rates.
  • Most training is self-service and AI-supported, scaling without live sessions.
  • Methodology and messaging are applied consistently across the team.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years across sales, sales training, and/or enablement, ideally including direct enterprise selling or rep coaching.
  • Demonstrated excellence as a teacher and coach, with a track record of developing people from beginner to credible. Strong facilitation, presentation, and adult-learning skills. This is the most important qualification.
  • Strong learning agility. You have moved from no knowledge of a complex or technical domain to genuine expertise, and can describe how. You approach mastering an unfamiliar industry as an opportunity rather than an obstacle
  • Fluency with modern AI tools and the ability to use them to build training: interactive simulations, adaptive self-service learning, and faster content production. You treat AI as core to making enablement scalable, not as an add-on.
  • A solid understanding of enterprise B2B SaaS sales (long, multi-stakeholder cycles involving technical and operational buyers) and fluency in at least one methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, SPIN, or Command of the Message).
  • 0→1 experience, with comfort in ambiguity and a history of building training, onboarding, or sales programs from scratch.
  • The ability to create content independently (curricula, playbooks, and certification tracks) without relying on pre-existing templates.

Benefits & Company Culture

  • Competitive Base Salary + Equity Package
  • Remote first culture (for most roles)
  • Comprehensive Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Home Office Stipend
  • Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet
  • Flexible PTO, generous company holiday policy

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience building AI-enabled or self-service training, such as simulation-based practice, AI-assisted content creation, or conversational knowledge tools.
  • Direct experience in construction tech, AEC, industrial SaaS, PropTech, or operational technology, which shortens domain ramp time.
  • Familiarity with enterprise procurement and operational or field buyer personas.
  • Experience enabling technical sales motions that involve Solutions Engineering.
  • Certifications in sales coaching, enablement, training, or leadership development.
  • Experience implementing LMS or enablement tooling

Nice to meet you!

Pepper is an innovative, fast-growing DTC intimate apparel brand designed to celebrate small-chested women. Our iconic solution-driven undergarments, swimwear, and clothing are thoughtfully designed to make every outfitting moment a confident and authentic expression of your best self. Pepper has been obsessed with uncompromising fit for small chests since our 470% funded Kickstarter launch 2017, and has grown to a global community of millions of women united by a mission to inspire women to feel perfectly enough as they are. We’re reshaping the conversation around fit, style, and confidence for small-chested bodies everywhere.

What we’re proud of:

  • Remote-first, flexible, and human: We’re a fully remote-first team that values ownership, balance, and trust. Pepper is built for people who want to do their best work from wherever they thrive. Without sacrificing connection, collaboration, or career growth.
  • Women-founded & Self-funded: As a women-owned company that never took traditional VC funding, we’ve scaled to eight-figure revenue through focus, profitability, and scrappiness. People come here to help rewrite what success looks like in DTC, and to build alongside a team that loves breaking the “rules” of how startups should grow.
  • Mission-driven with real impact. Everything we do is rooted in empowering small-chested people to feel confident and celebrated. Our mission shapes our products, our culture, and our decisions, from inclusive design to responsible manufacturing and community giving. Joining Pepper means using your work to make the world a little more comfortable, confident, and kind.

This is where you come in.

We’re looking for a strategic, data-driven Director of Planning to own our end-to-end inventory planning strategy, purchasing, and sales planning. Reporting into the executive team, you will lead the company’s Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, balancing demand forecasts, inventory investment, production capacity, and supply constraints to support profitable growth.

This role will build bottom-up forecasts rooted in SKU and size-level insights and translate those into sales plans by channel, inventory buys, and operational strategies that enable us to capture demand, scale new categories, and efficiently replenish our core business.

You’ll operate seamlessly between detail and strategy: diving into SKU and size-level performance, customer behavior, trend patterns, production lead times, and supply risks, while connecting those insights to broader business planning and growth objectives.

As a key cross-functional leader, you’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Merchandising, Finance, Production, Sourcing, and Supply Chain to align commercial demand with operational execution and ensure the business is positioned to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Own the company inventory sales plan forecast across seasonal launches, replenishment businesses, and new category expansion
  • Build and manage bottom-up forecasts at the SKU, color, and size level using historical performance, customer behavior, trend analysis, and business inputs
  • Develop forecasting methodologies that account for lifecycle dynamics including launch ramps, replenishment curves, cannibalization, and demand decay
  • Partner with Marketing and Merchandising to incorporate promotional activity, product launches, and customer acquisition trends into forecasts
  • Lead forecast reviews and continuously improve forecast accuracy across channels and categories

Supply Planning & Inventory Management

  • Translate strategic sales forecasts into inventory buy plans and vendor production plans that optimize in-stock rates, inventory productivity, freight optimization, warehouse storage, and cash flow
  • Own inventory targets including weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points, and inventory health metrics
  • Balance forecasted inventory needs by category against operational constraints including production capacity, lead times, MOQ requirements, vendor capabilities, and raw material availability
  • Partner with sourcing and production teams to ensure timely replenishment and successful execution of product launches
  • Manage inventory risk mitigation, scenario planning, and contingency planning to reduce stockouts and excess inventory

jobs.title: Commerce Integrations Lead / Sales Engineer
jobs.excerpt: See something that should exist?  Build it.  See a better way?
jobs.description:
See something that should exist? Build it.
See a better way? Do it.

At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

Commerce Integrations Lead / Sales Engineer

LATAM · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI
Start date: September 2026

Integrations & Technical Solutions Lead

LATAM or EMEA · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI

See something that should connect? Build it.
See a process that should exist? Create it.

At Terrific, we’re building the next generation of social commerce—helping brands turn content, creators, live experiences and AI into commerce they own.

Our technology brings shoppable video, live shopping, interactive timelines, polls and product carousels directly onto a merchant’s website or app.

Now we’re looking for an Commerce Integrations Lead/Sales Engineer to help us connect Terrific to the wider commerce ecosystem—and build the systems that make those connections faster every time.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a finished playbook.

You’ll help write it.

You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to solve the technical problems that determine whether a customer can launch, how quickly they see value and how easily we can support the next merchant.

One day, you may investigate how a global retailer’s cart works across multiple markets. The next, you may build a lightweight integration, help shape a live commercial opportunity, automate part of our technical-discovery process or prepare an app for a commerce marketplace.

You’ll work directly with teammates and customers across Latin America, Europe, Israel and the United States. You’ll have visibility into the full journey—from the first sales conversation through integration, launch and ongoing performance.

If you enjoy moving between technology, customers and commercial problems—and want the freedom to build rather than simply maintain—this role offers unusual room to make an impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD

Terrific needs to connect with the platforms and tools merchants already use.

You’ll help us expand and improve integrations across:

  • Shopify

  • VTEX

  • Adobe Commerce/Magento

  • WooCommerce

  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud

  • BigCommerce

  • Tiendanube/Nuvemshop

  • Wix

  • PrestaShop

  • Shopware

  • Custom and headless commerce environments

  • Native mobile applications

You’ll also explore integrations with platforms such as Klaviyo, Attentive, Gorgias, Zendesk, Yotpo, Segment, Zapier, Google Merchant Center and Meta Commerce Manager.

Over time, you’ll help Terrific build a stronger marketplace presence, a more repeatable onboarding process and a technical integration layer that can scale across customers and markets.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Investigating merchant websites, applications and commerce stacks.

  • Understanding how product catalogs, variants, carts and checkout flows work.

  • Assessing technical feasibility for active commercial opportunities.

  • Turning customer requirements into clear technical recommendations.

  • Building, testing and improving integrations across major ecommerce platforms.

  • Helping merchants move from signed agreement to their first live Terrific experience.

  • Working directly with customer engineers and internal commercial teams.

  • Supporting technical discovery, proposals, security reviews and proofs of concept.

  • Improving the reliability of product feeds, event tracking, cart actions and embeds.

  • Publishing and maintaining Terrific apps across relevant commerce marketplaces.

  • Building tools, scripts, automations and AI agents that make integration work faster.

  • Turning repeated customer friction into clear Product and Engineering priorities.

  • Creating the documentation and processes that will support future customers and teammates.

You won’t be expected to solve everything alone. You will be expected to take ownership, bring the right people together and move the problem forward.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re technical, curious and commercially aware.

You want to understand why something matters to the customer—not only how it works in the code.

You’re comfortable opening DevTools, tracing an API request, reading someone else’s implementation and building a practical solution. You can move from a technical conversation with engineers to a commercial conversation with Sales or a customer without losing the thread.

You communicate clearly, ask good questions and know when to challenge an assumption.

You don’t need every process to be defined before you begin. You like taking something that is currently handled differently each time and turning it into a system the company can reuse.

You also understand that speed and judgment matter in a startup. Sometimes the right answer is a full integration. Sometimes it is a simpler path that gets the customer live this week.

HOW YOU’LL USE AI

Terrific is AI-native by default.

We don’t treat AI as a separate initiative or an occasional productivity tool. We use it as part of how we investigate, build, document and improve our work.

In this role, you’ll have the freedom to use AI to:

  • Accelerate technical discovery and research.

  • Generate and test scripts.

  • Automate repetitive integration tasks.

  • Build internal agents and tools.

  • Improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Monitor integrations and identify problems earlier.

  • Help non-technical teams access technical answers faster.

We’re interested in what you can build with AI—not whether you use a particular tool.

The goal is to create leverage for the whole company, not simply complete your own work faster.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

  • Production experience with at least two major ecommerce platforms.

  • Experience working with APIs, product feeds, webhooks, authentication, carts or checkout flows.

  • Ability to read unfamiliar code, write working scripts and debug browser or network behavior.

  • Experience working directly with customers, merchants or external technical teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Good judgment about effort, risk and commercial value.

  • Comfort working independently within a distributed, international team.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience with live shopping, social commerce, video commerce, marketplace apps or large international retailers is a strong advantage.

French is valuable for our EMEA accounts.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, you will:

  • Build a clear picture of Terrific’s current integration landscape.

  • Take ownership of live customer integration work.

  • Create a repeatable approach to technical discovery and feasibility.

  • Reduce the time between signed agreement and customer launch.

  • Improve how Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success work together.

  • Move new platform integrations into production.

  • Help define which marketplace and partner integrations we build next.

  • Introduce automations and AI-powered workflows that save the team time.

  • Create a roadmap for how Terrific’s integration ecosystem should grow.

Success is not following a process perfectly.

Success is leaving us with a better process than the one you joined.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Many technical integration roles begin with a ticket and end when the ticket is closed.

This one begins with a customer opportunity.

You’ll see how technical decisions affect sales, launch timelines, customer experience and revenue. You’ll work across teams and countries, with direct access to the people making product and commercial decisions.

You’ll have meaningful freedom to decide how problems should be approached, which tools should be built and what Terrific’s integration function should become.

There is no process set in stone—and that is the opportunity.

REQUIRED

  • Based in Latin America—preferably Mexico, Argentina, Brazil or Colombia—or within a compatible EMEA time zone.

  • Available for a full-time independent-contractor engagement.

  • Able to work remotely with teammates and customers across global time zones.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

  • At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

  • Production experience with ecommerce platforms, APIs or merchant technology.

Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. Interviews, documentation and regular internal communication will be conducted in English.

Required:
  • Deep experience in at least one of Terrific’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1.
  • Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English.
Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.
Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific.
Please note: We review every application carefully. While we may not be able to respond to everyone, we will reach out to candidates whose experience aligns with what we’re building.

About Truv:

Truv is building the infrastructure layer that powers consumer-permissioned income, employment, identity, and asset verification. We help lenders, fintechs, and financial institutions make faster, more accurate decisions while delivering a seamless consumer experience.

As we continue to expand our data network and verification capabilities, we're looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and scale our Data Sources platform—the foundation that powers document ingestion, fraud detection, bank connectivity, and data reliability across Truv products.

About the Job:

We are seeking an experienced Lead Product Manager, Data Sources to own the execution of the roadmap, and execution for the systems that collect, process, and validate consumer financial data.

This role sits at the intersection of data infrastructure, machine learning, fraud prevention, and financial data aggregation. You will be responsible for building scalable capabilities that improve data coverage, quality, reliability, and trust across Truv's platform.

You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Fraud, Operations, Customer Success, and GTM teams to deliver products that directly impact conversion, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

What You'll Own:

    Document parsing - Drive the roadmap for parsing income and document types. Improve accuracy, reduce manual review, and shorten time-to-report. Partner with Data Science on extraction models and with Ops on the human-in-the-loop pipeline.

    Scaling document types - Expand the catalog of supported document types beyond the current set. Identify the highest-impact additions (by use case, client demand, and revenue impact), prioritize the rollout, and own the end-to-end product surface from upload to verified output.

    Fraud detection - Define and ship the fraud signal layer across data sources — document tampering detection, deposit-pattern anomalies, identity mismatches, and synthetic income flags. Balance precision and recall against client-specific risk tolerances, and build the configuration surface for clients to tune.

    Optimizing and scaling bank aggregation - Lead the Truv's bank aggregation product, connection success rates, refresh cadence, transaction enrichment, and coverage. Reduce drop-off, improve match rates, and expand FI coverage where it matters most for mortgage and tenant use cases.

    SLAs and reliability - Set, instrument, and defend SLAs across every data source: time-to-first-data, time-to-completed-report, refresh success rate, document parse accuracy, and bank connection uptime. Drive the dashboards, alerts, and review cadence that make these visible — and the engineering work that makes them improve

What You'll Do

  • Set the multi-quarter roadmap for Data Sources across docs, fraud, and aggregation; align it with revenue, client commitments, and platform-level constraints.
  • Write tight specs and 1-pagers; partner with Eng and Data Science to scope, build, and ship.
  • Talk to clients (mortgage lenders, government agencies, tenant screeners) weekly; turn their feedback into prioritized roadmap.
  • Own the metrics — parse accuracy, fraud catch rate, bank connection success, SLA hit rate — and the rituals that drive them up.
  • Lead and mentor PMs and engineers on the team; raise the bar on shipping speed and quality.
  • Represent Truv's data sources story externally (sales calls, conferences, partner reviews).

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in product management, with significant time in data, ML/AI, fintech, or verification / identity platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a data-intensive product — document understanding, OCR, financial data aggregation, fraud, or similar — at meaningful scale.
  • Strong technical fluency. You can reason about extraction models, API tradeoffs, and pipeline architecture without needing to be hand-held by engineering.
  • Track record of driving SLA / reliability outcomes — not just shipping features, but moving the numbers that matter.
  • Experience working with regulated industries (mortgage, lending, government) is a strong plus. GSE / FCRA / FNMA / FHLMC familiarity especially.
  • Strong written communication. You write the 1-pagers and specs that align the team.
  • Customer obsession. You spend real time with users and let what you learn shape the roadmap.
  • Worked on a verification or KYC/KYB product used by lenders.
  • Comfortable shipping in a startup environment where ambiguity is high and the bar moves up.

Why this role:

  • High leverage. Data sources are upstream of every Truv product. Improvements compound across mortgage, tenant screening, government, and any new vertical we enter.
  • Mature platform, room to push. Truv ships in production with major mortgage lenders today. Your job is to take a working platform and make it best-in-class.
  • Real complexity. Document parsing, fraud, and bank aggregation each have multi-year roadmaps. You'll get to operate across all three as one cohesive system.
  • Tight team. You'll work directly with senior leadership, the engineering teams that own these surfaces, and the largest clients in the space.

jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.


WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

About the Role

Great candidates aren't always looking for a job. That's exactly the problem we're hiring you to solve.

We're looking for a Senior Sourcer to own outbound candidate strategy across our open roles - not a coordinator role, not a "manage the inbound queue" role. You'll build pipelines of passive candidates from scratch, run your own outreach campaigns, and partner directly with hiring managers and leadership on search strategy. Most of your day will be spent finding people who weren't thinking about a new job - and giving them a reason to start.

If you've ever built a search from absolutely nothing - no shortlist, no warm leads, just a blank sheet and a hunch about where the right person might be hiding - this is your kind of problem.

What You'll Do

  • Own outbound sourcing for any role - senior or otherwise - where the pipeline is thin or inbound alone isn't cutting it
  • Hunt down passive candidates using Boolean search, X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, and whatever other channel gets the job done
  • Run high-volume, genuinely personalized outreach campaigns and stick with long sourcing cycles that don't pay off overnight
  • Have real conversations with the candidates you find, to sort signal from noise before handing off to the hiring manager
  • Partner directly with hiring managers and leadership to figure out where outbound effort matters most
  • Be the first impression of Zocks for people who've never heard of us - and make it a good one

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of sourcing experience, ideally from an agency, retained search firm, or an in-house team built around outbound
  • Real fluency in Boolean/X-ray search and other passive-sourcing techniques - not just LinkedIn's built-in filters
  • A track record of engaging and actually converting candidates who weren't looking
  • Scrappiness - you don't wait for the perfect tool or a clean list; you figure out a way in
  • Resourcefulness - when the obvious channel dries up, you find a less obvious one
  • Comfort with a high volume of no's and silence - you treat it as data, not discouragement
  • Adaptability - you can shift strategy mid-search when what you're doing isn't working
  • Strong written communication - your outreach needs to stand out in a crowded inbox, not read like a template
  • Full ownership mentality - you run a search end-to-end and don't need it handed to you in pieces

Logistics

  • This is a remote position, but we are currently only able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IA, KS, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NV, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, WA, WI
  • Background and reference checks required as part of onboarding

Interview Process

  • 30-min recruiter screen
  • Up to three 30-45-min video or onsite interviews
  • Offer pending references.

Total estimated time: ~3 hours

Compensation

  • Base salary $130K - $165K. Placement bonus for Director-level and above roles you source, paid after a 90-day retention milestone, regardless of where your day-to-day sourcing focus sits:
    • Director: $5K
    • VP: $10K
    • C-suite/exec: $15K–$20K

Total target compensation $160K - $190K depending on placement volume.

  • Equity - we're all building this together

BENEFITS

The full picture

Health

  • Medical: 100% of employee premium covered (UnitedHealthcare Select Plus network, 2 plan options)
  • Dental: 99% covered - Guardian, $1,500 annual benefit
  • Vision: 99% covered - Guardian/VSP, $150 frames & contacts allowance
  • FSA: Zocks matches dollar-for-dollar up to $500/year

Time off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid sick time
  • 11 paid holidays

Family

  • Birthing parent: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave
  • Non-birthing parent: 6 weeks fully paid parental leave

Financial

  • 401(k) via Guideline - Pre-tax and Roth options; low-cost Vanguard funds

Everything else

  • MacBook laptop + Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom provided
  • Equity grant - details included as part of your offer
  • Growth opportunities for high performers after 6 months
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with smart, kind teammates

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Zocks AI is an equal opportunity employer. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. We believe diversity drives creativity, innovation, and success - and we encourage all qualified people to apply.

We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are always made by humans.

Job Description Summary

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.

Job Description

The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Director, AI Foundations Engineer will drive the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.

Major Accountabilities

  • Lead the design and development and ongoing improvement of the organization's AI foundations that will enable use cases through a disciplined engineering approach

  • Define and implement an agentic AI foundational system, engineering standards, and development practices that promote scalability, reliability, repeatability, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise needs and strategic priorities.

  • Oversee engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that enable agentic AI products and workflows.

  • Drive modernization and integration efforts to connect existing systems and processes with AI capabilities.

  • Monitor agentic operations and user feedback to identify improvements, resolve issues, and support continuous optimization.

  • Establish effective operating models, support processes, and governance practices to ensure consistent delivery of AI capabilities

  • Communicate platform priorities, delivery progress, technical risks, and investment needs to senior leaders and cross functional stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.

  • 8 plus years of AI engineering experience, with a strong track record of leading product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for complex digital, data, or AI enabled products.

  • Demonstrated experience in AI and data driven product environments, including translating business needs into scalable product solutions and partnering closely with technical teams to bring innovative products to market.

  • Strong cross functional leadership skills, with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Innovation, Design, Data Science, Commercial, and other business teams to drive alignment and execution.

  • Experience managing and developing product managers or junior product leaders, including coaching, prioritization support, and fostering strong product management practices.

  • Excellent strategic, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, make informed tradeoffs, and clearly communicate product vision, priorities, and outcomes to stakeholders.

The salary for this position is expected to range between $194,600.00 and $361,400.00 annual per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors. Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards. US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

EEO Statement:

The Novartis Group of Companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive workplace that cultivates bold innovation through collaboration and empowers our people to unleash their full potential.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodations

The Novartis Group of Companies are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to call +1 (877)395-2339 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Salary Range

$194,600.00 - $361,400.00

Skills Desired

Agile (Programming Methodology) (Inactive), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Value Creation, Change Management, Curious Mindset, Data Governance, Data Literacy, Data Quality, Data Science, Data Strategies, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Learning Agility, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Algorithms, Mentorship, Nlp (Neuro-Linguistic Programming) And Genai (Inactive), Organization Awareness (Inactive), Stakeholder Engagement, Statistical Analysis, Time Series Analysis, Vision (Inactive)

As an Implementation Specialist at Ultimo, you help customers modernize their asset and maintenance operations using a best‑in‑class EAM platform. You work closely with customer stakeholders and internal experts to design, configure, and deliver solutions that actually get adopted.

You are trusted to lead, not just to execute.

jobs.title: Technology Strategist & Advisor
jobs.excerpt: Technology Strategy • Digital Transformation • Cybersecurity • Governance • Institutional Resilience Location: Global / Canada Work Model: Remote / Hybrid with Client-Site Assignments as Required Engagement: Independent Contractor / Project-Based Position OverviewMatrix is seeking experienced independent professionals to join our contractor network as Technology Strategists & Advisors.
jobs.description:
Technology Strategy • Digital Transformation • Cybersecurity • Governance • Institutional Resilience

Location: Global / Canada
Work Model: Remote / Hybrid with Client-Site Assignments as Required
Engagement: Independent Contractor / Project-Based

Position Overview

Matrix is seeking experienced independent professionals to join our contractor network as Technology Strategists & Advisors.

Contractors receive project-based assignments from Matrix based on individual client Work Orders. Assignments may involve technology strategy, digital transformation, enterprise systems, cybersecurity strategy, technology governance, technology-risk assessment, technology evaluation, implementation planning or other authorized strategic technology advisory services.

This is a senior-level advisory role suited to experienced technology professionals who can assess complex environments, advise executive stakeholders and develop practical technology strategies that support organizational objectives.

Clients may include law firms, healthcare organizations, government ministries and agencies, professional practices, corporations, regulated organizations and other institutions where technology, confidentiality, security, privacy and operational resilience are important considerations.

Assignments may be performed remotely or may require attendance at client locations for executive meetings, technology assessments, workshops, stakeholder engagement, implementation planning or other project requirements.

Depending on the assignment, contractors may work independently or collaborate with Matrix advisors, technical specialists, project managers and authorized client stakeholders.

The contractor is responsible for independently determining the manner, method, sequence and tools used to complete an assignment, subject to the applicable client Work Order, required deliverables, agreed timelines, confidentiality and security requirements, and client-specific requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology Planning

  • Assess the client's current technology environment, capabilities and priorities.
  • Develop technology strategies and multi-year technology roadmaps where required.
  • Evaluate legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure and technology dependencies.
  • Identify opportunities for modernization, optimization and operational improvement.
  • Develop practical recommendations aligned with organizational objectives, available resources and identified risks.
  • Consider scalability, resilience, security, privacy and long-term sustainability when developing technology recommendations.

Executive & Leadership Advisory

Provide independent strategic technology advice to authorized leadership stakeholders, which may include:

  • executive leadership;
  • managing partners;
  • CIOs and CTOs;
  • directors;
  • operations leaders;
  • compliance and risk personnel; and
  • other authorized decision-makers.

Advisory assignments may include:

  • cloud strategy;
  • digital transformation;
  • artificial intelligence and automation;
  • enterprise applications;
  • case or practice-management technology;
  • healthcare information systems;
  • document and records-management platforms;
  • cybersecurity strategy;
  • data governance;
  • technology risk; and
  • technology investment priorities.

Prepare executive briefings, strategic recommendations, technology assessments, risk-related reports and other advisory materials within the scope of the Work Order.

Consultants provide technology and operational perspectives. They do not provide legal opinions, legal advice or determinations regarding a client's legal rights, obligations or compliance with law.

Digital Transformation & Modernization

  • Develop or support digital transformation strategies.
  • Assess opportunities to modernize legacy systems and processes.
  • Evaluate cloud, hybrid and other technology environments.
  • Support technology implementation and transition planning.
  • Assess opportunities for automation, analytics and emerging technologies.
  • Consider organizational readiness, adoption and operational impacts.
  • Support change-management and technology-adoption initiatives where included in the Work Order.

Technology Risk, Privacy & Governance

  • Assess technology-related security and operational risks.
  • Provide strategic guidance regarding cybersecurity and information-security priorities.
  • Evaluate technology controls and risk-management approaches.
  • Support data-governance and information-management initiatives.
  • Identify technology-related privacy and data-protection considerations.
  • Develop technology-risk assessments and strategic recommendations.
  • Support practical technology-risk mitigation strategies.
  • Identify areas where the client should obtain advice from legal, privacy, cybersecurity or other appropriately qualified professionals.

Consultants may identify technology-related risks and requirements but do not provide legal or regulatory opinions or certify that a client is legally or regulatory compliant.

Enterprise Systems & Technology Evaluation

Evaluate technology solutions based on documented client requirements, which may include:

  • enterprise applications;
  • legal practice and case-management systems;
  • healthcare information systems;
  • document-management platforms;
  • records-management systems;
  • CRM systems;
  • workflow and automation platforms;
  • cybersecurity technologies;
  • cloud platforms;
  • collaboration systems; and
  • other specialized institutional technologies.

Provide objective, vendor-neutral recommendations based on technology, operational, security and implementation considerations.

Vendor Evaluation & Procurement Support

Where included within the Work Order:

  • Assist with technology requirements gathering.
  • Support vendor evaluation and technology-selection processes.
  • Develop or review technical evaluation criteria.
  • Assist with RFP and procurement documentation from a technology and operational perspective.
  • Evaluate vendor proposals based on technical and project requirements.
  • Support technology implementation governance.
  • Identify technology, security, operational or integration considerations.
  • Assist with vendor-management and implementation reviews.

Consultants do not provide legal contract advice or legal contract review. Legal terms, contractual rights, obligations and negotiations remain with the client's appropriately qualified legal or professional advisor.

Contractors do not have authority to make contractual commitments on behalf of Matrix or the client unless specifically authorized in writing.

Technology Investment & Cost Optimization

  • Assess technology investments in relation to organizational objectives.
  • Identify opportunities for technology optimization and operational efficiency.
  • Evaluate potential technology costs, resource requirements and implementation considerations.
  • Assist clients in prioritizing technology initiatives.
  • Support business-case development and technology investment analysis.
  • Consider measurable outcomes, sustainability and long-term value when developing recommendations.

Cross-Functional Advisory

  • Act as a strategic liaison between leadership, technical teams and operational stakeholders.
  • Translate complex technology issues into clear business and organizational considerations.
  • Facilitate discussions among technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support alignment between technology strategy and organizational priorities.
  • Identify technology dependencies, risks and implementation considerations.
  • Provide practical recommendations that recognize the client's operational environment and available resources.

Assignment & Project Management

Contractors will:

  • Review and assess the applicable client Work Order.
  • Independently organize and manage assigned advisory projects.
  • Determine appropriate methodologies, tools and processes for completing required deliverables.
  • Use Matrix's designated online project-management and collaboration platform to access assignment information and collaborate as required.
  • Maintain appropriate project documentation.
  • Provide agreed status updates and deliverables.
  • Identify matters requiring clarification, authorization or client direction.
  • Complete agreed deliverables within established project parameters.

Client-Site & Stakeholder Engagement

Depending on the Work Order, assignments may require attendance at:

  • law firms;
  • government ministries and agencies;
  • healthcare organizations;
  • corporate offices;
  • professional practices;
  • technology facilities;
  • institutional locations; and
  • other authorized client sites.

In-person activities may include executive briefings, stakeholder meetings, technology assessments, workshops, discovery sessions, implementation planning, vendor meetings or project coordination.

Contractors are expected to maintain professional conduct, confidentiality and discretion when working at client locations.

Core Qualifications

  • 7–15+ years of relevant technology strategy, IT consulting, technology leadership, enterprise architecture or digital transformation experience.
  • Demonstrated experience advising organizations on technology strategy or major technology initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of technology infrastructure, cloud environments, enterprise systems and cybersecurity.
  • Experience evaluating complex technology environments and developing practical strategic recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, data management, privacy and information-security considerations.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, strategic and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage advisory engagements.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Ability to operate an independent professional practice and provide services on a project basis.
  • Ability and willingness to attend client locations when required by an assignment.

Sector & Institutional Experience

Experience supporting one or more of the following environments is an asset:

  • law firms or legal service organizations;
  • healthcare organizations or health-related institutions;
  • government ministries or agencies;
  • courts or tribunals;
  • financial or insurance organizations;
  • professional services organizations;
  • regulated industries;
  • corporations; or
  • other high-confidentiality institutional environments.

Experience working across multiple industries or jurisdictions is particularly valuable.

Technology & Professional Expertise

Experience with one or more of the following is an asset:

  • enterprise architecture;
  • cloud strategy;
  • AWS;
  • Microsoft Azure;
  • cybersecurity;
  • information governance;
  • data governance;
  • privacy and data protection;
  • enterprise applications;
  • artificial intelligence and automation;
  • systems integration;
  • digital transformation;
  • business-process modernization;
  • document and records management;
  • technology-risk management; and
  • technology procurement and vendor evaluation.

Certifications & Professional Credentials

Relevant professional credentials may include:

  • CISSP;
  • CISM;
  • PMP;
  • ITIL;
  • AWS certifications;
  • Microsoft certifications;
  • enterprise architecture certifications;
  • cybersecurity credentials; or
  • equivalent professional qualifications.

Certifications are considered an asset and are not necessarily required where equivalent professional experience can be demonstrated.

Professional Competencies

The successful contractor will demonstrate:

  • strategic and analytical thinking;
  • independent professional judgment;
  • vendor-neutral advisory capability;
  • strong executive communication;
  • ability to understand complex institutional environments;
  • practical problem-solving;
  • strong facilitation skills;
  • ability to balance innovation with security and risk;
  • strong project and stakeholder-management skills;
  • adaptability across industries and jurisdictions;
  • discretion and confidentiality; and
  • an implementation-focused approach.

Independent Contractor Engagement

This is an independent contractor, project-based engagement and not an employment position.

Contractors manage their assigned projects independently and are responsible for determining the manner, method, sequence and tools used to perform the work, subject to the applicable Work Order, required deliverables, agreed timelines, confidentiality obligations, security requirements and client-specific requirements.

Matrix provides the client relationship, assignment scope and required deliverables. Contractors independently manage the execution of their assignments and use Matrix's designated online project-management and collaboration platform to receive Work Orders, access assignment information, provide status updates and collaborate with Matrix and authorized client contacts as required.

Contractors may accept assignments based on their availability, qualifications, experience and capacity.

Contractors are responsible for maintaining the professional capabilities, equipment, technology, transportation and other resources necessary to perform their assignments, except where otherwise agreed for a specific project.

Contractors are responsible for their own applicable taxes, government remittances, insurance, business expenses and other obligations arising from their independent business activities.

Nothing in the contractor relationship creates an employment, partnership, joint-venture or agency relationship between the contractor and Matrix or the client.

Work Environment

Assignments may be:

  • fully remote;
  • hybrid;
  • client-site based;
  • project-site based; or
  • a combination of remote and in-person work.

The nature, location, scope and duration of each assignment will depend on the applicable client Work Order.

Contractors should be comfortable working across different organizations, industries, technologies and professional environments.

Why Work With Matrix

  • Access to project-based strategic technology advisory assignments.
  • Opportunities to advise organizations facing complex technology and institutional challenges.
  • Flexible remote and in-person project opportunities.
  • Ability to independently determine the methodology and execution of assigned work.
  • Access to Matrix's online project-management and collaboration environment.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with experienced Matrix advisors and professional specialists.
  • Exposure to diverse technology environments and strategic challenges.
  • Opportunity to apply specialized expertise across different client engagements.
  • A professional network focused on quality, confidentiality, reliability and client service.

Our Approach

Matrix values independent professional expertise combined with practical, implementation-ready advice.

Our Technology Strategists & Advisors are expected to bring their own professional experience, strategic perspective and methodology to each engagement while remaining aligned with the client's approved objectives, deliverables and project requirements.

We seek advisors who can look beyond individual technologies and understand how people, processes, technology, risk, governance and organizational objectives must work together to create sustainable results.

Our approach is vendor-neutral, practical and implementation-focused, helping clients make informed technology decisions while recognizing when matters should be referred to the client's appropriately qualified legal, regulatory, privacy, cybersecurity or other professional advisors.

Professional Boundaries & Scope of Services

Matrix provides non-legal technology, administrative, operational and strategic consulting services.

Technology Strategists & Advisors may identify technology-related considerations involving privacy, security, governance, risk, regulatory requirements or industry standards. However, they do not:

  • provide legal advice or legal opinions;
  • provide legal representation;
  • interpret legislation or regulations for a client;
  • determine whether a client is legally compliant;
  • provide legal strategy;
  • negotiate or provide legal advice regarding contracts;
  • provide regulated professional advice outside their qualifications and authorized scope; or
  • make legal, regulatory or professional determinations on behalf of a client.

Where a project raises a question requiring legal or other regulated professional judgment, the matter must be referred to the client's appropriately qualified professional.

The consultant's role is to provide technology expertise, strategic analysis, operational recommendations and implementation guidance within the scope of the applicable Work Order.

Diversity & Inclusion Statement

Our firm is committed to building a diverse and inclusive advisory network. We value professionals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we believe that diverse teams deliver richer insights and more effective solutions for our clients. We value diversity and inclusion in our global advisory network and encourage applications from professionals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Matrix is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other protected status.

All information will be kept confidential according to privacy guidelines.

About Matrix

At Matrix, we deliver a broad range of advisory services and tailored solutions that help organizations navigate change, realize their vision, and optimize performance and productivity.

We are a boutique consulting and professional services firm specializing in strategic advisory, technology strategy, operational improvement and institutional transformation for law firms, government-related organizations, professional practices, healthcare organizations and complex public- and private-sector environments.

Our model combines strategic insight with practical implementation and operational execution to help leadership teams address sophisticated institutional, organizational and technology challenges.

Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

About Flex

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: Remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

You will build Flex's payments infrastructure. You will lead our vendor strategy across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. You will architect how Flex orchestrates multiple payment providers across bank partners, processors, and international rails into a single elegant customer experience. And you will be the product partner on our transition from operating on partner licenses to operating on our own money transmitter licenses, which is a foundational shift in how Flex works.

This seat requires someone who can hold a serious technical conversation with a Tier 1 bank, who has personally implemented payment rails at meaningful scale, and who can translate vendor selection into clear product decisions. The candidate we want has lived through at least one major payments transition (processor change, license expansion, or rails buildout) and knows what to watch for.

You do not need to be a lawyer. You do need to understand what the operational shift into a forward thinking strategy around money movement means, and be able to communicate the now program, the in-between, and the future program clearly to the rest of the company.

What you will do

Own major Tier 1 bank partner implementations and the broader bank partner strategy.

Architect the multi-provider payments stack across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. Tomorrow it means more rails, more corridors, more direct integrations.

Lead vendor selection across new payment rails as Flex scales domestically and internationally.

Partner to deliver our MTL acquisition process. Own the product implications of the partner-licensed-to-directly-licensed transition. Translate the operational change for the rest of the company.

Build the framework for international money movement across multiple corridors. Pair payment providers thoughtfully so the customer experience is elegant and the vendor risk is balanced.

Represent Flex in technical and commercial negotiations with the largest financial institutions in the world.

Partner with engineering on the implementation cadence. We have a small but growing payments pod and you will help us scale it as the surface area grows.

What you will need

4 to 9+ years of payments-specific product experience. Ready to build a function from the ground up.

You have personally owned vendor relationships and technical implementations with top-tier payment providers. You know the difference between what a vendor sells and what they actually deliver.

Money transmitter licensing transition experience is strongly preferred. If you have lived through a company going from partner-licensed to directly licensed, we want to talk to you. If you have not, the right candidate can still close on this gap. We can teach the MTL specifics. We cannot teach the judgment.

You can hold a technical conversation about ACH, wire, card rails, real-time payments, and cross-border money movement without needing translation.

You have negotiated with at least one Tier 1 bank or payment network and can walk us through what you learned.

Nice to have

Direct experience working with or alongside any of the following will help you ramp faster. None of these are required. The more of them you have touched, the more productive you will be on day one.

Tier 1 bank partners. JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Citi, or comparable institutions on a real fintech partnership.

Card processors and issuing platforms. Marqeta, Lithic, Stripe Issuing, Adyen Issuing, Galileo, Highnote, Checkout.com.

Cross-border rails and international money movement. Airwallex, Wise, Nium, Currencycloud, Remitly, WorldRemit.

Bank infrastructure and BaaS platforms. Unit, Modern Treasury, Increase, Treasury Prime, Column, Lead, Synctera.

FINTRX is the preeminent resource for private wealth data and research. Its platform features millions of data points on the Registered Investment Advisor and global Family Office ecosystem. Today, FINTRX serves thousands of customers globally, which include top asset managers, private equity and venture capital firms, real estate firms, institutional investors, investment banks, consultants and service providers.

About the role

We're seeking a Data Delivery & Integration Engineer to own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of FINTRX's external data delivery, including Snowflake data shares, SFTP feeds, and S3-based distribution. In this role you will serve as the primary technical point of contact for all data delivery integrations, combining hands-on platform management with client-facing expertise. Working closely with our engineering, product, and client success teams, you will ensure a seamless, reliable data delivery experience for our growing global client base.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage all aspects of the Snowflake data share environment, including configuration, replication, access controls, and performance optimization
  • Manage data feeds pipelines (SFTP, S3 bucket, and other delivery mechanisms) end to end, ensuring timely and accurate delivery
  • Create and maintain custom tables, views, and transformations within Snowflake to meet client-specific requirements
  • Develop a deep understanding of data lineage—how delivered data ties back to source documents and upstream systems
  • Lead live Snowflake walkthroughs and data feed demonstrations for prospective clients
  • Participate in consultative and troubleshooting calls, diagnosing and resolving data delivery issues on behalf of clients
  • Manage the ongoing client relationship as it pertains to Snowflake integrations and data feeds Proactively identify, investigate, and prevent data issues within shares and feeds before they impact clients
  • Assist in building monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks for data delivery pipelines Maintain thorough documentation of data sharing mechanisms, file formats, and integration configurations

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with Snowflake (data sharing, replication, and administration strongly preferred)
  • Proficiency with data delivery mechanisms such as SFTP, S3, and cloud-based data sharing
  • Strong SQL skills and experience building/modifying views, tables, and stored procedures Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration and monitoring tools
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable leading demos and client-facing calls
  • Experience with data lineage concepts and metadata management Familiarity with GCP is a plus
  • Familiarity with Couchdrop is a plus
  • Bachelor's Degree in computer science, mathematics, data science, or a related field
  • Ability to work east coast hours
  • Honesty, integrity, and accountability are paramount
  • Organization and ability to manage multiple projects and meet proposed deadlines

Benefits

  • Competitive annual salary Unlimited Paid Time Off Health, dental & vision insurance 401k retirement plan with company match Remote*
  • In addition to our competitive compensation package, we offer a highly motivated, growing and supportive environment with the opportunity to work alongside many other highly talented professionals. We strive to continually build on our evolving culture - which is built on; innovation, drive, and top tier product creation on behalf of our global client base.
  • FINTRX does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

*This position does not qualify for visa sponsorship, including H-1B, OPT, or CPT. Candidates who will require visa sponsorship now or in the future should not apply.

*Candidate must be able to work EST business hours to be considered
