jobs.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Engagement Manager at Chooose, you will partner with our enterprise customers in the aviation and energy sectors, enabling them to build and operate their SAF programs. In close collaboration with the Chooose Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest customers in your assigned region, supporting customers across their entire experience with the Chooose platform, from implementation to solution go-live and beyond.
This is a remote role that must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida
Alt ID: Strategic Account Manager / Client Partner / Engagement Manager / Enterprise CSM / Strategic Account Lead

What you'll do

  • Own total responsibility for a portfolio of key enterprise customers within the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors.
  • Become the expert on the customer's SAF program. Thoroughly understand the customer’s program objectives, and guide how the customer leverages the Chooose platform to reach these objectives.

  • Maintain a balanced approach and multiple perspectives. Enable commercial growth while considering Chooose's commitment to enabling long-term, high-integrity climate action.
  • Manage complex software deployments. Supported by an assigned Technical Implementation Manager and other key resources, oversee the implementation of complex decarbonization programs including a range of climate solutions from Sustainable Aviation Fuel to carbon offsets and removals.
  • Refine our playbook. Drive continuous improvement across Technical Implementation, Customer Operations, and Customer Success functions.
  • Collaborate with multiple Chooose teams to execute the operational tasks needed to achieve program objectives on time and with high quality.
  • Proactively and continually educate yourself on the carbon-related requirements and market trends impacting our customers and the sectors in which we operate.

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise project management, or similar.
  • Experience in enterprise software organizations relating to carbon markets, fuel markets, or carbon accounting is a plus.
  • Technical capability. You enjoy helping customers solve business and technical problems, and are comfortable with technical and highly configurable SaaS solutions. Previous experience with API integrations and enterprise-grade SaaS solutions is a plus.

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will involve a practical exercise for you to show your work. You’ll receive written instructions for the exercise in advance, and we’ll then schedule a time to discuss. The third and final phase consists of a one-on-one conversation with a member of our executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring enough time to get to know one another.

In this full-time, customer-facing role, you will serve as a trusted, customer-facing technical lead, partnering directly with Sponsors throughout active migration programs.

What You’ll Do

jobs.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Growth & Experimentation
jobs.excerpt: Everis has a different standard for talent.  We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability.
jobs.description:
Everis has a different standard for talent. We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability. We look for exceptional work, sound judgment, fast learning, ownership, and evidence of impact. It is not a lower bar. It is a sharper one.

We’re looking for an accomplished software engineer who has built real mobile applications and already has practical exposure to growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or broader product work. This role requires both engineering depth and evidence that you can think beyond implementation.

Join Everis at a defining stage of growth. Help shape the product, influence the company we become, and grow with us. Work 100% remotely from anywhere, benefit from unlimited leave, and connect with colleagues at company-sponsored international retreats in some of the world’s most inspiring cities.

About Everis

Everis is a growing, remote-first software company founded by proven technology entrepreneurs Rob Rawson and Liam Martin, who previously built Time Doctor into an eight-figure global SaaS business. We acquire promising mobile apps and SaaS companies, invest in their future, and improve their products, technology, and customer experience. Our ambition is to make Everis the best long-term home for exceptional software products—and a company where exceptional people can take real ownership, do consequential work, and grow with us.

About the Product

Pebble is Everis’s growing, speaking-first language-learning app for iOS and Android. It helps people learn English, Spanish, and French through practical lessons, pronunciation practice, and guided conversations that get them speaking from day one. The product is live and evolving quickly, with major opportunities across onboarding, habit formation, activation, retention, conversion, and new markets. Your engineering and product decisions will directly influence how well people learn and how quickly Pebble grows.

What makes this role different

Most engineering roles begin after the problem, solution, and ticket have already been defined. Here, you join the work earlier. You will remain a software engineer first, but you will also identify product problems, decide what to test, build the solution, measure the outcome, and use the evidence to determine what happens next. This is not a marketing role for someone who codes; it is an engineering role with responsibility for product outcomes.

What you’ll work on

  • Build, ship, and improve Pebble’s mobile applications.

  • Find friction across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization.

  • Turn product questions into improvements, prototypes, A/B tests, and other useful experiments.

  • Use product and user data to understand behavior and decide what should be built next.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, and act on what you learn.

  • Work directly with our founders and product and business leadership.

  • Balance strong engineering with the speed required to test ideas and learn.

What you need to bring

This is a mobile engineering job first. You need to have built, shipped, and supported a production mobile app. We mean a real product used by real people - not just a demo or code sample.

We also need proof you've thought beyond implementation. Show us at least one of these:

  • Breadth beyond implementation. Direct mobile-growth or conversion work You must show meaningful evidence of at least one of the following: growth experimentation, A/B or split testing, conversion optimization, product ownership, building and operating your own software product.

  • Conversion optimization. You improved a real flow: onboarding, activation, a paywall, trial-to-paid, checkout, or another point where users dropped.

  • Core Stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment about reliability, maintainability, quality, and speed. Flutter/Dart, TypeScript/NestJS, MongoDB, or close equivalents; and App Store or Google Play subscriptions, paywalls, payments, or trial-to-paid journeys.

  • Production mobile engineering. Demonstrated success building and shipping production mobile applications using iOS, Android, cross-platform, or another credible mobile environment.

  • Product development or ownership. You helped decide what to build and why. You didn't just receive a finished specification. You can independently take production software from problem through implementation, release, and iteration.

  • Product-management-type work. You framed the problem, made trade-offs, defined success, or used evidence to choose the next move.

  • A product of your own. You built it, launched it, watched real people use it, and changed it based on what you learned.

What good looks like

  • Your fundamentals are solid. APIs, data modelling, testing, debugging, release practices, and production monitoring aren't someone else's job.

  • You can tell the whole story. What was wrong, what you personally built, what happened, and what you did next.

  • You cross boundaries when the problem demands it. Mobile, backend, web, data, analytics - you don't stop at the edge of your code.

  • You'd rather find out than argue from theory. You form a view, test it, and change your mind when the evidence says you should.

What we offer

  • Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 USD annually, depending on experience.

  • Consequential ownership: your decisions will directly affect Pebble and Everis.

  • Direct founder access: work closely with experienced entrepreneurs on important product and company decisions.

  • Exceptional colleagues: work with capable, curious, high-ownership people held to the same demanding standard.

  • Room to grow: take on larger problems and greater responsibility as Everis expands.

  • 100% remote: work from anywhere.

  • Unlimited leave: take meaningful time away when you need it.

  • Paid international company trips: come together with the team in some of the world’s most inspiring cities—to collaborate, build lasting relationships, and experience somewhere new.

Our recruiting process

We keep our process structured and transparent:

  • Initial review: Application → Written Assessment

  • Skills and reasoning: Recorded Scenario Assessment → Reasoning Intelligence Test → Recorded Role-Specific Assessment

  • Interviews: Technical Interview → Final Interview with a Co-Founder

  • Final evaluation: Paid Work Trial

If you are an exceptional mobile engineer who wants to help decide what gets built, prove whether it works, and shape a growing product, we want to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $80K - $120K

Working across multiple claims adjudication platforms and the team's ticketing and data warehouse environments, this role turns raw claims and workflow data into reliable metrics on cycle time, turnaround, recovery volume, and queue health. The Senior Data Analyst partners with operations leadership to define complex reporting requirements, builds repeatable and auditable data pulls in place of manual one-off extracts, and contributes to data quality and stewardship so the team's operational numbers hold up under leadership and audit review. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone fluent in SQL and claims data, not a generalist business intelligence position.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst is the analytics owner for a healthcare claims reprocessing and payment integrity team operating across two health plan markets. The team handles overpayment recovery, claims reprocessing, provider contestment review, and the operational reporting that supports each. This role builds and maintains the data products the team and its leadership rely on to manage day-to-day work and to demonstrate performance against operational targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain operational dashboards and reports that track reprocessing cycle time, post-approval turnaround, queue and hold status, stalled or aging tickets, contestment volume, and recovery throughput.

• Write and optimize complex SQL against multiple claims adjudication systems and an enterprise data platform, including queries that join claims data to ticketing and workflow data through established crosswalks.

• Replace manual, ad-hoc extracts with documented, repeatable, and parameterized data pulls so that recurring reports are consistent and reproducible from one period to the next.

• Translate operational questions from team leadership into clear reporting requirements, and document those requirements so the logic behind each metric is transparent and defensible.

• Conduct ad-hoc analysis to answer time-sensitive operational and prioritization questions, including high-dollar case identification and workload distribution across reviewers and analysts.

• Support data quality and stewardship efforts: validate that source data ties out, identify and document data gaps or anomalies, and flag conditions that would make a metric unreliable before it reaches leadership.

• Partner with IT and data platform teams on data access, source structure, and the migration of operational data off manual processes onto governed, auditable platforms.

• Produce reporting that is appropriate for a regulated, audited environment, including clear sourcing and documentation of report logic, while keeping the role's outputs limited to operational status and analytics rather than financial estimates or accounting determinations.

• Promote self-service reporting where appropriate by building reusable, well-documented data products rather than serving every request as a one-off.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. (Required)

Certification/Licensure

  • Relevant certification such as a coding credential (CPC), a Microsoft data or Power BI certification, or a SQL or database certification.

Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive data analysis experience, with at least two years working directly with healthcare claims, payer operations, or payment integrity data. (Required)
  • Demonstrated experience writing production-grade SQL against relational databases independently, not solely through a drag-and-drop reporting layer. (Required)
  • Advanced SQL, Data visualization and BI development, with hands-on Power BI experience
  • Python coding, data warehouse using Synapse
  • Exposure to workflow or ticketing systems and to joining workflow data to claims data.
  • Ability to gather and document reporting requirements and to explain the logic behind a metric to a non-technical operations audience.
  • Data Quality, Data Validation experience
  • Experience working with IT and Data teams
  • Experience with a claims adjudication platform (QNXT, Facets, or a comparable payer system) and with claims data structures such as claim, line, member eligibility, provider, and coordination of benefits.
  • Familiarity with operating in an ICFR or SOX regulated environment and producing reporting that supports audit and control requirements.

jobs.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less.
jobs.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales. Our creative library includes books, podcasts, keynotes, live events, member interviews, case studies, trainings, webinars, founder content, and years of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of paid hooks each week. When a hook or angle proves it can earn attention, you will turn it into a family of visual concepts for paid static ads. We are looking for a designer who has already produced conversion-focused creative at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will receive a winning hook or developed angle. You are not waiting for a finished layout. Your job is to decide how the idea should be visualized, which evidence or source material strengthens it, and how to create multiple distinct concepts that can be tested quickly.

This is one high-ownership in-house role, not a contractor-management position and not a brand-polish role.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

Receive a winning hook, proven ad, or developed angle from the creative strategy team, along with winners, losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team.

  • Understand why it worked and what the visual must communicate in the first second.
  • Use AI to search our content and proof library for relevant testimonials, founder material, book passages, customer stories, screenshots, frameworks, podcast moments, event excerpts, and visual references.
  • Develop several genuinely different visual concepts before polishing one direction. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, visual devices, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Design paid statics around books, highlighted passages, frameworks, customer proof, founder material, screenshots, UGC-style assets, photography, and original visual metaphors.
  • Create meaningful variations across headline, hierarchy, composition, image choice, proof, framing, CTA, and visual hook.
  • Use AI to accelerate research, composition exploration, image cleanup, controlled asset generation, and repetitive production while retaining human control over the concept and final craft.
  • Ship clean, editable Figma files and platform-ready exports.
  • Review the winners, losers, hook data, and performance feedback supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team, then turn the learning into new visual families.

What You Own

  • Visual concepting
  • Hook visualization
  • AI-assisted research
  • Proof visualization
  • Static ad design
  • Typography and hierarchy
  • Image and asset creation
  • Meaningful variations
  • Figma organization
  • Quality control
  • Winner iteration
  • Performance learning

What Your Day Actually Looks Like

  • Review winners, losers, hook data, creative references, and testing directions supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Select an approved hook or developed angle and generate several distinct visual approaches.
  • Search the content library with AI for the strongest supporting proof and imagery.
  • Build net-new concepts with disciplined hierarchy, typography, imagery, credibility, and platform-safe composition.
  • Create useful variations that isolate a real hypothesis.
  • Inspect legibility at feed size, source accuracy, visual artifacts, alignment, export settings, and file structure.
  • Use the supplied results and team analysis to build the next visual family from what worked.

What Success Looks Like

  • A proven hook becomes several distinct, testable visual concepts rather than one layout with color changes.
  • The idea reads immediately and the visual earns attention without cheapening trust.
  • Proof remains legible, accurate, and credible for a sophisticated business audience.
  • AI expands useful research and output without replacing design judgment.
  • Winning concepts are recombined and extended as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Editable files remain organized for rapid reuse and iteration.

What We Need to See

A portfolio of conversion-oriented paid ads with measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, CTR, conversion, booked calls, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

  • Strong typography, hierarchy, composition, image craft, and concept range across more than one visual style.
  • Personal ownership of the concepts and editable files you show.
  • Experience designing for a sophisticated or high-consideration audience where credibility matters as much as stopping power.
  • A testing example that explains the hook, visual hypothesis, variants, controlled differences, result, and next decision.
  • A repeatable AI-enabled Figma or design workflow with a finished example and credible impact on speed or output.

This Role Is Not

  • An organic social designer
  • A brand-only portfolio role
  • A production artist waiting for layouts
  • Template swapping at volume
  • AI imagery without design
  • A contractor-management position
  • Beauty without response

How to Apply

Choose one paid static campaign you personally designed. Explain the winning hook or starting angle, the audience, the visual hypothesis, the concepts and variations, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and show the editable working-file structure.

Then show us how AI materially improved the research, concepting, or production workflow without replacing your design judgment.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

Second, the this role acts as the clinical subject-matter expert on model development, ensuring payment integrity models make clinical and operational sense. Across both, this role brings enough command of PBM operations and analytics to drive realistic, actionable recommendations, partners closely with the data science team, and speaks to findings independently with clients and PBMs. This Position also collaborates with cross-functional teams, including product, account management, legal advisors, operations, and technology, to develop and implement pharmacy strategies.

Client PBM Guidance:

  • Serve as the primary pharmacy/clinical subject-matter expert on client calls, discussing payment integrity findings and translating analytics into clear, actionable stories for clients.

  • Bring a working knowledge of PBM operations, including how claims adjudicate and how pricing/rebate terms are administered in practice.

  • Potentially act as the clinical lead for PBM RFP evaluations and collaborating with the analytics team to ensure contract and financial guarantee findings are clinically and contractually sound.

Clinical Model Development & Payment Integrity:

  • Ensure payment integrity findings are integrated into the broader PBM strategy and client-narrative, rather than treated as a standalone deliverable.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Work closely with leadership to shape the vision and goals for pharmacy-related strategy, PBM operations, and payment integrity initiatives.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data science, account management, legal advisors, operations, and technology, to develop and implement pharmacy strategies.

Regulatory Compliance and Industry Standards:

  • Ensure PBM strategy and payment integrity work align with government regulations (e.g., CMS, CAA) and payer contract requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Experience:

This is often gained through roles such as trade/rebate contract negotiation, account management, clinical data science/analytics, or PBM clinical/claims operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to interpret PBM contract terms (pricing guarantees, rebate arrangements, definitions) and connect them to clinical and financial impact.

  • Comfortable partnering closely with an analytics team and speaking independently to their findings, without personally performing every underlying analysis.

  • Skills:

  • Strong executive presence; able to represent SmartLight independently in front of clients and PBMs.

  • Advanced knowledge of pharmacy benefits, PBM contracting and operations, claims adjudication, and formulary/utilization management.

  • Comfortable engaging with data science teams on model logic, clinical assumptions, and validation, without requiring a technical/data science background.

  • Excellent communication skills, translating complex clinical and contractual findings for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Strong collaboration and partnership skills, working effectively across teams without direct authority.

Key Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and clinical judgment, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and risk in pharmacy contract, claims, and operational data.

  • Ability to drive change and influence PBM discussions and outcomes based on data and clinical insight.

  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and compliance.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach to client and PBM challenges.

Who is SmartLight Analytics

SmartLight Analytics was formed by a group of industry insiders who wanted to make a meaningful impact on the rising cost of healthcare. With this end in mind, SmartLight works for self-funded employers to reduce the wasteful spend in their healthcare plan through our proprietary data analysis. Our process works behind the scenes to save money without interrupting employee benefits or requiring employee behavior changes.

You'll help Veterans navigate healthcare, benefits, behavioral health services, community resources, and other support while also helping the broader care team handle complex cases more effectively.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to do more than manage individual cases. You'll serve as a resource to other care coordinators, help improve Veteran-specific workflows, identify gaps in the program, contribute to training, and help shape how care coordination is delivered as the program develops.

We're particularly interested in someone whose background brings together Veteran or VA experience, care coordination, and increasing program responsibility.

This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations.

For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings.

This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting.

The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared.

What You’ll Do

Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support

  • Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories.

  • Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach.

  • Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage.

  • Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests.

  • Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters.

  • Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings.

  • Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.

Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support

  • Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity.

  • Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points.

  • Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.

  • Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant.

  • Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging.

  • Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager.

Sales Alignment & Enablement

  • Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points.

  • Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate.

  • Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team.

  • Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities.

  • Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.

  • Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.

  • Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.

  • Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.

  • The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

  • 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role.

  • Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.

This role is focused on agentic systems: software that reasons over a task, calls tools, works through multiple steps, and hands the result to a person to review and approve.

Our users work under strict accuracy, traceability, and validation requirements. The engineering challenge is making non-deterministic systems reliable, observable, and controllable enough to be trusted, tested, and shipped.

You’ll work on both the platform and runtime our agents execute on and the production agents built on top of it.

What You’ll Work On:

Agent Platform & Runtime (Core Focus)

  • Design and build the runtime our agents execute on: planning and execution loops, tool calling, state management, durable execution, and failure recovery
  • Build the layer through which agents reach platform data and external systems safely
  • Design coordination, delegation, and handoff across agents and workflows where needed
  • Make agent behavior versionable, testable, measurable, and regression-safe across releases
  • Build reusable primitives so new agents are configured rather than rebuilt from scratch

Building Agents (Core Focus)

  • Take a domain workflow from expert conversation to a working agent: goals, actions, execution flow, failure handling, and success criteria
  • Ground agent decisions and outputs in authoritative enterprise data rather than relying on model knowledge alone
  • Implement human-in-the-loop by design, including approval gates, override capture, uncertainty handling, and clear evidence for agent decisions. Agents recommend and draft; people decide
  • Close the loop: turn user corrections and overrides into signals that measurably improve the agent

Evaluation & Reliability

  • Build evaluation harnesses for multi-step behavior, not single-response accuracy: task completion, tool-call correctness, groundedness, trajectory quality, and regression across model, prompt, and tool changes
  • Define production metrics for agent quality, reliability, latency, cost, and human intervention rates
  • Implement guardrails, fallbacks, timeouts, cost ceilings, and end-to-end observability and tracing across agent runs
  • Design safeguards against prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, data leakage, and other agent-specific security risks
  • Manage prompt evolution, model drift, and non-determinism while maintaining consistent, measurable system behavior across releases

Integration & Data

  • Integrate agents with platform APIs and third-party enterprise systems already running in our customers’ environments
  • Build retrieval and context pipelines that turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable, permission-aware agent context
  • Design controlled execution paths for automated actions, with a complete, traceable audit trail

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Build and operate backend services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, etc.)
  • Own significant parts of the system architecture and contribute to key technical decisions
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python
  • Backend: Node.js, Python, AWS Lambda, Step Functions
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP and related agent/tool protocols, embeddings and vector search
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • Testing: Jest, Playwright, pytest

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including production systems
  • Experience building production LLM systems, including tool-using or multi-step agentic workflows beyond simple prompting and chat interfaces
  • Strong understanding of LLM behavior, limitations, and failure modes, especially how errors compound across a multi-step run
  • Experience with LLM APIs, tool and function calling, and designing planning and execution loops
  • Experience evaluating and debugging non-deterministic systems
  • Solid backend and cloud experience (AWS or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python

You Should Be Comfortable With

  • Debugging across distributed and non-deterministic systems
  • Making explicit tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost
  • Working in ambiguous problem spaces where the right architecture isn't obvious yet
  • Owning production systems end-to-end
  • Choosing conventional software over AI when AI isn't the right solution

Nice to Have

  • C#, Microsoft .NET Framework
  • Tool and interop protocols such as MCP
  • Evaluation pipelines and metrics built specifically for agentic systems
  • Experience in regulated or domain-heavy systems (validation, audit trails, controlled change)
  • Retrieval and grounding techniques for supplying agent context
  • Workflow and durable-execution platforms (Temporal, Step Functions, n8n, etc.)
  • Containerization and orchestration (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

We are seeking an experienced Sales Development Representative to join our Sales team. The SDR team is focused on ensuring our products are first and foremost in the hearts and minds of teachers, educators, and our ultimate end user – the kids!

What you will be doing…

You will be responsible for providing sales support to the new business sales team. Primary areas of focus will include proactive and reactive management of both inbound and outbound client inquiries and outreach, top-of-funnel lead management, and CRM management. 

Ideally, you will have

  • Conviction, follow-up, resilience, and an internal drive for success. 
  • Highly organized with an ability to proactively prioritize and manage your time. 
  • Client-centric in everything you do. 

Ideally, you will be

  • A great communicator – both verbal and written. You must be able to smile and dial the phone, hold a conversation, listen, adapt, and educate K-12 Teachers, Principals and District leaders on 3P’s software product offerings. Equally proficient at creating a clear and effective email or sales campaign. 
  • Outbound lead generation and follow-up for our Business Development Managers.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Exacom, a Motorola Solutions company, provides mission-critical recording solutions for public safety, government, military, and critical infrastructure agencies. Our team supports customers with reliable technology, direct support, and a customer-focused approach to complex recording and data capture environments.


Job Description

Motorola Solutions is looking for a Product Manager to own Product Management across the Hindsight recording platform. You'll be responsible for licensing and subscription management, system integrations, product roadmap, and delivering a unified emergency communications recording experience across the Hindsight suite of products. You'll be part of an empowered product team operating with a startup mindset inside a large enterprise. Reporting to the Director of Product Management for Hindsight, you'll own the billing foundation that powers monetization across our unified platform, working directly with engineering, finance, and operations to build systems that scale. This role is hands-on: you'll run discovery, define outcomes, ship products, and measure results.

Responsibilities:

Run Continuous Discovery: Talk to customers, finance teams, and operations stakeholders regularly. Conduct interviews, observe billing workflows, analyze usage and payment data, and synthesize what you learn into clear problem statements and opportunity assessments.
Ship Product That Matters: Work with engineering and design to move from problem to solution to delivery. Write clear product specs, make scope trade-offs, and ensure what ships actually solves the problem you set out to solve.
Measure Impact: Define success metrics for your area and instrument your product to track them. Use data to inform decisions, validate hypotheses, and demonstrate business impact.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Finance, Sales Operations, ERP teams, and other product teams within Motorola Solutions to ensure feature changes are coordinated, launches are clean, and feedback from the field shapes the roadmap.
Understand the Landscape: Stay sharp on emergency communication trends. Use that knowledge to inform how Hindsight structures features, pricing, packaging, and subscription management.
Competitive Product: Build competitive analysis and review where our product stands in the overall market.
Sales/Marketing Enablement: Work with the sales and marketing teams to to align product catalogs and sales materials to achieve smooth go to market processes.

Qualifications:

Bachelors Degree with at least 5+ years of professional experience in a high tech environment with 3+ years of product management experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software.

Experience with emergency communications systems, radio systems, call handling systems or cloud hosted platforms.

Demonstrated ability to run customer discovery and translate findings into product decisions.

Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, including the ability to engage in technical discussions about architecture and trade-offs.

Experience defining and tracking product metrics, and using data to drive prioritization.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product strategy and rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences.

A bias toward action and learning over perfection, with experience shipping product iteratively.

What Sets You Apart:

AI Fascination and Vibe Coding Experience: Gone are the days when only the engineers could code. We expect you to be able to stand up AI generated prototypes rapidly and iterate on them.

Multi-Sided Ecosystem Thinking: You've worked with products that serve multiple stakeholder types (partners, installers, integrators, end-users) and understand the trade-offs involved.

jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a remote/work-from-home (WFH) production underwriting role that includes travel to key agency relationships within the assigned territory.

Territory: TBD but likely a combination of states in the overall Northeast.

Preferably, this individual will be based in or close to their respective territory.

Qualified candidates must have Commercial insurance underwriting experience (with authority) and a profitability & production orientated lens along with agency management.

Additionally:

  • Strong preference for commercial middle market expertise

  • Construction-specific insurance industry experience is ideal

  • Existing relationships with agency partner firms is highly desirable

The internal title for this role is Sr Territory Manager, Construction Services Business Development - Commercial Lines.

This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.

Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Senior Territory Manager, you'll work primarily middle market accounts, with an emphasis in commercial lines construction services, representing some of our most complex and sophisticated distribution partners. You'll market, manage and underwrite business through direct contact with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet top financial goals and objectives. To succeed, it will be important to collaborate with internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes action plan to resolve those situations. Performs analysis of the most complex accounts that require combining experience, intuition and business savvy to make strategic territory and account decisions.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Navigates complex interactions necessary to influence sophisticated producers and customers. Independently reviews for acceptability and handles those within level of authority using company underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting a significant volume of assigned work using company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Facilitates the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, accountabilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Considers sophistication of partners, navigates organizational complexities and mines for ancillary opportunities through promotion and negotiation techniques. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the team on new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all products that may improve offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and developing new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Assesses accounts and develops business propositions to win business.

  • Consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique businesses. Provides industry trend observations to leaders. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability. Proactively identifies and consults on new business and growth strategies.

  • Communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates market intelligence to agencies and leaders. Communicates and collaborates actively with team and leaders to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance and enhance agency relationship. Builds and maintains strong business relationships with agency leaders, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. May assist in the development or training delivery as a subject matter authority.

  • Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority. Provides professional development knowledge and insight to team. May help mentor and coach new Territory Managers.

  • Manages a significant workload effectively and backs up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to measure performance and develops action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews. Ensures that unique agency business capabilities are assessed and emphasized as a competitive advantage.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Director.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Extensive working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and philosophies, company products and programs and state statutes. Strong knowledge of effective sales, marketing and agency relationship management techniques. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment within underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Must have the ability to determine situations where additional support is needed for decisions. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. jobs.description:
Job Title: Director - LIMS Strategy - CPG & F&B

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems has built the first modern cloud LIMS system, and we are hiring a Director of LIMS Strategy, QualityOne, to accelerate our growth across global accounts in the Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), and Chemical Ingredients industries.
In this high-impact role, you will architect and execute the commercial strategy for our LIMS product line within these target sectors. You will act as the ultimate bridge between sales, marketing, product, and services, unifying them into a cohesive market vision while developing and personally delivering key messaging, training sales teams, and establishing industry thought leadership.
We are seeking a visionary leader with deep expertise in laboratory informatics, strong market intuition, and relevant experience in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) supply chain who can seamlessly pivot from high-level strategy to hands-on, day-to-day execution.

What You'll Do

Market Expansion & Growth

    • Drive Market Entry: Own the growth and market penetration of Veeva LIMS for QualityOne across target FMCG and their supply chain sectors
    • Act as a Commercial Leader: Operate in a high-visibility, customer-facing commercial capacity to drive positive outcomes for both customers and Veeva
    • Champion Thought Leadership: Serve as an industry evangelist by presenting at major conferences, leading webinars, and authoring content for industry publications

Customer Engagement & Deal Strategy

    • Discovery & Workshops: Lead customer discovery sessions to uncover pain points, define desired benefits, and co-create solutions powered by Veeva LIMS
    • Deliver High-Impact Presentations: Support sales in creating and delivering compelling presentations to prospects, active customers, and executive stakeholders
    • Support Deals: Help prospective customers build their business cases to justify investments and accelerate the sales cycle. Support sales in deal strategy, pricing and proposals
    • Analyze the Competition: Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and develop tactical strategies and materials to win against competitors

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

    • Influence Product Roadmap: Provide vital business and technology guidance to the product team to shape new or enhanced features in laboratory informatics software
    • Enable Field Teams: Provide strategic direction and messaging to field-facing teams while building strong relationships with executive leadership
    • Coordinate the Customer Lifecycle: Align and coordinate resources across the entire customer journey, from initial sales to final delivery and beyond
    • Build Communities: Engage deeply with communities of practice and manage relationships with both internal and external stakeholders and partners

Requirements

Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge

    • Informatics Background: 8+ years of experience growing and scaling a technology offering at a laboratory informatics software vendor and/or a laboratory informatics consulting firm
    • Industry Alignment: Proven track record working with Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), supply chain companies, or closely related industries
    • Executive Presence: Proven ability to hold meaningful, strategic conversations with Heads of Quality, QC, and IT leaders regarding software applications and modernization
    • Innovation & Problem Solving: Demonstrated success innovating across complex business processes and technical solutions using critical thinking

Communication & Influence

    • Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
    • High-Impact Presenter: Dynamic presentation skills with the ability to be clear, concise, convincing, confident, and credible to any audience
    • Relationship Builder: Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for collaborating and working closely with people

Drive & Execution

    • Self-Starter Mentality: Driven and highly motivated leader who is comfortable taking initiative and working independently
    • Execution Excellence: Detail-oriented with a strong, self-imposed standard of quality, diligence, and a hard-working "want to win" attitude
    • Travel Flexibility: Ability and willingness to travel up to 40% for customer meetings and presentations

Nice to Have

    • Quality & Manufacturing Domain Expertise: Industry experience spanning Quality Control (QC), GxP quality content, training management, quality systems processes, or manufacturing
    • Commercial Leadership: Proven experience leading or guiding global sales teams to aggressively pursue and close complex enterprise opportunities
    • Executive Relationship Management: Seasoned background in establishing, expanding, and maintaining trusted partnerships with C-suite and executive-level stakeholders
    • Established Authority: Published thought leadership pieces, whitepapers, or articles within the laboratory informatics domain

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 120,000 - 200,000 EUR

Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

jobs.description:
Pay: $140,000.00 - $205,000.00 per year

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Build a meaningful family law career with a growing, modern, remote-first firm that values both excellent client outcomes and attorney sustainability.
  • Handle high-impact divorce, custody, support, and equitable distribution matters with an emphasis on negotiation, strategy, and durable resolutions.
  • Enjoy genuine autonomy over your cases while working alongside experienced paralegals, administrative support, and accessible leadership.
  • Work remotely by design, with office space available for attorneys who prefer an in-office option.
  • Earn a competitive compensation package with performance bonuses and a 10% new client origination bonus.
  • Explore a real partnership opportunity as you grow with our team.
  • Take meaningful time away knowing attorney coverage is available while you are out.
  • Benefit from medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays, and modern systems designed to make your work easier.

Location:

Remote within Northern Virginia, with in-person court appearances and depositions as needed. Office space is also available for attorneys who prefer to work in person.

Note:

To be considered, you must be an active member of the Virginia State Bar in good standing, be located in Northern Virginia, and have at least 2 years of directly relevant family law experience.

About Us

We are a growing, technology-forward family law practice built around a simple belief: exceptional client outcomes begin with a strong, supported team. Our attorneys help clients navigate divorce, custody, support, and complex financial matters with clear strategy, thoughtful advocacy, and a commitment to resolving conflict whenever possible. We are building a modern law firm where talented attorneys have autonomy, meaningful support, and the opportunity to grow. Confidential Employer.

Job Description

  • Manage family law matters from initial strategy through resolution, including divorce, custody, visitation, support, equitable distribution, enforcement, and modification matters.
  • Develop thoughtful case strategies that prioritize negotiated resolutions and minimize unnecessary conflict.
  • Represent clients in court when necessary with confidence, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Negotiate directly with opposing counsel to pursue favorable and durable outcomes.
  • Conduct legal research and draft pleadings, motions, agreements, and other case documents.
  • Communicate proactively and clearly with clients throughout their matters.
  • Help clients focus on practical, long-term solutions during difficult and consequential transitions.
  • Coordinate closely with paralegals and support staff to maintain organized files and meet deadlines.
  • Manage your work independently in a remote environment while staying connected to a collaborative team.

Qualifications

  • Active Virginia State Bar license in good standing.
  • 2+ years of directly relevant family law experience.
  • Experience handling divorce, custody, visitation, support, equitable distribution, enforcement, and modification matters.
  • Strong negotiation and settlement skills with a resolution-focused approach to family law.
  • Strong legal research, drafting, written communication, and client communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage a remote caseload effectively.
  • Located in Northern Virginia and available for required in-person court appearances.

Job title: Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing

Location: 100% remote; candidates must be based in the United States or Canada and available during North American business hours

Employment: Full-time

Salary: US$70,000–$85,000 base salary, plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000, depending on ability and experience.

Everis is hiring an early-career analyst to build the pipeline of businesses we may acquire. You will research markets and companies, build relationships with brokers, contact owners, qualify opportunities, do initial analysis, and hand the strongest deals to our acquisition team with clear notes.

This is a sourcing and relationship role, not a traditional investment-banking role. Your main responsibility is high-quality deal flow. You will see evaluation, diligence, and transactions, but the deal team owns complex modelling, diligence, negotiation, and execution.

Why join Everis

  • Work directly on acquisition strategy and see how a lead becomes a serious opportunity.

  • Speak with brokers, advisers, founders, and owners while learning what makes a business attractive and why owners sell.

  • Research varied industries, use modern AI and sourcing tools, take ownership quickly, and grow into broader acquisition responsibilities.

About Everis

Everis is a software holding company with $27 million in annual recurring revenue. We buy B2B SaaS companies from the founders who built them and keep them permanently. We invest our own capital and operate without the pressure of a fund exit timeline. Our remote team strengthens engineering and product, pricing, go-to-market, retention, revenue operations, and back-office systems across the portfolio.

What you’ll work on

Broker and intermediary relationships

  • Find and build relationships with relevant brokers, advisers, marketplaces, and other deal sources.

  • Stay in regular contact, understand what they have coming to market, and follow up consistently.

  • Screen brokered and marketplace opportunities against Everis’s criteria and surface the strongest ones quickly.

Owner sourcing and outreach

  • Build targeted lists of businesses and owners that may fit our criteria.

  • Find and verify decision-maker contacts, then run thoughtful outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.

  • Hold initial conversations, understand each owner’s goals, and follow up professionally over what may be a long cycle.

Research and qualification

  • Understand what each business does, how it makes money, who its customers are, and what makes it defensible.

  • Gather high-level information on revenue, profit, growth, recurring revenue, customer concentration, owner involvement, asking price, sale motivation, and timing.

  • Assess fit, prepare short opportunity briefs and notes, and coordinate a clean handoff to the deal team.

Pipeline ownership and improvement

  • Keep the acquisition CRM accurate, including contacts, source, stage, notes, next action, financial snippets, risks, and follow-up dates.

  • Track outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, handoffs, and funnel progression. Provide concise weekly reporting.

  • Use evidence and AI tools to improve research, outreach, recordkeeping, and the sourcing methods that produce the best opportunities.

What we’re looking for

  • Evidence of exceptional ability through one specific, verifiable accomplishment with unusual difficulty, selectivity, or impact—and a clear explanation of what you personally contributed.

  • Alternatively, direct acquisition experience that includes all three: analysing small or mid-sized SaaS or mobile-app businesses, judging their attractiveness as acquisition targets, and engaging owners or founders about acquisition fit or motivations.

  • Strong research and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and communicate credibly with brokers, advisers, owners, and founders. You are smart, curious, and able to learn quickly.

  • Excellent spoken and written communication. You are comfortable making cold calls, sending outbound messages, hearing no, and following up consistently without relying on finance jargon.

  • Highly organized, reliable, proactive, and resilient. You maintain accurate notes, follow through on commitments, handle confidential information with integrity, and work effectively without constant supervision.

  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, research databases, and AI tools, with basic financial and commercial literacy or the ability to learn quickly.

This role is designed for candidates with zero to three years of professional experience. Prior acquisition or sales experience is not required when a candidate demonstrates exceptional ability. Generic sales results, outreach volume, list building, financial modelling, credentials, or employer prestige do not establish a strong match on their own.

What we offer

  • US$70,000–$85,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000.

  • 100% remote work from the United States or Canada.

  • Direct exposure to founders, brokers, owners, and real acquisition opportunities.

  • Meaningful responsibility early, with a path into senior deal origination, acquisitions, or broader operating work.

If you want to learn how great businesses are found and directly help build Everis’s acquisition pipeline, we’d like to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $70K - $85K

The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.

Clinical Trial Monitoring

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality;

  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met;

  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery;

  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites;

  • Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks;

  • Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level;

jobs.title: Director of Product Execution
jobs.excerpt: At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent.
jobs.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

Strategy is worth what gets delivered. At LegitScript, the Director of Product Execution owns that delivery. You will own the portfolio view, run the prioritization process, and build the operating discipline that turns product direction into shipped, measured outcomes. You are not the author of the strategy or the products — your product managers own that work — but this role exists to make it count for more.

You will run prioritization on consistent criteria in a forum where the reasoning is visible, so the ranking is trusted by the teams whose work is deferred, not only the teams whose work is chosen. You will protect focus as roadmaps grow, hold every bet to a shared readiness standard, and close the loop by measuring what actually happened after launch. This is a leadership role with hands in the work: you lead through your product managers while staying close enough to the details to catch a vague requirement, an unowned dependency, or a metric that will not tell us anything.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the portfolio view: what is committed, what is in flight, what is at risk, and what has been deliberately deferred.
  • Own the prioritization process end to end, including the cadence, the criteria, and the forum where bets are ranked and the outcome is published.
  • Set and hold the readiness bar for work entering the plan: a defined problem, an intended outcome, a measure, an owner, and both signatures.
  • Drive scope discipline, breaking large bets into increments that deliver value on their own and retiring work that no longer earns its place.
  • Identify and resolve cross-squad dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and capacity contention before they become delivery risk.
  • Own the operating cadence for product, including planning, prioritization, roadmap review, launch readiness, and retrospectives.
  • Run launches end to end from the product side, including readiness, enablement, communication, and post-launch measurement.
  • Lead, coach, and grow the product management team, owning hiring, performance, and career development.
  • Set the standard for product craft, including problem definition, discovery, requirements, and success metrics.
  • Review product managers' work and give feedback that raises the standard, from sharper problem statements to clearer requirements.
  • Define and track execution metrics, including delivery predictability, cycle time, scope change, and effort spent on abandoned work.
  • Report progress to engineering leadership, the strategy organization, and the executive team with clarity and a clear point of view.

What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers or product teams.
  • A track record of delivering complex B2B software, ideally in SaaS, fintech, regtech, compliance, trust and safety, or another domain where accuracy and defensibility matter as much as speed.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-team product portfolio, including sequencing work with visible cross-team dependencies and managing capacity across competing demands.
  • Experience running a prioritization process across competing domains, with an output trusted by the teams whose work was deferred as well as the teams whose work was chosen.
  • Experience executing a strategy you did not author, converting direction from strategy owners into delivered, measured outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with an engineering counterpart as a peer, with a clean boundary between product intent and technical execution.
  • Fluency in modern delivery practice, including incremental delivery, iterative planning, and release approaches that get value to customers early.
  • Enough technical depth to engage credibly with architecture and platform trade-offs, and the judgment not to mistake that for owning them.
  • Strong analytical practice, including defining delivery and outcome metrics, instrumenting for them, and changing course when the data says to.
  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to make a complex trade-off legible to an executive, an engineer, and a customer in the same document.
  • Comfort operating through change, including establishing durable operating practices where none exist and improving them without disrupting delivery.
  • A four-year college degree or a comparable blend of education and experience. We value practical skills, a strong work ethic, and a passion for learning, regardless of formal education

Preferred:

  • Experience in products that combine software automation with expert human review.
  • Domain experience in payments, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, supplements, financial crime, marketplaces, or advertising platforms.
  • Experience with platform, API, or integration products serving enterprise partners.
  • Experience establishing product operating discipline in an organization that did not previously have it.

We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.
