Job Description

At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.

As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.

Job Summary:
Leads commissioning activities for complex projects within a business unit, ensuring the verification, validation, and performance of all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems and integrated building systems. Serves as a technical resource for commissioning planning, execution, and documentation, guiding project teams through all phases of commissioning to confirm systems meet design intent and operational requirements. Partners with project leadership, engineers, and trade partners to drive consistency, efficiency, and quality in system turnover and project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
Leads commissioning planning and execution for complex projects, ensuring all mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) and building systems are verified and validated in accordance with project and company standards.
Develops and maintains commissioning plans that define testing requirements, inspections, start-up procedures, documentation and integrated system testing.
Coordinates cross-functional commissioning meetings, facilitates system-level testing and tracks progress and issues through completion and turnover.
Reviews and validates test documentation, system performance data and vendor reports to ensure quality and compliance with design and operational criteria.
Collaborates with project managers, MEP coordinators, clients and trade contractors to identify, communicate and resolve commissioning-related issues.
Mentors commissioning specialists and project teams, providing technical guidance and sharing best practices to enhance business unit-level commissioning performance.
Recommends and implements process improvements, leverages technology and data to optimize commissioning efficiency and accuracy and supports talent acquisition efforts by participating in interviews and evaluating commissioning experience and role alignment.

Education Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, construction management, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

Work Experience:
6–8 years of experience in commissioning, MEP coordination, building systems operations, or a related field required.
Experience leading commissioning efforts on complex or mission-critical projects preferred.

Certifications and Licenses:

None required.

Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP), Accredited Commissioning Process Authority (CxA), or LEED Accredited Professional preferred.

DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world.


Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek.

Company Overview

Where metal meets momentum. Where bold ideas become the products everyone else wishes they built.
Welcome to JR Metal Works. One of the fastest-rising names in American manufacturing.

We combine precision engineering, modern fabrication technology, and true craftsmanship to create products built to last. As we continue to grow, we remain deeply committed to quality, safety, and continuous improvement, on the shop floor and beyond.

At JR Metal Works, you’re not just filling a role. You’re joining a team that values integrity, teamwork, and problem-solving. We invest in your growth so you can build a career with real impact.

We offer competitive pay, a comprehensive benefits package, and clear opportunities for advancement in a company that’s moving forward—fast.

Position Summary

The Project Designer is responsible for creating, reviewing, and supporting technical designs that meet customer specifications and internal manufacturing requirements. This role collaborates closely with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure designs are accurate, manufacturable, and aligned with production capabilities.

The Project Designer supports projects from design through production and installation, contributing to quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement across the organization.

Core Responsibilities

  • Create and review technical drawings to ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal standards, and manufacturing requirements.
  • Develop and maintain job travelers to support accurate and efficient production execution.
  • Perform tolerance analysis on critical assemblies to ensure proper fit, function, and performance.
  • Meet with suppliers, customers, and project stakeholders to review designs and implement changes as required.
  • Modify and update designs to resolve operating, quality, or production issues.
  • Provide installation support as needed to ensure successful implementation of designed components or assemblies.
  • Attend team and project meetings to provide progress updates, coordinate with colleagues, plan next steps, and stay informed on emerging product lines.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and adhere to JR Metal Works’ quality, safety, and continuous improvement standards.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proficiency in SolidWorks software and technical drawing creation.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, tolerancing, and assembly design.
  • Ability to interpret customer prints, specifications, and technical requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication skills with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Career Growth & Development

JR Metal Works is committed to helping employees build long-term, rewarding careers. Each position is supported by a Position Information Sheet (PIS) that clearly outlines role expectations, skill milestones, and growth pathways.

Position Information Sheets provide transparency into:

  • Performance and merit-based pay progression
  • Skill and responsibility milestones
  • Leadership growth and development opportunities
  • Cross-training and internal advancement paths
  • Training, certification, and professional development expectations

Advancement at JR Metal Works is based on demonstrated performance, skill mastery, accountability, and alignment with company values. Employees are encouraged to actively engage with their Position Information Sheet and leadership team to track progress and plan their next career step.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. Duties may change at any time with or without notice.

Employment with JR Metal Works is at-will and may be terminated by either the employee or the Company at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

JR Metal Works is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws.

Employees are expected to comply with all company policies, safety procedures, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations. Nothing in this job description creates a contract of employment or guarantees compensation or advancement.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The RFP Manager leads Elovate's proposal development function, owning the end-to-end process for responding to requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for quotes (RFQs), and requests for information (RFIs) from municipal and government agency clients. This role combines strong writing and editing skills with disciplined project management, ensuring every proposal is accurate, compelling, on-brand, and delivered on time. The RFP Manager works closely with subject matter experts across Sales, Operations, Product, Finance, and Marketing to translate technical and program knowledge into clear, persuasive proposal content, while also partnering with Corporate Leadership on win strategy and driving continuous improvement across the proposal process.

Job Description:

Core Responsibilities

  • Proposal Development & Writing

    • Create high-quality, customized responses to requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for quotes (RFQs), and requests for information (RFIs).

    • Edit content created by subject matter experts and partner with Marketing to improve and refine new content.

    • Develop, write, and proofread content tailored for different audiences — from novice to expert — and flexible for use across different markets and program implementations.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts and corporate personnel to develop and write technical and management content for written responses.

    • Edit content across all proposal documentation, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and integrity throughout.

    Proposal Process & Project Management

    • Manage the complexity of a large volume of concurrent proposals, with a focus on project management and quality assurance across the full proposal process life cycle.

    • Meet proposal deadlines by establishing priorities and target dates for information gathering, writing, review, and approval.

    • Monitor workflow in Monday.com to ensure the RFP and government bid request process is consistently followed by all parties involved.

    Quality Assurance & Compliance

    • Ensure proposals meet established Elovate standards for content and style, and are compliant with Elovate Marketing corporate standards.

    • Serve as a final quality checkpoint, verifying that every proposal reflects Elovate's brand, accuracy, and professionalism before submission.

    Strategy & Stakeholder Collaboration

    • Collaborate with Corporate Leadership to develop a proposal win strategy and integrate that strategy throughout the proposal.

    • Maintain the database of competitive wins and losses, using insights to inform future proposal strategy and positioning.

    Training & Continuous Improvement

    • Provide training to Sales on RFP processes, timelines, and best practices.

    • Proactively identify areas of process improvement and lead efforts to drive a positive proposal experience for all stakeholders.

    • Assist with special projects and other duties as requested and assigned by management to support overall departmental efficiency.

    Requirements

    • 4+ years of experience in proposal management, technical writing, RFP response, or a related role, ideally within a B2B, government, or public sector environment.

    • Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and proofread clear, persuasive, and audience-appropriate content under tight deadlines.

    • Proven experience managing multiple concurrent proposals with strong project management and organizational discipline.

    • Excellent collaboration skills, with experience partnering with subject matter experts, sales, and executive stakeholders to produce written content.

    • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and brand compliance across all deliverables.

    • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with Monday.com or comparable project management platforms strongly preferred.

    • Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

    Nice to Haves

    • Experience responding to government or municipal RFPs, RFQs, or RFIs.

    • Background in automated traffic enforcement, public safety technology, or GovTech.

    • APMP certification or formal proposal management training.

    • Experience building or maintaining a competitive win/loss database or knowledge library.

    • Familiarity with sales enablement or CRM platforms.

Worker Type:

Regular

Number of Openings Available:

GTM Manager / Head of GTM

Employment type: Full-time
Location: Remote

About our Client

Our client builds data generation and evaluation systems for Physical AI and robotics. We help technical teams turn complex data, model outputs, and evaluation workflows into usable systems for real-world AI and robotics development.

We are looking for a hands-on GTM Manager / Head of GTM to build our commercial strategy, win customers, and turn early traction into a repeatable revenue engine.

You will work directly with the founders and collaborate closely with product, research, and engineering. This role combines strategic go-to-market work with direct sales execution: identifying the right markets and accounts, opening conversations, understanding complex customer needs, shaping compelling commercial offers, and closing business.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and refine Miraxis’s ideal customer profile, priority segments, buyer personas, and target accounts across Physical AI and robotics.

  • Build and execute a go-to-market strategy covering positioning, customer acquisition, sales channels, and commercial partnerships.

  • Generate qualified pipeline through targeted outbound, founder networks, partnerships, industry events, and relevant inbound opportunities.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposals, negotiation, and closing.

  • Develop relationships with technical decision-makers, budget owners, and executive sponsors.

  • Understand customers’ data-generation and model-evaluation challenges, purchasing criteria, budgets, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value, differentiated messaging, and persuasive commercial materials.

  • Partner with technical teams to structure commercially viable pilots with measurable success criteria and a clear path to paid adoption.

  • Help develop pricing and packaging based on customer feedback, willingness to pay, and delivery economics.

  • Convert pilots and early engagements into paid contracts, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Identify partnerships that provide access to customers and create new revenue opportunities.

  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and communicate realistic forecasts, deal priorities, risks, and next steps.

  • Track conversion rates, sales-cycle length, deal value, and reasons for wins and losses.

  • Bring customer and market insights back to the product, research, and engineering teams.

  • Build repeatable sales processes and playbooks as Miraxis grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in B2B go-to-market, business development, or full-cycle sales for technical products or services.

  • A demonstrated record of personally generating pipeline and closing revenue.

  • Experience selling to technical buyers and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.

  • Strong discovery skills and the ability to connect customer challenges to a compelling value proposition.

  • Confidence leading commercial discussions, preparing proposals, negotiating terms, and moving opportunities toward a decision.

  • The ability to understand and credibly communicate technical concepts with support from subject-matter experts.

  • Experience developing market positioning, defining target segments, or testing customer-acquisition channels.

  • Strong commercial judgment and a disciplined approach to qualification, prioritization, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • High ownership and comfort building processes in an early-stage environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling solutions related to AI, robotics, data platforms, infrastructure, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or technical services.

  • A relevant network within robotics companies, AI labs, or enterprise AI teams.

  • Experience turning founder-led sales into a scalable and repeatable commercial process.

  • Experience structuring technical pilots or proof-of-concept engagements and converting them into paid contracts.

  • Familiarity with pricing and packaging for data, software, or technical services.

  • Experience developing revenue-generating partnerships.

  • Experience helping a new company or offering win its first customers or enter a new market.

What Success Looks Like

  • Miraxis has a clear ICP and positioning that resonates with technical and commercial buyers.

  • The company develops a growing, qualified pipeline that produces new paying customers.

  • Pilots have defined success criteria and commercial next steps, leading to paid adoption.

  • Revenue grows through new customer acquisition, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Forecasts accurately reflect deal progress and genuine buying signals.

  • Customer insights improve the company’s positioning, offers, and product direction.

  • Successful acquisition and sales approaches become repeatable playbooks.

Working at our Client

This is an opportunity to build the commercial function of a company working at the intersection of AI, robotics, data, and model evaluation. The right person will be commercially driven, intellectually curious, comfortable with technical products, and motivated by building the sales motion—not simply inheriting one.

You will have meaningful ownership, direct access to the founders, and the opportunity to influence both Miraxis’s revenue strategy and product direction.

As an Accountant, you will take end to end ownership of assigned accounting areas across operating costs, cash transactions, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed assets and intangible assets, including internally developed intangible assets. jobs.description:
Marketing Manager

Remote, South Africa. Full-time, permanent, UK hours. R30,000 per month.

Read this before you apply

This is a senior seat at a company of four people. Nobody will train you and nobody has time to check your work. If you need a manager to break tasks down for you, this is not the job. If you have run the whole marketing channel for a small business and you are good at it, keep reading.

The company

Our client is a London-based AI training and transformation consultancy, a year and a half old, founder-led, growing. They teach leadership teams what AI can actually do for their business, then build it with them: data readiness, workflow analysis, AI literacy training, custom AI agents. Two founders, a small payroll, and a fractional CMO who sets direction.

The job

You run marketing end to end for a small, fast-growing business. The fractional CMO owns the strategy, the calendar and the priorities. Everything downstream of that is yours: you take the brief and you deliver it, properly, without being chased and without being taught.

You will be across all of it, social, content, email, events, analytics, paid. But we are not looking for someone who is average at everything. We want you to be genuinely strong in one or two areas and competent across the rest.

What you will actually do

  • Take a brief from the fractional CMO and execute it end to end, first time, to a standard nobody has to correct
  • Build and ship email campaigns and automated sequences in ActiveCampaign, including event follow-up flows segmented by who attended and who did not
  • Own the content and publishing calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram
  • Write. Short-form copy, campaign emails, social, show notes. You will not have a copywriter sitting next to you
  • Run the SEO programme: what topics the business should own, and the content that wins them
  • Run and optimise paid campaigns where they earn their place, and report honestly on what they cost and what they returned
  • Own comms for live events and online workshops, announcement through to post-event follow-up
  • Keep the tracking honest and produce a monthly report that tells the founders what moved and why
  • Use AI properly in daily production, not as a novelty

What you need

  • You have owned marketing end to end at a small business, a startup, or directly for founders. Not a slice of a large corporate marketing department. If your best work was one channel inside a big company, this will not suit you and we would rather say so now
  • Real depth in one or two areas. SEO and content, or Meta and paid social, or email and lifecycle, or analytics and attribution. Be excellent at something
  • Numbers you can defend. Not "improved engagement". What was it before, what was it after, what did the business get, and how do you know. You will be asked to walk through a campaign in detail, including what it cost per lead and why that figure is credible
  • Technical by instinct. You pick up new tools quickly, you have built things yourself, and you use AI because you understand what it can do, not because it is fashionable
  • You deliver alone. Remote, lightly managed, off a written brief, on time
  • Experienced enough to have been there and done it. This is not a first or second marketing job

Nice to have

  • ActiveCampaign specifically, though any serious automation platform transfers
  • Event marketing
  • Podcast or video production
  • Experience marketing a B2B service to business leaders

Two things we will ask you directly

What else are you contracted to do? This is a full-time role and it has to be your only one. We ask everybody, and we ask it first.

Walk me through a campaign you ran, with the numbers. Three of them, with the starting point as well as the finish. If you cannot do that from memory, do not apply yet.

What you get

Full ownership of marketing delivery at a company selling the thing every business is currently trying to work out, with a fractional CMO who knows what he wants and tells you clearly. Full-time, permanent, UK hours, paid in rands into a South African account. Employed through Remote Recruitment, working as part of the client's team.

Equipment

Reliable laptop, stable fibre, quiet professional home working setup.

Process

A recorded screening interview with us, then a task and a final conversation with the founder and the fractional CMO. You will hear back within 24 hours of every stage.

The American Red Cross is seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and exceptionally organized Sr. Manager, Digital Content Strategy & Operations to lead digital content strategy, experience optimization, and operations across key Biomedical Services digital properties, including RedCrossBlood.org and the Blood Donor App.

This is a high-impact role for a leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution—someone who can take complex, ambiguous initiatives, synthesize information, create clarity and structure, and drive the details through completion.

A significant initial focus will be serving as the content strategy and project management lead for a major organizational website redesign and re-platform. At the same time, this leader will own the day-to-day digital content operating model for RedCrossBlood.org, the Blood Donor App, and other digital properties. They will serve as the central project manager and content strategist for digital requests, translating business objectives into compelling digital experiences and coordinating cross-functional teams through discovery, UX, content, design, SEO, accessibility, implementation, QA, and launch.

The ideal candidate is hungry for impact, highly accountable, intellectually curious, and energized by complexity. They can see the big picture while relentlessly managing the details. They know how to ask the right questions, bring structure to ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and keep work moving. They are equally comfortable developing a strategy, facilitating a working session, building a project plan, reviewing a wireframe, editing content, analyzing performance data, and working in a CMS to ensure the work is implemented correctly.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Digital Marketing.

Digital Transformation, Project & Program Management

  • Support multilingual and Spanish-language content requirements in partnership with translation partners, ensuring translated content maintains the intended user experience, accuracy, and conversion objectives.

Digital Content Strategy & Operations

  • Own the end-to-end content process across RedCrossBlood.org, the Blood Donor App, and other digital properties from discovery and requirements through content development, design, implementation, QA, launch, and ongoing optimization.
  • Develop and execute content strategies that use digital experiences to achieve measurable business objectives, including increasing blood donation appointments, engagement, and lead generation.
  • Lead promotional content across web and app, including homepage experiences, campaign placements, in-app promotions, badges, feature announcements, terms and conditions, and other high-priority content.

  • Partner with UX and design teams to develop user journeys, wireframes, page structures, component requirements, and experiences that make it easy for users to find information and take action.
  • Ensure content is structured and optimized for modern search experiences, including SEO and emerging answer-engine/AI search optimization (AEO).
  • Identify opportunities to connect web and app capabilities, including deep linking, journey optimization, personalization, and other enhancements that create a more connected digital experience.
  • Write, edit, or direct content development as needed, ensuring content is compelling, concise, user-centered, on-brand, and designed to drive action.
  • Serve as a hands-on digital content leader who can establish the strategy and ensure execution meets a high standard.

Data, Analytics & Continuous Optimization

  • Establish and monitor KPIs for digital content and experiences in partnership with marketing, analytics, engagement, and business teams.
  • Translate data and analytics into clear insights, recommendations, and prioritized actions.
  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and recurring performance reporting that provide actionable visibility into digital performance.

Accessibility, Governance & Best Practices

  • Serve as a digital content accessibility lead and liaison, partnering with appropriate teams to ensure digital content and experiences meet accessibility standards and provide an inclusive experience for all users.
  • Conduct and coordinate regular content audits, identifying opportunities to improve accessibility, usability, content quality, SEO, and overall digital experience.
  • Develop documentation, governance, workflows, templates, and operating processes that make digital content work more efficient, scalable, and consistent.

Additional duties may be assigned as the discretion of the Sr. Director, Digital Marketing.

Requirements:

  • 6-10+ years of relevant experience* in digital marketing, digital experience, content strategy, web, digital product, content operations, or related disciplines.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is architecturally strong, quality-driven, and AI-native to join our Mobile Engineering team.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is architecturally strong, quality-driven, and AI-native to join our Mobile Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own Android architecture decisions, ship polished Kotlin applications, and set the standard for how AI accelerates engineering at Xsolla.
Deep expertise in modern Android is essential: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow, and the Jetpack library surface, along with a proven track record of shipping commercial applications to Google Play from concept to launch. The ability to design scalable architectures, implement robust testing strategies, profile and optimize startup time, jank, memory, and battery across a fragmented device landscape, and mentor other engineers while collaborating across cross-functional teams will be key to your success in this role.
We build AI-first. We expect you to work fluently with AI coding agents as a daily multiplier - scoping work for them, reviewing what they produce with a critical eye, and building the internal tooling, context, and evaluation habits that make the whole team faster.
If you’re passionate about building high-quality Android experiences that scale, and love shipping apps that power gaming, virtual currency, and digital commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain our native Android application in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, used by players and developers worldwide.
  • Deliver high-quality features on time throughout the development lifecycle, from technical design through release and post-launch iteration.
  • Own the full Android release process: signing, App Bundles, Play Console tracks, staged rollouts, pre-launch reports, and crash and ANR triage.
  • Implement best practices for Android development, including code review, automated testing strategies, and CI/CD with Gradle, Fastlane, or equivalent.
  • Integrate mini-apps, payments, and virtual currency systems into the Xsolla App ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to turn business goals into experiences that feel genuinely native.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, QA engineers, and project managers, and communicate effectively across distributed, multi-timezone teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions to align development work with business objectives.

Architecture & Design

  • Design and implement scalable application architecture for Android with a focus on maintainability, performance, and developer experience.
  • Lead architectural decisions around modularization, dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger), navigation, and state management (MVVM, MVI, unidirectional data flow).
  • Configure and optimize the Gradle build, convention plugins, version catalogs, build caching, and configuration cache, for fast, incremental builds.
  • Build and maintain an internal Compose component library and design system implementation.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across the mobile development team.
  • Create technical specifications and architecture documentation for complex features and systems.
  • Partner with the iOS and React Native engineers to keep shared API contracts, design tokens, feature flags, and analytics schemas coherent across the app family, without flattening the platform into a lowest common denominator.
  • Drive observability for mobile: structured logging, crash monitoring, performance tracing, and release health dashboards.

AI-First Engineering

  • Use AI coding agents and assistants as a core part of your daily workflow, and raise the bar for how the team prompts, reviews, and verifies AI-generated code.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes agents effective in our codebase: project rules, tool integrations, reproducible dev environments, and automated checks that catch what review misses.
  • Design evaluation and guardrails for AI features, including prompt regression testing, fallback behavior, and handling of model failure modes in production.

Location: Japan
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Japan.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales
jobs.excerpt: Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.
jobs.description:
Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.

These few words shape everything we do at Packback from the smallest decision to the largest. Over the last decade since our company’s founding, our team has seen first-hand the power of giving students intentionally designed spaces in their learning experience to be autonomous and curious. We have also seen the incredible benefits of using AI technology to shorten feedback loops and help students revise their work before they submit.

Packback is a pedagogy partner that uses technology as a “means to an end” to shorten feedback loops for students and instructors, improve writing and critical thinking skills, and cultivate student-centered, trust-based educational learning environments.

Packback partners with 600+ higher education and K-12 institutions and is backed by growth equity firm PSG, with a platform proven to improve student writing confidence and cut instructor grading time by 30%.

About the role

We're looking for a VP of Sales to lead and scale Packback's sales organization as we grow our presence across higher education. This role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on leadership of the team responsible for new enterprise business — setting the overall direction for how Packback sells, structures, staffs, and compensates its sales function, while staying close enough to the field to coach Account Executives through institutional partnerships and faculty-driven adoption. You'll partner directly with the CEO and cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to set sales strategy, build the infrastructure to execute it, and expand our impact on campuses across the country. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

This is an opportunity for a senior sales leader who wants ownership over how a sales org is built, not just how it's run. You'll be accountable for revenue results, but you'll also shape org design, compensation strategy, and the long-term GTM architecture that determines how Packback scales.

Who is the ideal candidate?

  • You have experience leading enterprise sales organizations in EdTech, higher education, or another mission-driven B2B SaaS environment at the VP level or equivalent, and you've owned a sales org's structure and economics, not just its quota
  • You enjoy balancing strategy with execution — designing GTM motions and comp plans one day, joining a customer call or coaching a rep through a tough deal the next
  • You're comfortable operating as an executive partner to the CEO, translating market and pipeline data into strategy the leadership team and board can act on
  • You're motivated by building something meaningful and are excited by the opportunity to help colleges and universities improve student learning outcomes

What you'll do

  • Revenue Strategy & GTM Execution: Own the overarching sales strategy for the enterprise and B2C higher-ed business. Design and evolve go-to-market motions, organizational structure, staffing plans, and incentive structures in partnership with Finance and People to drive scalable growth.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives and front-line managers. Drive a high-performance culture through structured coaching on complex, multi-stakeholder deals—from discovery through close—and proactively recruit and onboard top sales talent. You’ll directly manage both front line managers as well as some enterprise sales representatives.
  • Sales Operations & Pipeline Management: Enforce forecast rigor and pipeline hygiene at the organizational level. Implement reliable processes, playbooks, and KPI tracking to ensure accurate forecasting and provide board-ready performance insights to the executive team.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Market Strategy: Drive deep alignment with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to optimize the end-to-end customer journey. Act as a market advocate, gathering insights from campus leaders and faculty to inform product direction and refine market narratives.

Requirements

  • 10+ years sales experience, including 3+ years leading multilayered teams (manager‑ and/or director‑level reports) in B2B SaaS or EdTech businesses
  • Demonstrated success selling complex solutions to higher education institutions or similarly complex organizations
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles while supporting higher-volume opportunities or multiple sales motions
  • Demonstrated success leading teams in account-based selling - navigate multi-stakeholder buying groups within each account, uncovering new sales opportunities and growing user adoption across the institution
  • Track record designing or redesigning quota, territory, or comp plans that improved attainment or efficiency
  • Strong coaching skills with a track record of improving individual and team performance
  • Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance metrics
  • Expert negotiator - experience navigating and negotiating MSAs, data‑privacy addenda, and multi‑year pricing frameworks
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and executive-level customers
  • Familiarity with modern sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Salesloft, or similar platforms
  • Experience with consultative sales methodologies such as Challenger, MEDDIC, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • A genuine interest in education and a desire to help institutions improve outcomes for students
  • Ability to travel up to 25-35 % for (domestic U.S.) for campus visits, conferences, and executive sponsor meetings

Additional Information:

Sponsorship: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without the need for sponsorship. Packback does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Location: Currently we are only able to hire from these states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MD, MI, NJ, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI

About the team

The HR Compliance team is part of Zillow's Employee Service & Operations (ES&O) organization. ES&O focuses on delivering scalable, reliable services that support employees and managers across the company, bringing together operational expertise, systems, and shared services that enable Zillow's people processes to run smoothly.
Within ES&O, the HR Compliance team serves as Zillow's center of expertise for HR compliance — establishing the standards, guardrails, and governance frameworks that keep people practices legally sound as the business grows. The team partners closely with the broader People organization, Legal, and other shared services to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, enabling operational teams to execute compliantly and consistently.

About the role

The Program Manager, HR Compliance is a subject matter expert responsible for helping strengthen Zillow's HR compliance program across a defined and expanding portfolio of programs.

This role supports regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, and policy governance work that allows the team to monitor and respond to changes in employment laws and regulations, identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risk, and equip HR partners with the guidance they need to operate compliantly. You will establish standards, playbooks, and controls for teams to execute against.

You Will:

  • Monitor new and emerging employment regulations across U.S. federal, state, and international jurisdictions

  • Develop and maintain a compliance register and ownership mapping, ensuring risks and obligations are documented, assigned, and tracked

  • Support international employment compliance governance across multiple jurisdictions, partnering with regional HR and People Legal on country-specific regulatory obligations

  • Maintain audit-ready compliance controls and documentation across the program portfolio; coordinate internal and external audit activity, owning documentation standards, evidence organization, and audit response coordination in partnership with People Legal

  • Support preparation and submission of statutory government reports, including mandated federal and state workforce filings

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and advisory resource for stakeholder teams on compliance requirements

  • Establish and communicate the compliance guardrails that operational teams execute against, ensuring consistent application of standards across programs

  • Support development and implementation of actionable, accessible guidance

  • Contribute to compliance education efforts, helping stakeholders understand the intent and practical application of requirements

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $90,900.00 - $145,100.00 annually. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You treat compliance as a discipline with standards, not a set of tasks to complete. You understand the regulatory intent behind requirements and can communicate it clearly to partners who don't work in this space

  • You are skilled at identifying risk before it becomes an issue, and you know how to document, escalate, and track it with rigor.

  • You draw a clear line between setting the standard and executing against it, and you hold that line in how you structure partnerships with operational teams.

  • You work confidently across jurisdictions and regulatory frameworks, and you know when a question requires legal escalation versus when you can resolve it directly.

  • You build credibility through accuracy, follow-through, and the quality of your documentation.

  • You are organized and deadline-driven, and you can manage multiple programs simultaneously without details falling through.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in HR compliance, employment law operations, or a related field with direct exposure to compliance program management

  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment laws and regulatory frameworks, including FLSA, EEO, FCRA, and related requirements

  • Experience with compliance risk identification, gap assessment, or audit coordination

  • Demonstrated ability to manage HR policy governance processes, including review cycles, version control, and legal alignment

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with a track record of managing multiple concurrent compliance programs

  • Experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting HR compliance programs in a multi-jurisdictional or global environment

Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. jobs.description:
Commercial Project Delivery Director

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT

SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience


THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR POSITION

SunStrong Management is seeking a remote Commercial Project Delivery Director. SunStrong delivers technical asset management and operations for a renewable portfolio spanning solar, battery energy storage, wind, and EV infrastructure. Project Delivery reports into Commercial Operations by design: the organization that will operate an asset for thirty years controls the standard by which it is accepted at twelve months.
The Commercial Project Delivery Director owns the execution of SunStrong's construction and capital project portfolio and the quality of every asset handed to Operations. The role is accountable for schedule, cost, safety, and — distinctively — for the long-term operability of what gets built. It carries commercial ownership of EPC relationships, gate discipline across the delivery path, and the capability of the delivery team.
Part of this will be to create protocols, reporting and other organizational processes where none currently exist. This is not a scheduling or reporting role. The Director is expected to hold a gate against schedule pressure, to refuse an incomplete turnover package, and to defend a punchlist category on the record with a contractor who would prefer it to be dropped.

COMMERCIAL PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivery Governance

  • Own the Project Delivery to Operations Protocol — maintain it, enforce it, and revise it against what each project cycle exposes.
  • Serve as decision authority at Gates 0, 2, and 6; support the VP of Commercial Operations at Gate 5 Operability Acceptance with a documented recommendation and risk position.
  • Resolve punchlist category disputes on the record; escalate to the VP any request to waive a Category A item.
  • Maintain the portfolio gate forecast and surface projected holds early enough that they are decisions rather than emergencies.
  • Establish and maintain the fleet equipment standard and the operability review checklist in partnership with Portfolio Management and Field Service.

FSP Commercial Ownership

  • Own the commercial relationship with Field Service Partners — selection, negotiation support, performance management, and escalation.
  • Direct contract abstraction and ensure Baseline Exposures are identified, owned, and mitigated before a project advances.
  • Negotiate change orders within delegated authority; prepare and defend positions above that threshold.
  • Maintain the FSP performance scorecard and translate it into award decisions, negotiated terms, and surveillance intensity on subsequent projects.
  • Pursue performance guarantee, warranty, workmanship, and latent defect claims in coordination with Legal and Asset Management before claim windows expire.

Portfolio Execution

  • Own aggregate schedule, cost, and cost-to-complete across the delivery portfolio; approve baseline changes.
  • Allocate Project Managers and Project Controls resources against project complexity, exposure, and geography.
  • Chair the weekly internal delivery standup and the monthly owner project review.
  • Own the delivery risk register and drive mitigation to closure rather than to documentation.
  • Interface with Asset Management on COD-dependent lender, tax equity, and host obligations, and Finance on capital forecasting and cash flow.

Safety and Quality

  • Establish the owner-side safety expectation for EPC and subcontractor personnel; verify that stop-work authority is real on every site.
  • Ensure incident and near-miss investigation quality meets SSM standards regardless of which party performed the work.
  • Direct the Inspection and Test Plan review process and the designation of hold and witness points across the portfolio.
  • Drive quality trending — punchlist volume normalized to MW, recurrence rate, nonconformance disposition — into contractor selection and design standards.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build and develop the Project Delivery team — hiring, leveling, development plans, and succession.
  • Establish competency standards for advancement within the Project Manager ladder and the Project Controls track.
  • Drive the working relationship between Project Delivery and Operations so that operability input arrives at design review, not at turnover.
  • Represent Project Delivery to GoodFinch, lenders, tax equity partners, and host customers.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Ten or more years in construction or project delivery within energy, utility, or infrastructure, including five or more years leading project managers.
  • Demonstrated ownership of utility-scale or distributed generation construction portfolios, with direct EPC contract administration experience.
  • Working command of EPC agreement structure — substantial and final completion, performance guarantees, liquidated damages, retainage, warranty, and change control.
  • Direct experience with commissioning, capacity and performance testing, and turnover acceptance.
  • Demonstrated ability to hold a commercial position with a contractor under schedule pressure.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Solar PV and battery energy storage delivery experience; familiarity with tracker, inverter, and BESS platform differences and their operational consequences.
  • Prior operations or asset management experience — the perspective this role is built to import into construction.
  • PMP, or PSP / CCP through AACE International.
  • Experience with acquired or in-flight construction portfolios and the transition of contractor relationships mid-project.
  • Interconnection, AHJ, and utility coordination experience across multiple jurisdictions.



Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart
  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed
  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate
  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you
  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up
  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need
  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors
  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something
  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app
  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning
  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"
  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on
  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself
  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead
  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data
  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)
  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there
  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Terminal.exe
jobs.excerpt: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.
jobs.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on.

What you get

  • A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, within Europe.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.

We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

Highlights

Build the pipelines and data model powering a live SaaS platform for container terminals worldwide.

jobs.description:
WEX is an innovative payments and technology company leading the way in a rapidly changing environment. Our goal is to simplify the business of running a business for our customers and free them to spend more time, with less worry, on the things they love. We are on a journey to build a unified, world class user experience across our products and services and leverage customer driven innovation to power our growth and strategic initiatives.

As we lean into our mission to “simplify the business of running a business”, WEX is looking to simplify and reimagine experiences, starting from the customer perspective.

As a Product Manager, Unified Platform (Health & Benefits), you will serve as the architectural connective tissue across our Health & Benefits ecosystem. Your mission is to sunset siloed legacy systems and drive the strategy for a seamless, API-first platform. You will own the execution and delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating across the business on the product roadmap with an emphasis on creating a simple, proactive and personalized experience.

About the team:
We are the architects of Wex’s forthcoming unified experience for all Health and Benefits clients. Our mission is to take the complex, siloed worlds of Benefits Administration, Consumer Directed Health (CDH), and Cobra Direct Bill (CDB), and weave them into a single, cohesive ecosystem. We are moving away from fragmented legacy systems toward a modern API-first and Micro-Frontend (MFE) architecture. We operate in a new and at times ambiguous space, tasked with defining the common data standards and seamless workflows that allow our products to feel like one experience, rather than a collection of separate tools.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the Unification Strategy: Architect the phased transition of Benefits Administration, Consumer Directed Health (CDH), and Cobra Direct Bill (CDB) from siloed legacy tools into a single, cohesive ecosystem.

  • Establish Data-Driven Foundations: Take a proactive approach to our data strategy by identifying missing metrics and designing the instrumentation needed to capture them. You will turn raw information into the insights that justify our roadmap and prove our success.

  • Synthesize Feedback into Action: Use a mix of customer interviews and gathered analytics to validate hypotheses and pivot quickly when a unification effort needs adjustment.

  • Drive Decisive Prioritization: Own the prioritization process by developing a clear point of view on product direction. You will be expected to weigh competing priorities and present a recommended path forward for alignment.

  • Orchestrate API and MFE Strategy: Partner with engineering to ensure our Micro-Frontend (MFE) strategy and backend APIs work in harmony to deliver a modular, "plug-and-play" experience for our users.

  • Standardize Core Logic: Identify and define the shared logic—such as eligibility, enrollment, and identity—that must remain consistent across every product line to ensure a seamless customer journey.

  • Multi-Squad Technical Delivery: Direct 1–3 scrum teams, balancing greenfield builds with legacy migrations while maintaining a relentless focus on feature quality and technical health.

  • Bridge Stakeholder Gaps: Act as the primary link between business leaders, UX, and engineering to ensure everyone is aligned on the unified vision and the trade-offs required to get there.

  • Leverage AI for Efficiency: Use AI tools to accelerate the discovery process, from drafting complex technical requirements, to identifying patterns in large datasets, to building prototypes of new features.

  • Identify Common Denominators: Look across different product tribes to find where we are duplicating effort and lead the charge in consolidating those into shared, scalable services.

What you’ll bring:

  • 4–6+ Years of Product Management Experience: Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-grade platform products (experience in Health, Benefits strongly preferred).

  • API & System Architecture Fluency: Strong functional grasp of how APIs and Micro-Frontends (MFEs) interact to power modular, scalable web apps.

  • Mastery of Ambiguity: Demonstrated ability to take high-level organizational goals and distill them into actionable, step-by-step engineering roadmaps.

  • Systems-Thinking Mindset: Ability to balance micro-level user workflows with macro-level platform architecture.

  • Data-Centric Approach: Comfort with data modeling and establishing single-source-of-truth architectures between disparate systems.

  • Influence & Governance: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a history of driving consensus across competing organizational priorities.

This is a senior, high-ownership role on a small team. You won't just contribute features — you'll be responsible for the design, reliability, and evolution of the platform itself. You'll have direct input into product direction and the freedom (and responsibility) to ship work that materially moves our coverage, accuracy, latency, and uptime metrics.

What You'll Own

Ranked by where your time goes:

  • Backend & API development — real-time enrichment APIs (person/org lookup, contact data, reverse search), search and filter endpoints, waterfall enrichment logic, and the credit/billing surfaces customers meter against. Match rate, latency, and freshness directly drive customer value.
  • Data engineering, ETL & search infrastructure — own the Elasticsearch/ECK stack end-to-end (index and mapping design, ingestion pipelines, relevance tuning, cluster health, scaling, migrations), plus the ETL applications that move billions of data points daily into searchable stores, Snowflake data products, and warehouse exports while holding fill rates and accuracy.
  • DevOps & platform (core owner) — you own day-to-day AWS infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and observability. This is not shared-on-the-side ops: you're responsible for infrastructure modernization, deployment pipelines, security scanning, log/metric consolidation, and the reliability of the systems you build.
  • Observability & data-quality tooling — build Grafana dashboards, load tests, and data-accuracy evals that make coverage, freshness, latency, and correctness measurable and continuously monitored across the data-quality surface.
  • Customer-facing web app (minority) — contribute to the React/TypeScript app, docs, onboarding, and self-serve surfaces when the work calls for it.

Core Responsibilities

Backend & API Development

  • Design, build, and operate RESTful APIs for enrichment, search, feeds, and platform-customer workflows.
  • Develop scalable backend services — workers, task queues, waterfall lookups, data pipelines — that keep refresh cycles predictable and fill rates high.
  • Build the metering, credit-logging, and billing logic that customers rely on for accurate consumption.
  • Participate actively in product planning; help shape which features have the highest customer impact.

Data Engineering, Search & ETL

  • Own the Elasticsearch / ECK search stack end-to-end: index design, ingestion, relevance, cluster health, scaling, and migrations.
  • Design and operate ETL applications moving data into searchable stores, bulk feeds, and warehouses (Snowflake, S3).
  • Optimize PostgreSQL — query performance, indexing, cache utilization.
  • Drive measurable improvements in latency, uptime, error rate, fill rate, and scalability.

DevOps & Infrastructure (Core Owner)

  • Own AWS infrastructure (ECS, S3, etc.) and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines.
  • Own observability — Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry — and on-call response for the surfaces you build.
  • Drive infrastructure modernization and share crawler infrastructure maintenance with the team.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Code review with high standards for readability, security, and performance.
  • Write unit, integration, and E2E tests — test reliability is a quality contributor, not overhead.
  • Document features, architecture, and API contracts; great developer docs are how our customers succeed.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems and APIs, with clear examples of strategic technical problem-solving (not just tenure).
  • Strong proficiency in Python / Django REST Framework.
  • Hands-on experience operating Elasticsearch / OpenSearch at scale — index/mapping design, query and relevance tuning, cluster management, migrations.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating ETL pipelines that move significant data volumes reliably.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and async task systems (Celery / RabbitMQ or equivalent).
  • Core-owner-level comfort with AWS (ECS, S3, CloudWatch), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent) — you're comfortable owning the platform, not just deploying to it.
  • Experience operating services in production — observability, on-call, incident response.
  • Working proficiency in React / TypeScript — comfortable shipping product UI when the work calls for it. (This is the minority of the role, not its center.)
  • Strong written communication; comfortable owning documentation as a deliverable.

AI & Agentic Workflows (Required)

This is non-negotiable. AI coding tools are core to how we build, and you're expected to operate effectively in an AI-augmented engineering environment. You must demonstrate strong, hands-on fluency with:

  • AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) used daily for implementation, refactoring, and code review — while validating all generated output before it reaches production.
  • Agentic workflows — designing, orchestrating, and debugging multi-step agent pipelines (e.g., research → plan → implement → verify loops, MCP server integration, tool-use design).
  • Judgment about where AI helps vs. hurts — knowing when to delegate to an agent, when to write the code yourself, and how to keep an agent on rails for production work.

We evaluate this in interviews with live exercises. Candidates without demonstrable agentic workflow experience will not be considered.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake or other data warehouses.
  • Background in B2B data products — enrichment, contact data, company data, search/discovery.
  • Experience with data-privacy/compliance engineering — GDPR/PII handling, US state privacy regimes.
  • Building MCP servers.
  • Experience with web crawling, data sourcing, or large-scale ingestion systems.
  • Open-source contributions or public technical writing.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay for your location — calibrated to your experience and where you're based.
  • Flexible working hours — we care about output and overlap, not clock-watching.
  • Untracked PTO — take the time off you need; there's no accrual to count.
  • Relaxed working environment — small team, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. Anyone can take an idea to production without jumping through hoops.

Job Title: Mandarin Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Position Overview:

The Mandarin Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Mandarin and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

Collaboration & Support

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You care about clean code, responsive layouts, and website performance.

    • CSS

    • WPBakery

    • WP Engine
    • SiteGround
    • Kinsta

What Success Looks Like

Interview Process

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply today and help build websites that are optimized for performance, usability, and long-term success.
