About Dentsu Creative:

Dentsu Creative is a global creative agency network designed to unlock exponential growth for clients. We use Transformative Creativity as a differentiating, driving force to bring our capabilities together to positively impact people, business and society. Established in June 2022, Dentsu Creative is integrated with Dentsu's Media and CXM businesses in over 145 countries and regions, to offer integrated Growth Solutions.

Overview:

TEMPORARY DIRECTOR, INTEGRATED STRATEGY

Reports to: EVP, Integrated Strategy

YOUR MINDSET

You have developed fluency in disciplines most people keep separate. You don't see creative strategy and media strategy as different languages. You see them as different expressions of the same brilliant strategic thinking and that fluency informs everything you do.

You believe that the best creative ideas scale, that strategic coherence matters, and that you grow by collaborating with people who think differently than you. You contribute with conviction and follow-through. You help build a culture where people understand how their work fits into something bigger and you are here for more than your role. You understand that ideas and how they reach people are equally important—not one secondary to the other.

ROLE OVERVIEW

You will develop and execute a range of integrated strategy projects for a specific brand or strategic focus area within a multi-brand consumer healthcare enterprise, translating strategic direction into inspirational insights and briefs that enable great creative and media execution come together.

This role demands fluency in two disciplines that most separate: Brand Strategy and Connected Strategy. You work from both perspectives simultaneously. You don't just translate between them, you hold them together with clear strategic thinking that helps them operate as one. You understand how strategy needs to live across earned, owned, and paid channels—including social and influencer partnerships.

You turn strategic direction into clear big ideas and briefs grounded in audience insight and media possibility. You work with creative and media teams to help them understand how their work fits together into a coherent whole and inspire both to think bigger and think together. You are the bold strategic voice in the room who helps teams see how their work connects and why that connection matters.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Development — Ideas & Brief

  • Translate strategic direction into powerful Catalyzing Ideas and briefs grounded in creative insight and contextual possibility
  • Build the strategic rationale—not just what we're doing, but why it matters and how it moves the business
  • Develop brand worlds that breathe life into ideas—articulating character, conviction, and edges with specificity
  • Help creative teams uncover the strategic insight that should drive their work. Help media teams see how that idea scales. Understand how ideas need to live in social and influencer contexts.

Strategic System Operationalization

  • Identify WHERE ideas reach the right audiences and HOW they show up in context—across paid media, owned channels, social platforms, and influencer partnerships
  • Research and surface audience signals that inform where and when strategy becomes relevant and urgent
  • Understand signal stacking—how multiple signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
  • Help teams understand how their work feeds the whole and why that connection matters

Cross-Disciplinary Alignment & Leadership

  • Work with creative, media, social, and influencer partners to ensure strategy translates consistently across all touchpoints
  • Help creative teams understand media strategy and what's possible at scale. Help media teams understand creative strategy and what ideas demand. Bridge social and influencer thinking into the broader strategic conversation.
  • Bridge creative and media conversations so both disciplines understand they're working from the same foundation
  • Think in both languages simultaneously—you are fluent in creative strategy AND media strategy, weaving them together

Stakeholder Communication & Relationship Building

  • Brief brand partners and internal stakeholders on strategy with clarity and confidence
  • Be a reliable strategic voice partners turn to when asking "how should this idea work?" or "how does this fit what we're doing?"
  • Engage with senior team to gather input and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities

Team Contribution & Development

  • Support team leadership by modeling integrated thinking
  • Mentor junior strategists, helping them understand systems thinking, not just tactical execution
  • Ask good questions that help teams think beyond their discipline
  • Contribute to creating psychological safety where people challenge siloed thinking

Measurement & Learning

  • Help monitor how strategy translates in market and gather feedback for refinement
  • Support measurement that tracks whether the system is working, using data as feedback not just reporting
  • Contribute insights on how ideas are propagating and whether signals are clustering as predicted

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Your strategic briefs are clear, actionable, and inspiring. You are a student of great work and hungry to do your best work
  • Creative and media partners use your strategy as a real tool, not just a document. They understand how the two disciplines work together
  • Teams understand the coherence in what they're building—how each piece connects to the whole. They think in systems, not just tactics
  • You've demonstrated you can develop strategy and help bring it to life in integrated ways
  • Junior strategists learn systems thinking by working with you. You are an inspiring mentor to junior talent
  • Measurement shows ideas propagating and signals clustering as predicted
  • Relationships deepen because you bring perspective that helps partners operate more strategically

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

  • 6-10 years strategy experience with demonstrated fluency in BOTH creative strategy AND media strategy
  • Proven ability to develop and communicate breakthrough strategic thinking, not just execute briefs
  • Track record working on consumer or B2C brands in complex strategic environments
  • Experience working across creative and media functions
  • Comfort engaging with senior stakeholders in strategic conversations
  • Experience with social media platforms and/or influencer partnerships a plus

Intellectual Foundation:

  • Understanding of how ideas propagate and land in culture—not just single-moment performance
  • Ability to hold multiple perspectives, audiences, and signals in mind simultaneously
  • Comfort moving between strategic thinking and tactical execution, between 30,000 feet and the work itself
  • Understanding of signal stacking—how audience signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
  • Genuine curiosity about how creative and media thinking complement and inform each other
  • Evidence that you think about systems, not just campaigns
  • Evidence that you learn from people and disciplines different from your own

Communication & Collaboration:

  • Strong communicator who can brief stakeholders with clarity
  • Ability to contribute ideas within a broader strategic framework
  • Genuine interest in how creative and media thinking complement each other
  • Collaborative spirit; you get smarter working with others

jobs.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations / Project Manager with a strong AdTech Background to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

The Business Operations / Project Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

Core Responsibilities

1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

  • Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.


2. Project Management & Visibility

  • Own and maintain internal Notion project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model.


3. Product Rollout Support

  • Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with Group Product Manager to formalize this process as a repeatable model.


4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

  • Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.


5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

  • Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for departmental initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable, and scalable systems and models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role.

Who You Are

  • The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
  • The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
  • Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
  • Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.


What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

The national offices of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.), A Corporation (“A Corp”) “PC(USA)”, based in Louisville Kentucky, serve with mid-councils, congregations, worshipping communities, and partner organizations to carry forth the mission of Jesus Christ. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a Challenge? Looking for an innovative organization and the opportunity to learn and grow professionally? We can help! We are seeking a Learning Management Systems Administrator to support the Federal Trade Commission.

I’ve never heard of Terrestris. What do you do?

At Terrestris, we leverage technology to create better mission outcomes through better human performance. We form strong client and team relationships through transparency and strive to create an environment where our team can let their excellence shine through. By finding, developing, and incorporating new ideas, we provide memorable services. Rooted in the USMC values of honor, courage, and commitment, Terrestris seeks to deliver extraordinary value to the American people by helping the Government become more efficient and effective.

So, what will the Learning Management Systems Administrator at Terrestris do?

As the Learning Management Systems Administrator, you will have primary responsibility for the functional and technical operation and enhancement and maintenance of FTC’s Learning Management Systems (LMS) eTrain2 operating on the Cornerstone platform, and the processes and standards governing its use. The LMS supports training across all mission critical areas, and you will be responsible for designing and applying appropriate workflows and business processes to ensure that required training data is captured and maintained in accordance with applicable standards and FTC business requirements. You will coordinate LMS development and operations adhering to FTC’s technology standards and processes and serve as the designated security officer (DSO) for the application.

What does a typical day look like for the Learning Management Systems Administrator?

You will be responsible for:

  • LMS Operations and Maintenance:
    • Manage day-to-day operations of the LMS, ensuring functionality, reliability, and accessibility for users.
    • Configure system settings, permissions, roles, and hierarchies to meet organizational needs.
    • Perform regular updates, patches, and upgrades to the LMS platform.
    • Primary point of contact for LMS daily operations and end-user support.
    • Maintains and monitors system performance.
    • Partner with the team, instructors, and vendors to ensure optimal use of the LMS.
    • Identify process and quality improvements, providing feedback on usage, defects, and enhancements.
    • Monitor monthly releases for upcoming system changes and deployments.
  • User Management:
    • Create, update, and deactivate user accounts as necessary.
    • Monitor and troubleshoot user access issues, ensuring timely resolution.
    • Provide guidance and technical support to end-users, instructors, and course designers.
    • Generate and analyze user activity reports to identify engagement trends or system issues.
    • Create and manage user structures including the creation of user groups and learning cohorts.
    • Manages course enrollment including progress tracking.
  • Course Management:
    • Publish and archive online or blended learning solutions, assign training curricula, and add and delete resources.
    • Manage the course asset library.
    • Populate course information and assign learners.
    • Develop and update standardized tools and reporting for ongoing access to learning information; generate standard and custom reports.
    • Analyze reporting data and recommend strategic direction to Chief Learning Officer, technical managers, or others, as appropriate.
    • Create and manage the overall course structure and set up course programs based on specifications from the instructional designer.
    • Manage tracking of course revisions and history.
    • Build online assessments and evaluations in LMS for courses.
    • Manage relationship with third party vendors and facilitate the successful linkage of courses to FTC’s LMS.
    • Assign and manage learning paths, certifications, and compliance training.
  • Troubleshooting:
    • Provide troubleshooting assistance for users regarding logging in to the LMS and accessing courses.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve issues relating to system functionality and software systems.
    • Serve as point of escalation for support issues, which may include interaction with LMS vendor and other vendor support services.
    • Work with the instructional technologist and instructional designers to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to accessing the LMS and course content.
  • Reporting and Analytics:
    • Develop and generate custom reports on user progress, course completion, and compliance.
    • Provide data insights to support organizational learning strategies.
  • Documentation and Training:
    • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and user guides for the LMS.
    • Conduct training sessions for users, administrators, and course creators on LMS functionality.
    • Document system changes, configurations, and integrations for reference.

What qualifications do you look for?

You might be the systems administrator we’re looking for if you have:

  • Certification as a Cornerstone Administrator.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Cornerstone LMS administrator working within the government sector.
  • Technical skills including troubleshooting, and understanding of directory, file structures, and systems.
  • The ability with course design and development.
  • The ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • The ability to collaborate with others at all levels of the organization as well as vendors.
  • Customer service skills and a responsive attitude.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills; ability to communicate complex technical concepts in layman’s terms.

What kind of benefits does Terrestris Offer?

We offer outstanding benefits including health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category.

Terrestris is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Join Outlive

Help Build the Operating System for Better Long-Term Health

Outlive is translating the principles of Medicine 3.0 into a practical, evidence-based product that helps people change the trajectory of their health. We focus on what matters most. Setting meaningful long-term goals, understanding the risks that can get in the way, and selecting the tactics that move the needle. Our approach is grounded in the ideas Peter Attia has spent his career developing. A deliberate practice with clear metrics and truly personalized plans that extend healthspan, not just lifespan.

We’re building a system that takes the essential pillars of long-term health and makes them actionable. Our goal is simple. Give people a structured way to understand where they are today, what levers truly matter, and how to make durable progress over time.

Why Outlive

You will shape the foundation, not optimize at the margins

We’re in the earliest stages of building something that doesn’t exist anywhere else. There are no templates. No inherited systems. The work requires people who want to solve first-principles problems and create frameworks built to last.

Science and design sit at the center of everything

We aim to convey complex ideas with clarity and precision. That means pairing rigorous scientific thinking with thoughtful, intuitive design; so users can understand why something matters and how to act on it.

AI is part of how we work

The product itself is grounded in science and behavior change. But as a team, we use AI to think, test, draft, explore, and accelerate our work. It’s a tool that enhances judgment and craftsmanship, not a replacement for either.

We care about rigor, honesty, and high standards

The team is small, driven, and aligned around a shared goal: build something that meaningfully improves long-term health. We challenge ideas respectfully, expect clear reasoning, and operate with a bias toward action. Precision matters. So does integrity.

Join our candidate pool to be considered for future openings on our team!

Role Overview

Outlive is building a mobile-first digital health platform focused on long-term risk reduction, personalized health intelligence, and sustainable behavior change. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in shaping and delivering product experiences across mobile, web, and backend services.

This role is ideal for a senior engineer who is strongest in one area (frontend or backend) but highly capable and opinionated across the stack. You’ll own features end-to-end—from user experience and data modeling to API design and deployment—while helping establish high engineering standards in a HIPAA-aware environment.

Product & Feature Development

  • Integrate frontend applications with custom authentication hooks backed by Firebase and backend identity services
  • Consume and evolve REST APIs
  • Implement analytics (PostHog), error tracking (Sentry), and accessibility best practices
  • Write and maintain frontend tests using Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, and Detox as appropriate

Backend & APIs

  • Design and implement backend services using NestJS (v11) and TypeScript
  • Build secure, well-validated REST APIs using zod, class-validator, and OpenAPI
  • Implement authentication and authorization using Google Identity JWT validation and role-based access control
  • Model relational data using Prisma and Postgres (Cloud SQL)
  • Implement async and background workflows using Google Cloud Tasks
  • Integrate with external services such as OCR, scheduling APIs, and third-party data sources
  • Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, and Sentry
  • Write unit and integration tests using Jest

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Act as a senior individual contributor, setting quality bars through code, reviews, and architectural decisions
  • Partner closely with infrastructure and DevOps engineers to ensure reliable deployments
  • Identify opportunities to simplify systems and reduce operational overhead
  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards, patterns, and best practices
  • Mentor mid-level engineers as the team grows

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong experience across frontend and backend development
  • Production experience with React (web and/or React Native)
  • Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational data modeling and ORMs
  • Strong grasp of authentication, authorization, and security fundamentals
  • Comfort working in small teams with high ownership and autonomy
  • Ability to lead or follow as the moment calls for
  • Familiarity with design patterns of distributed systems

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on experience with React Native (Expo)
  • Production experience with NestJS
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience in healthcare, wellness, or other regulated domains
  • Experience implementing offline-first or background processing features
  • Strong accessibility and UX quality sensibilities

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • Ships meaningful product features end-to-end across mobile, web, and backend
  • Improves consistency and quality across shared frontend patterns
  • Strengthens API design, validation, and error handling
  • Reduces friction between frontend and backend integration
  • Raise the overall engineering bar through thoughtful execution and mentorship
  • Measure and utilize product metrics to drive real customer value

In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling.   • Own our trust and safety transparency reporting: listings blocked, scams intercepted, buyer money protected, illegal import patterns by origin, for distribution to journalists and animal welfare stakeholders alike.

  • Mine breeder reviews, Trustpilot and support conversations for the human stories regional press actually run.

  • Become PMG's press desk, so the journalist relationship belongs to PMG rather than to an agency.

  • Brief and equip country leads and founders as spokespeople: talking points, Q&A, data appendices, prep before interviews.

  • A track record of building stories out of data rather than distributing press releases. You can spot the angle a journalist will want before they ask, and you are comfortable enough with spreadsheets and dashboards to find it yourself and sanity check a number before a reporter does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, drafting, localisation and workflow automation. You think in terms of how to leverage yourself through AI, not around it, with a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Able to operate as a team of one: briefing agencies and freelancers and holding them to account, rather than managing staff beneath you.

Preferable experience

You will thrive here if you

What we offer

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led.
jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments.

﻿What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of mirrord’s cloud integration features like queue splitting, DB branching, and more.
  • Stay hands-on and actively contribute to the codebase.
  • Work with Kubernetes, cloud services, DB systems, message brokers, and other tools and platforms.
  • Set the technical direction for the team and maintain high engineering standards.
  • Drive smart, effective use of AI across the team.
  • Help prioritize work, unblock engineers, and drive roadmap execution.
  • Hire and mentor engineers as the team grows.
  • Partner with Product, Solution Engineering and directly with users to drive adoption and expansion.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience leading engineering teams.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience writing production-grade code in Rust (most preferably), C++, or C.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.
  • Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments.
  • Comfortable working async in a remote-first, startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building developer tools.
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or other components that interact with the Kubernetes API.
  • Familiarity with backend infrastructure tooling like data stores, message brokers, GitOps tools, etc.

Why MetalBear?

  • Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of local development and cloud infrastructure.
  • Be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work directly impacts thousands of developers and some of the world’s biggest companies.
  • Work also on an open-source product used and loved by developers.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly, and low on meetings.

Who we are:

We are on a mission to become a leading supplier of critical materials that enable the green energy and technology revolution. Our materials and technologies are required for the electric vehicle, green energy, consumer electronics, and defense industries, and our battery grade lithium and tech metals are needed for chipsets, semiconductors, and 5G.

We have a substantial interest in the Round Top, Heavy Rare Earth, Lithium and Critical Minerals deposit in West Texas. We have also developed the United States’ first rare earth and critical minerals processing facility and we own the only scalable, sintered neo-magnet manufacturing system in the Western Hemisphere. By developing this fully integrated, US-based “mine-to-magnet” critical mineral supply chain, we are poised to become the leading domestic supplier to these industries.

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Orbitwell is an AI-first content workflow that turns a professional's own judgment and stories into a consistent, firm-approved public presence. The platform captures private input through conversation, audio, and dictation, drafts voice-matched content grounded in that person's real expertise, and routes every draft through configurable firm guardrails and human verification before it reaches a ready-to-publish queue. Rather than another point solution for capture, writing, or scheduling, Orbitwell is designed to be the system of record for expert-driven publishing inside professional-services firms.

The venture begins with an initial product, 30+ validation interviews, and a working prototype to accelerate iteration and go-to-market. We are now seeking a founder to lead the venture from here.

  • ~500,000+ US professional-services firms in wealth and legal alone (33,000 RIAs, 418,000–463,000 law firms), most under 10 people
  • Professional-services AUM/revenue is growing and consolidating: RIA assets under management +22.3% YoY to $176.8T; RIA M&A hit a record 322 deals in 2025, up from 272; law firm employment +1.4% in 2025
  • ​​The category proving willingness to pay for this workflow, personal/employee advocacy software, is a $0.5B–$2.2B market in 2026, growing at double-digit CAGR through the early 2030s
  • Generative AI content creation, the underlying technology wave, is a $14.8B market in 2024 projected to reach $80.1B by 2030 (32.5% CAGR)

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

jobs.description:
Run and scale the delivery engine behind a growing technical professional-services and software company. You will lead a roughly 40-person organization, influence the performance of most company revenue, and partner directly with the CEO on strategy, growth, and acquisition integration. It is a high-impact operating role with a credible path toward broader COO-level responsibility as the business grows.

This confidential company serves public-sector clients nationwide and is expanding organically and through acquisition. It needs a hands-on leader who can bring financial discipline, clear accountability, and a scalable operating cadence without burying a fast-moving, relationship-driven business in bureaucracy.

This is not a back-office role or another layer of project management. You will lead through leaders, own delivery performance, and make the staffing and commercial calls required to improve utilization, contract achievement, quality, and margin. There is no billable target; your capacity is reserved for running the organization.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the CEO and serving on the senior leadership team, you will lead the Delivery/PMO leader and technical Capability Leads across approximately 40 consultants, project managers, and specialists. Because consulting revenue flows through billable delivery, your organization influences roughly 70% of company revenue.

You will own the delivery operating system: capacity, staffing, utilization, hours billed, budgets, contract achievement, scope discipline, quality, escalations, and portfolio margin. You will also help shape company strategy—pricing, staffing mix, investment and cost decisions, annual operating goals, new-business growth, net dollar retention, recurring-revenue mix, and the productization of repeatable offerings.

As future businesses are acquired, you will lead operational integration across systems, staffing, standards, and delivery practices. Broader COO-level scope is a real possibility, although there is no fixed timetable; expanded responsibility will follow demonstrated performance and business need.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and develop the Delivery/PMO leader and Capability Leads through clear goals, 1:1s, performance conversations, and real accountability.
  • Build a trusted cadence for staffing, capacity, delivery reviews, escalations, resource allocation, and portfolio performance.
  • Create visibility into where delivery makes or loses money by project, capability, and person—and act on the findings.
  • Improve utilization, hours billed, budget and contract achievement, scope discipline, quality, and gross margin.
  • Review scopes, budgets, schedules, staffing assumptions, pricing, and complex pursuits before commitments become delivery problems.
  • Make final allocation, people, budget, and scope calls when issues cannot be resolved at the leadership level.
  • Replace recurring workarounds and individual heroics with repeatable practices that scale with revenue and headcount.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for significant accounts and bring senior operating judgment to client, CEO, and business-development conversations.
  • Lead the delivery-side integration of future acquisitions.

What Success Looks Like

  • First quarter: establish command of delivery economics by project, capability, and person; put a working operating cadence in place; and clarify decision rights.
  • Year one: leaders own outcomes at the right level, staffing and capacity reviews run on a rhythm the organization trusts, utilization and margin move for understood reasons, project performance is more visible, and fewer issues require CEO intervention.

What You Bring

You may come from professional services, consulting, managed services, systems integration, cloud or IT services, engineering or architecture services, software-connected services, military leadership, or another project-based operating environment. GIS experience is not required. The exact industry matters less than your ability to lead accountable teams, understand delivery economics, and build operating discipline in a growing company.

Strong candidates typically bring:

  • Substantial operating and leadership experience—often 7+ years—with accountability for teams, leaders, delivery quality, staffing, client outcomes, and financial results.
  • Commercial fluency in utilization, capacity, hours billed, project budgets, scopes, contracts, pricing, gross margin, and staffing tradeoffs.
  • Evidence of building, fixing, scaling, or materially improving a real operating environment with measurable results.
  • Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to make clear decisions with incomplete information.
  • The EQ to earn trust before driving hard changes, plus the ownership mindset to stay hands-on while building systems that reduce fire drills.
  • Credibility with technical professionals and senior clients without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room.
  • Learning speed, curiosity, and comfort exploring how automation and AI may improve services economics.

Pure strategy experience without hands-on operating ownership is unlikely to be enough.

Helpful Experience

  • Project-based services contracts, scopes, budgets, pricing, and delivery economics.
  • Scaling or restructuring a services organization.
  • M&A integration.
  • Professional-services automation, PSA, resource-management, ERP, or delivery-operations platforms.
  • Public-sector contracting, GIS/geospatial, or technical consulting.
  • MBA or comparable graduate business training.

A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience is expected; field of study is not a screen.

Compensation and Logistics

  • Base salary: $170,000–$200,000 annually.
  • Performance opportunity: an annual incentive may be offered, with a potential target of approximately $25,000. Terms are not guaranteed and will be confirmed during the offer process.
  • Long-term upside: equity or broader profit participation may become available as scope grows; it is not guaranteed on day one.
  • Benefits: health coverage and a retirement-plan match.
  • Location: remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates in the greater Chicago area.
  • Travel: limited travel as needed, especially early in the role.
  • Status: full-time, exempt.

Hiring Process

This is a confidential search moving with urgency. The process is expected to include an initial screening conversation, a case exercise, a deeper behavioral interview, and a final onsite meeting before offer.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led.
jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments.

﻿What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of mirrord’s cloud integration features like queue splitting, DB branching, and more.
  • Stay hands-on and actively contribute to the codebase.
  • Work with Kubernetes, cloud services, DB systems, message brokers, and other tools and platforms.
  • Set the technical direction for the team and maintain high engineering standards.
  • Drive smart, effective use of AI across the team.
  • Help prioritize work, unblock engineers, and drive roadmap execution.
  • Hire and mentor engineers as the team grows.
  • Partner with Product, Solution Engineering and directly with users to drive adoption and expansion.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience leading engineering teams.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience writing production-grade code in Rust (most preferably), C++, or C.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.
  • Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments.
  • Comfortable working async in a remote-first, startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building developer tools.
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or other components that interact with the Kubernetes API.
  • Familiarity with backend infrastructure tooling like data stores, message brokers, GitOps tools, etc.

Why MetalBear?

  • Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of local development and cloud infrastructure.
  • Be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work directly impacts thousands of developers and some of the world’s biggest companies.
  • Work also on an open-source product used and loved by developers.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly, and low on meetings.
  • Competitive salary, stock options, and a culture that respects your time.

Why Join Us?

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches and develops market-leading pet and equestrian marketplaces globally. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and some of our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we are on a mission to transform this process by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through innovative technology. We are a driven and ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by top-tier investors such as Verdane. As a company, we have been profitable since our first year, meaning we do not rely on investor capital for our growth.

The opportunity

This is our first dedicated PR hire and it covers the whole group. Over the years, PMG has managed to reduce animal welfare issues on our platforms far below any peer, through ID verification of breeders, AI-assisted moderation of adverts, a zero-tolerance approach to illegal puppy imports and unlicensed high-volume breeding, and by going far beyond what the law requires. Your job is to tell the world about it.

We know the playbook works because we have already done it once. In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling. You bring an AI-forward mindset, the instinct to ask how can I leverage myself through AI, and you use it daily for data analysis, drafting, localising, and getting a story out across markets, so covering seven markets does not mean seven times the work.

What you will do

jobs.excerpt: Commercial Project Controls & Coordination ManagerBRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENTSunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios.
jobs.description:
Commercial Project Controls & Coordination Manager

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT

SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience


THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT CONTROLS & COORDINATION MANAGER

SunStrong Management is seeking a remote Commercial Project Controls & Coordination Manager. SunStrong delivers technical asset management and operations for a renewable portfolio spanning solar, battery energy storage, wind, and EV infrastructure. Project Delivery reports into Commercial Operations by design: the organization that will operate an asset for thirty years controls the standard by which it is accepted at twelve months.
The Manager of Project Controls & Coordination owns the integrity of the information the delivery organization runs on — schedule, cost, change, contract terms — and the operating discipline of the registers that trace every commitment and every open item to closure. The role is the reason a gate decision can be made on evidence rather than on a contractor's summary.
The role deliberately combines two distinct bodies of work: an analytical function that independently baselines, recalculates, and reports variance, and a coordination function that maintains the registers, the document vault, and the meeting and reporting cadence. This is a single role by design at current portfolio scale, with a defined trigger for splitting it. The candidate profile is analytical first — coordination discipline can be taught to an analyst; analytical judgment cannot be taught to a coordinator.COMMERCIAL PROJECT CONTROLS & COORDINATION MANAGER RESPONSIBILITIES

Analytical — Schedule Control

  • Establish and maintain the integrated project schedule baseline; control all baseline changes through a documented change process.
  • Review EPC-submitted schedules for logic integrity — open ends, constraints, negative float, excessive lags, and critical path credibility. A schedule accepted without interrogation is a schedule written for the contractor.
  • Maintain the portfolio milestone and gate forecast; identify projected slip against COD, lender, tax equity, and host commitments early enough that it is a decision rather than an emergency.
  • Perform schedule variance and trend analysis; distinguish recoverable slip from structural slip and state which is which.
  • Verify that three-week lookaheads reconcile to the master schedule rather than describing a parallel reality.

Analytical — Cost Control

  • Own the project cost baseline, commitment tracking, actual cost capture, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Maintain earned value methodology across the portfolio; report SPI, CPI, and forecast at completion with a stated basis.
  • Review EPC payment applications against verified physical progress, milestone achievement, and retainage terms before release.
  • Maintain the retainage and punchlist hold register, including SSM independent cost estimates supporting Category B and C holds.
  • Support capital forecasting and cash flow projection with Finance and Asset Management.

Analytical — Change Control

  • Own the change order log from request through disposition, with schedule and cost impact independently assessed rather than accepted as submitted.
  • Analyze each change against the contracted scope to determine whether it is genuine added scope, a scope gap the EPC should have caught, or a contractor estimating error.
  • Track cumulative change against delegated authority thresholds and flag approaching limits before they are exceeded.
  • Maintain change trend analysis by contractor as a direct input to the EPC performance scorecard.

Analytical — Contract Abstraction

  • Abstract every EPC agreement into the standard term register within fifteen business days of intake — completion definitions, performance guarantees, testing methodology, liquidated damages, retainage, warranty, notice requirements, and change authority.
  • Identify and log Baseline Exposures where the contract as written falls short of the SSM acceptance standard; assign owners and track mitigation.
  • Maintain the warranty register with expiration tracking and claim window alerting. A claim window that closes unnoticed is a direct loss and is treated as one.
  • Maintain the delivery risk register with quantified exposure and mitigation status.

Coordination — Registers and Document Control

  • Own the punchlist register system — structure, field standards, data integrity, aging reporting, and completeness of closure evidence across all projects.
  • Maintain register hygiene: no orphaned IDs, no renumbering, no items closed without a verifier and an evidence reference.
  • Drive aging follow-up across punchlist, RFI, submittal, and nonconformance logs; escalate items breaching aging thresholds rather than reporting them indefinitely.
  • Own the project document vault — filing standard, naming convention, version control, access control.
  • Maintain the equipment register — serial numbers, network addresses, warranty start dates — as construction data lands.

Coordination — Cadence and Reporting Production

  • Produce the monthly owner project review package and the weekly gate and variance reporting.
  • Coordinate the weekly internal delivery standup and the monthly owner project review — agenda, materials, actions, and action closure.
  • Track action items from all delivery forums to closure with named owners and dates.
  • Support lender, tax equity, and host milestone certification with defensible documentation.

Systems and Data Standards

  • Define and enforce data standards — naming conventions, site codes, equipment tags, WBS structure — so that delivery data reconciles to operations data after turnover rather than requiring a manual crosswalk.
  • Build and maintain reporting tooling and dashboards that surface exceptions rather than requiring the reader to hunt for them.
  • Automate recurring coordination tasks. Every hour automated is an hour returned to analysis.
  • Build durable tooling within the constraints of the actual environment, including SharePoint limitations, rather than solutions that depend on software SSM does not have.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Five or more years in project controls, cost engineering, or scheduling within construction, energy, or infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ownership of schedule baselines and earned value reporting on capital projects.
  • Working command of EPC contract commercial terms and their controls implications — milestone payment, retainage, liquidated damages, and change authority.
  • Advanced Excel; scheduling software proficiency (Primavera P6 or MS Project).
  • Demonstrated ability to report an unfavorable variance accurately to the person whose project it is.
  • Willingness to perform coordination and document control work personally at current scale. This role builds the function before it supervises one.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, finance, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.



Preferred Qualifications
  • Solar PV or BESS construction controls experience.
  • AACE International certification — PSP, CCP, or EVP.
  • Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, or Python for reporting automation.
  • Experience building durable tooling inside SharePoint-constrained environments.
  • Experience standing up a controls function rather than inheriting one.

.
Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

26WD98795 Senior Software Developer (Web) (Remote)

Position Overview
Virtual and augmented reality are transforming design and creation through new immersive and collaborative experiences that will impact how major segments like entertainment, architecture, developer, construction, and manufacturing converge. The industry is being transformed by innovations in Extended Reality (XR) and AI which are creating new ways of leveraging spatial computing to review, collaborate and create in immersive, collaborative environments. As a Senior Software Developer (Web), you will be part of the team responsible for building and delivering a collaborative XR platform within the Interactive Graphics Solution org. In this role, you will partner closely with UX Designers to build products and services that enhance our customer’s spatial understanding through our industry leading Autodesk Platform technologies. If you have a passion for creating modern, beautiful, and high-performance web frontends and share our passion for XR, join us as we redefine how we work and collaborate with each other in a new reality.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain frontend applications (JavaScript, React, TypeScript) alongside backend services (Golang, AWS)

  • Build and optimize beautifully rendered, web-based components that push performance limits across XR Headsets

  • Lead large, complex projects across teams, defining scope, planning execution, and delivering milestones on time

  • Collaborate with architects, UX designers, product managers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into product features

  • Help shape system design and architecture across cloud and web environments, improving scalability, performance and feel across immersive and 2D environments

  • Lead technical discussions, align outcomes with business goals, and document solutions for clarity and adoption

  • Stay ahead of emerging trends to anticipate and address future development needs

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in software design and development with emphasis on Frontend development

  • Deep, hands-on experience developing complex, performance-sensitive web applications in JavaScript (ES6+) with working knowledge of React and Typescript

  • Strong grasp of browser performance profiling, rendering bottlenecks, and limitations of the DOM and JavaScript engines

  • Experience building applications with CPU constraints that push browser limits

  • Experience with real-time communication technologies like WebSockets, Microsoft Fluid and supporting data formats (JSON, Protobuf)

  • Demonstrated excellence in cross-functional collaboration, with experience working across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders

  • Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, distributed systems, and browser event loops and rendering pipelines

  • Experience with Electron

  • Comfortable with AWS, specifically services like S3

  • Git, Github knowledge

  • Experience in an agile development environment

  • Good problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS Degree in Computer Science or similar technical field

  • Experience with 3D and immersive web technologies like ThreeJS or WebXR

  • Proven experience with AWS cloud services and designing resilient, scalable cloud-native architecture. Full stack experience (Backend + Frontend) is a bonus

  • Experience with Databases (SQL and noSQL)

  • Experience with containerization (Docker)

  • Basic game engine experience (Unreal Engine preferred)

  • Basic experience with AR, VR and MR

  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, Spinnaker) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)

  • Experience with observability tools for monitoring, logging, and tracing in distributed systems (e.g., Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk)

The Ideal Candidate

  • Result Oriented: You finish the job, and you do it fast

  • Continuous Learner: You actively explore emerging technologies, measure its impact, and share insights widely

  • Build Trust: You communicate with clarity and transparency, surface risks and trade-offs early, and follow through with high quality deliverables

  • Team Player: You build a collaborative environment by fostering inclusive dialogue, actively seeking diverse perspectives, and celebrate collective achievements

26WD98795 Développeur logiciel senior (Web) (Télétravail)

Aperçu du Poste

La réalité virtuelle et la réalité augmentée transforment la conception et la création grâce à de nouvelles expériences immersives et collaboratives qui auront un impact sur la convergence de secteurs majeurs tels que le divertissement, l’architecture, le développement immobilier, la construction et la fabrication. L’industrie est en pleine mutation sous l’effet des innovations en matière de réalité étendue (XR) et d’intelligence artificielle (IA), qui ouvrent de nouvelles voies pour tirer parti de l’informatique spatiale afin d’examiner, de collaborer et de créer dans des environnements immersifs et collaboratifs. En tant que développeur logiciel senior (Web), vous ferez partie de l’équipe chargée de concevoir et de déployer une plateforme XR collaborative au sein de l’organisation Interactive Graphics Solution. À ce titre, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs UX afin de créer des produits et des services qui améliorent la compréhension spatiale de nos clients grâce aux technologies de pointe de la plateforme Autodesk. Si vous êtes passionné par la création d’interfaces Web modernes, esthétiques et hautement performantes, et que vous partagez notre passion pour la XR, joignez-vous à nous pour redéfinir notre façon de travailler et de collaborer les uns avec les autres dans une nouvelle réalité.

Responsabilités

  • Concevoir, développer et assurer la maintenance d’applications front-end (JavaScript, React, TypeScript) en collaboration avec les services back-end (Golang, AWS)

  • Créer et optimiser des composants Web au rendu soigné qui repoussent les limites de performance sur les casques de réalité étendue (XR)

  • Diriger des projets complexes et de grande envergure impliquant plusieurs équipes, en définissant la portée, en planifiant l’exécution et en respectant les échéances

  • Collaborer avec les architectes, les concepteurs UX, les gestionnaires de produit et les parties prenantes pour traduire les exigences d’affaires en fonctionnalités de produit

  • Contribuer à façonner la conception et l’architecture du système dans les environnements nuage et Web, en améliorant l’évolutivité, la performance et l’expérience utilisateur dans les environnements immersifs et 2D

  • Mener des discussions techniques, aligner les résultats sur les objectifs d’affaires et documenter les solutions pour plus de clarté et faciliter leur adoption

  • Rester à l’affût des tendances émergentes afin d’anticiper et de répondre aux besoins futurs en matière de développement

Qualifications Minimales

  • Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience pratique en conception et développement de logiciels, avec un accent particulier sur le développement front-end

  • Expérience approfondie et pratique du développement d’applications Web complexes et sensibles aux performances en JavaScript (ES6+), avec une connaissance pratique de React et de TypeScript

  • Maîtrise solide du profilage des performances des navigateurs, des goulots d’étranglement de rendu, ainsi que des limites du DOM et des moteurs JavaScript

  • Expérience dans la création d’applications soumises à des contraintes de CPU qui repoussent les limites des navigateurs

  • Expérience avec les technologies de communication en temps réel telles que WebSockets, Microsoft Fluid et les formats de données associés (JSON, Protobuf)

  • Excellence avérée en matière de collaboration interfonctionnelle, avec une expérience de travail au sein de multiples équipes d’ingénierie et auprès de diverses parties prenantes

  • Solide compréhension des algorithmes, des structures de données, de la concurrence, des systèmes distribués, ainsi que des boucles d’événements et des pipelines de rendu des navigateurs

  • Expérience avec Electron

  • Aisance avec AWS, en particulier avec des services comme S3

  • Connaissances de Git et de GitHub

  • Expérience dans un environnement de développement agile

  • Bonnes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en communication

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Maîtrise en informatique ou dans un domaine technique similaire

  • Expérience avec les technologies Web 3D et immersives telles que ThreeJS ou WebXR

  • Expérience avérée avec les services cloud AWS et la conception d’architectures cloud natives résilientes et évolutives. Une expérience full-stack (back-end + front-end) est un atout

  • Expérience avec les bases de données (SQL et NoSQL)

  • Expérience avec la conteneurisation (Docker)

  • Expérience de base avec les moteurs de jeu (Unreal Engine de préférence)

  • Expérience de base en RA, RV et RM

  • Maîtrise des outils et pratiques de CI/CD (p. ex., Jenkins, Spinnaker) et de l’infrastructure en tant que code (p. ex., Terraform)

  • Expérience avec les outils d’observabilité pour la surveillance, la journalisation et le traçage dans les systèmes distribués (p. ex., Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk)

Le candidat Idéal

  • Axé sur les résultats : vous menez les projets à terme, et vous le faites rapidement

  • En apprentissage continu : vous explorez activement les technologies émergentes, mesurez leur impact et partagez largement vos connaissances

  • Instaurer la confiance : vous communiquez avec clarté et transparence, soulevez les risques et les compromis dès le début, et livrez des résultats de grande qualité

  • Esprit d’équipe : vous créez un environnement collaboratif en favorisant un dialogue inclusif, en recherchant activement des perspectives diverses et en célébrant les réalisations collectives

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role:The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross-referencing, and stress-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.

The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.

They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.

In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

CFWA Relationship Management — CVS

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day-to-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.

  • Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.

  • Lead recurring CFWA governance touchpoints (e.g., joint operating and workgroup meetings), setting agendas, tracking action items, and driving issues to closure.

  • Review CVS-provided FWA reporting, investigative summaries, audit results, and recovery activity for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with source claims data; challenge findings that are not supported by the data.

  • Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.

  • Track pharmacy-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

Data Validation & Source Reconciliation

  • Validate, reconcile, and cross-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.

  • Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.

  • Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.

  • Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

AI-Assisted Detection & Validation

  • Use AI- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high-priority cases for review.

  • Validate AI-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.

  • Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.

  • Stay current on emerging AI-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers & Red Flags

  • Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.

  • Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.

  • Investigate referrals and self-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

Case Referrals

  • Conduct thorough data validation into suspected fraudulent activity, documenting methodology, findings, and conclusions.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready case records in the case management system.

  • Prepare clear written summaries and present findings to leadership, business partners, legal, and, when appropriate, law enforcement or regulatory bodies.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner with claims, payment integrity, underwriting, compliance, legal, and data teams — as well as pharmacy operations and clinical and pharmacy services — to share intelligence and strengthen controls.

  • Work and collaborate with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

  • Mentor junior analysts on data validation techniques, investigative methodology, and red-flag recognition.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of SIU processes, tools, and detection capabilities.

Required skills and experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Finance, Data Analytics, Health Administration, Pharmacy, Business, or a related field — or equivalent investigative experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud investigation, financial crime, pharmacy benefit or claims analysis, or a closely related field, ideally within an SIU or comparable environment.

  • Demonstrated experience with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including familiarity with NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber/pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license).

  • Demonstrated experience validating and reconciling data across multiple, disparate systems and sources.

  • Experience managing or supporting a vendor, PBM, or delegated-entity relationship, including referral coordination, reporting review, and performance follow-up.

  • Strong working knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and common fraud schemes, and of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy FWA.

  • Hands-on experience using analytical, detection, or case management tools, including AI/ML-assisted detection platforms.

  • Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with a naturally inquisitive and skeptical approach.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly and concisely.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Professional certification such as CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CFCS, AFE, AHFI, CPhT, or equivalent.

  • Direct experience with CVS/Caremark data, reporting, or FWA processes.

  • Experience with controlled substance monitoring, opioid overutilization programs, or PDMP data.

  • Experience working with data visualization tools, or analytical querying of large data sets.

Salary range: $73,000 - $130,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package.
