Market Access & Technology Solutions

ROLE SUMMARY This principal-level leader manages people and independently leads complex, client-facing revenue management and system integration engagements. The role combines full-suite Model N expertise, deep knowledge in one or more market access domains, disciplined program delivery, IRA experience, and active support of business development and practice growth.

Position Focus

  • Lead and develop a team of functional and technical resources while maintaining accountability for delivery quality, utilization, and client outcomes.
  • Own end-to-end implementations, enhancements, integrations, and transformation programs across the revenue management landscape, with deep experience across the revenue management full suite applications.
  • Provide subject matter leadership in one or more areas: Commercial Contracting, Managed Care, Government Pricing, Medicaid, Technical Architecture/Integration, or Automation.
  • Operate independently as the engagement lead, establishing the delivery structure, governance, communications, and controls required to execute successfully.
  • Help expand the practice through business development support and relationship building techniques.

Core Responsibilities

1. People Leadership & Practice Management

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of resources across functional, technical, and project delivery disciplines.
  • Establish clear expectations, provide actionable feedback, support career development, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Plan staffing and team charter based on project scope, required capabilities, client needs, and delivery risk.
  • Set and reinforce standards for project management, documentation, testing, quality assurance, and client communication.
  • Contribute to recruiting, onboarding, capability development, reusable assets, and practice operations.

2. Client Engagement & Program Leadership

  • Independently lead complex, multi-workstream client engagements from discovery and planning through design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and transition to support.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery leader, building trusted relationships with senior business, technology, finance, and operations stakeholders.
  • Develop and manage integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, budgets, resource plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate delivery across client teams, software vendors, system integrators, data providers, and other third parties, with clear ownership and escalation paths.
  • Create and execute governance models, status reporting, steering committee materials, communication plans, and change management plans.
  • Maintain accountability for scope, quality, schedule, financial performance, and client satisfaction.

3. Revenue Management

  • Provide functional and technical leadership across the pharmaceutical revenue management ecosystem, including integrations with ERP, data platforms, chargeback, rebate, pricing, membership, and financial systems.
  • Apply hands-on experience to guide solution architecture, configuration, integration, data conversion, testing, deployment, and operational readiness.
  • Assess current-state processes and systems, define future-state operating models, and translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
  • Lead design decisions across master data, transaction flows, calculation logic, interfaces, controls, reporting, and reconciliation.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve data quality, and automate manual activities.

4. Functional & Technical Subject Matter Expertise

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in at least one of the following domains, with the ability to connect business requirements to system and data implications: Commercial Contracting; Managed Care; Government Pricing; Medicaid; technical architecture and integrations; or automation.
  • Partner effectively with cross-functional teams including Market Access, Contract Operations, Government Pricing, Medicaid, Finance, IT, Data, Legal, Compliance, and Quality Assurance.
  • Translate complex business and regulatory requirements into practical processes, system requirements, controls, and implementation plans.
  • Guide the development of interfaces, data pipelines, workflow automation, reporting, validation rules, and operational controls.

5. SDLC, Quality & Operational Readiness

  • Apply strong software development life cycle experience across requirements, design, build, unit testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, deployment, and hypercare.
  • Define delivery standards and ensure traceability across requirements, configurations, technical specifications, test scenarios, defects, and release decisions.
  • Lead testing strategy, defect governance, data reconciliation, cutover planning, go-live readiness, and post-production stabilization.
  • Ensure solutions are supported by clear documentation, SOPs, runbooks, training materials, support models, and transition plans.
  • Promote repeatable delivery methods, accelerators, templates, and automation that improve efficiency and reduce implementation risk.

6. IRA & Regulatory Transformation

  • Advise clients on system, data, process, and operational impacts associated with the Inflation Reduction Act, including Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program and Maximum Fair Price implementation considerations.
  • Translate IRA requirements into cross-functional workplans, solution requirements, integration needs, controls, testing strategies, and readiness activities.
  • Coordinate stakeholders and vendors to address dependencies across pricing, contracting, claims, payment, data, reporting, and financial processes.
  • Monitor evolving requirements and help clients assess impacts to operating models, technology roadmaps, and compliance readiness.

7. Business Development & Market Growth

  • Support account and practice leadership in identifying, shaping, and advancing new opportunities.
  • Contribute to or lead RFP responses, solution strategies, statements of work, delivery approaches, staffing models, estimates, pricing inputs, and executive presentations.
  • Participate in client workshops, capabilities presentations, demonstrations, and proposal orals.
  • Help develop market-facing offerings, thought leadership, case studies, reusable assets, and alliance relationships.
  • Identify follow-on opportunities within active engagements and connect client needs to broader practice capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing teams and leading complex client-facing engagements independently.
  • Deep revenue management experience and hands-on expertise with the Model N full suite across implementation, enhancement, integration, or transformation programs.
  • Advanced expertise in one or more of the following: Commercial Contracting, Managed Care, Government Pricing, Medicaid, technical architecture/integration, or automation.
  • Proven ability to create and manage project timelines, integrated project plans, governance structures, communication plans, change management plans, and cross-vendor delivery models.
  • Strong SDLC experience, including requirements, design, build, SIT, UAT, cutover, deployment, and stabilization.
  • Experience addressing Inflation Reduction Act impacts, including operational or technology readiness for MFP-related processes.
  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting business development through proposals, statements of work, estimates, solutioning, and client presentations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating Model N with SAP, Oracle, data lakes, data warehouses, claims platforms, chargeback systems, contract platforms, or other revenue management technologies.
  • Experience with data conversion, reconciliation, master data, system controls, and audit-ready documentation.
  • PMP, Agile, Scrum, change management, Model N, cloud, or related certifications.
  • Experience leading distributed teams and coordinating multiple vendors across time zones.

Leadership Profile

Accountable leader

  • Owns outcomes, makes timely decisions, escalates early, and follows through on commitments.

Trusted advisor

  • Connects client objectives, market access operations, technology, data, and regulatory requirements.

Structured operator

  • Creates clarity through plans, governance, controls, communication, and disciplined execution.

People developer

  • Builds capability, delegates effectively, coaches teams, and maintains high standards.

Growth oriented

  • Recognizes client needs, shapes practical solutions, and contributes to winning work.

Working Environment

  • Periodic travel may be required for client workshops, key project milestones, and industry events.
  • Role may support multiple client engagements and business development priorities based on practice needs.

Labcorp Oncology is seeking a Director, Medical Affairs - Oncology and Hematologic Malignancies to join our team!

Job Summary:

The Director, Medical Affairs - Oncology & Hematologic Malignancies serves as a physician leader within Labcorp Oncology on the medical affairs team, providing clinical and scientific expertise across hematologic malignancies and broader oncology diagnostics. This role serves as a key medical representative for the organization, engaging with healthcare providers, academic leaders, payers, professional societies, and other stakeholders to advance the understanding and adoption of evidence-based diagnostic strategies.

The Director partners closely with cross-functional teams to support scientific exchange, medical education, market access initiatives, evidence generation, and customer engagement activities. This individual maintains expertise in evolving oncology practice standards and represents Labcorp Oncology at major scientific meetings, customer engagements, and industry forums.

Job Responsibilities:

Medical affairs leadership and external engagement

  • Serve as a medical expert and ambassador for Labcorp Oncology across hematologic malignancies, precision oncology, and related diagnostic services.
  • Build and maintain scientific relationships with community oncologists, hematologists, academic investigators, key opinion leaders, and professional societies.

Medical education and scientific communication

Market access and cross-functional partnership

Research and evidence generation

  • Support development of clinical research initiatives, real-world evidence programs, publications, abstracts, and scientific presentations.

  • Contribute to scientific communication strategies highlighting the clinical value of Labcorp Oncology's diagnostic portfolio.

  • 7 or more years of combined clinical practice, academic medicine, diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, laboratory medicine, or medical affairs experience following fellowship training.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of medical affairs experience within diagnostics, precision medicine, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or laboratory services organizations.
  • 3 or more years of experience with molecular diagnostics, genomic profiling, biomarker testing, or precision oncology.

  • Ability to engage effectively with healthcare providers, payers, key opinion leaders, and other stakeholders.

Job Description:

Job Title - Risk Lead

Location - Remote

Type - Full-Time

About the company

Velonetic represents the joint ventures between DXC Technology, the International Underwriting Association (IUA), and Lloyd’s of London. Previously referred to as the London Market Joint Ventures, we have been operating for over 20 years in the London market (Lloyd's and Company), in both insurance and reinsurance business. Processing over £101 billion worth of premium and claims transactions today, we are building a new digital platform and services that will enable our customers to move transactions and money through the processing lifecycle with greater efficiency and speed, releasing time to drive innovation and focus on higher value activities.

About the job

The Risk Lead will be a part of the second line of defence risk team and will be responsible for managing Enterprise risks (Finance, Operations, Sales, Supply chain, Digital transformation etc).

The role involves providing risk oversight and guidance to the business and ensuring compliance with the organisation's risk management framework.

The successful candidate will have a strong background in enterprise risk management and relevant controls.

There is room to grow within the team and within the wider DXC company. The candidate ideally also has experience in the insurance industry, but other financial services related, or Digital, Data, Technology related services are also desired.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads comprehensive assessments of enterprise‑level risks and provides clear, actionable recommendations to support informed decision‑making across the business.
  • Monitors, analyses, and reports on risk exposures, ensuring timely escalation of significant issues to senior management.
  • Maintains and updates the enterprise risk register, ensuring risks are accurately documented, assessed, and actively managed.
  • Drafts effective controls and conducts control testing to assess design and operating effectiveness.
  • Maintains and enhances the enterprise risk management framework to ensure consistency, alignment, and compliance across the organisation.
  • Leads and supports the rollout and integration of new risk management systems, driving adoption and embedding improved processes.
  • Supports the Head of Risk in preparing risk reports, dashboards, and presentations for executive committees and board‑level audiences.
  • Advises business units on risk management best practice, enabling sound operational and strategic decisions.
  • Tracks emerging risks and develops proactive strategies to address evolving threats.
  • Builds trusted relationships with business teams, acting as a key partner on all risk matters.
  • Provides direction and support to team members, fostering capability growth and high‑quality delivery.

Qualifications:

  • Holds a relevant bachelor’s degree and/or Risk Management certification, with experience in ECCTA and fraud risk.
  • Works effectively with others while confidently delivering autonomously when required.
  • Demonstrates strong planning, prioritisation, and attention to detail to ensure high‑quality outcomes.
  • Produces well‑structured reports, policies, and process documents, supported by excellent verbal and presentation skills.
  • Applies strong problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills to assess issues and propose effective solutions.
  • Adopts a can‑do mindset, adapts to changing priorities, and actively contributes ideas and improvements.
  • Proactively develops knowledge and skills, adding value through ongoing learning and initiative.

Investment In Training and Development

We offer a comprehensive range of training and career development opportunities, a structured induction programme, tailored job training as well as mentoring and support for relevant sponsored professional qualifications. We’re developing an environment where people can grow and harness their careers and skills to be the best that they can be to focus on the long term.

Our Culture

Here at Velonetic, we support with care and compassion. We are constantly evolving our initiatives around equality, diversity, and inclusion to ensure that everyone feels equally involved and supported in the workplace no matter of who they are or what they do. We are proud of the culture we are creating to ensure that our commitment is ongoing and have a diverse mix of employees working within an inclusive environment and culture to create a high performing workforce led by talented leaders. We aspire to be recognised for our innovative and modern thinking approach.

Employee Benefits

As part of our competitive remuneration package, flexible benefits are available. There is an option to “flex up and down” on specific benefits, for example buy or sell annual leave, Private Medical Benefit, Dental and Travel Insurance.

You will also have access to ‘Perks at Work’, a discount store to purchase gift cards at reduced rates and get discounts on holidays, restaurants, activities, groceries and more.

DXC Recruitment Team will be engaging with all candidate applications on behalf of Velonetic. DXC will be managing the recruitment throughout the onboarding process.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. jobs.description:
About the team

At Zillow, we believe home should be more than just a dream. The Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Product team delivers a home financing journey that gives consumers more confidence, transparency, and ease than they can find anywhere else. We partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Research, and Operations to bring holistic experience innovation to market. This team is building an AI-native operating model for service delivery — agentic systems that reason about the next best action, and durable workflow infrastructure that carries those decisions out reliably.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. AI agents reason over each customer's situation, adapt that process to the specific opportunity in front of them, and determine the next work that should happen: the action, the outcome it is meant to create, the quality bar it must meet, and the skills required to execute it. You will own that loop across engagement and loan production. You design the AI harness (context, tools, memory, orchestration, escalation, guardrails) that determines what those agents reason over and what work they produce. You own the eval infrastructure that scores those decisions against the process you defined, learns from operator feedback, and uses experiments to decide what to keep, change, or retire.

You Will Get To

  • Define and lead a multi-year product vision for Directed Workflows as an AI-first service system spanning engagement and loan production

  • Define, with Sales and Business Operations, the sales and service process this system encodes: customer jobs, value at each stage, and how that experience earns attention and advocacy

  • Design the AI harness that turns that process into AI agent behavior: context engineering, tool design, memory, orchestration, and guardrails, including where a model should reason, where deterministic systems should execute, and what requires a person. The work the agent produces names the action, intended outcome, quality bar, and skills required to execute

  • Own the eval infrastructure you build or integrate: score AI agent output against the intended process, learn from operator feedback in production, and run experiments that show whether the directed work moved the outcome

  • Sequence from high-leverage pilots to platform: prove outcomes in focused increments, retire or redesign what does not move the metrics, then expand successful patterns across the financing journey

  • Influence across Zillow so the customer experience, the real estate agent experience, and the home finance operator experience operate as one coordinated service, and represent that strategy with senior leaders including risks and trade-offs

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex systems spanning multiple teams and customer or operator journeys

  • Demonstrated experience shipping agentic or decisioning products as a closed loop: designing the AI harness and the eval infrastructure that proved and improved outcomes

  • Experience shaping sales or service strategy with business leaders, tying process design to customer jobs, value delivery, and growth

  • Strong analytical ability using data, experimentation, and model/product evaluation to improve conversion, quality, or operator productivity

  • Track record of influencing senior Engineering, AI, Operations, and business stakeholders around strategy, trade-offs, and execution

  • Or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Nice to have: mortgage or lending experience; familiarity with workflow platforms, operator surfaces, or capacity-aware routing

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  • Own transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, and contemporaneous documentation for cross-border services, software and intellectual property arrangements, and intercompany funding
  • Manage indirect tax compliance and strategy for Neo4j's software subscriptions, cloud offerings, professional services, marketplace transactions, and channel sales, including nexus analyses, registrations, exemption documentation, and product taxability
  • Evaluate the tax implications of new products and commercial models, international expansion, legal entity changes, acquisitions, and post-acquisition integration
  • Monitor international tax developments relevant to Neo4j, including OECD Pillar Two requirements as applicable, digital services taxes, withholding and permanent establishment exposure, and evolving SaaS taxability rules
  • Build scalable, audit-ready tax processes, documentation, and internal controls, and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reduce reliance on manual processes

  • Oversee tax attributes and incentives, including R&D tax credits and net operating losses, and coordinate ownership-change analyses under Section 382 with external advisors

Treasury

  • Own global cash management, including daily cash visibility and cash concentration across legal entities, bank accounts, and currencies
  • Manage banking relationships and the bank account lifecycle, including account openings and closures, signatories, administrative access, and appropriate segregation of duties
  • Administer Neo4j's debt facilities, including covenant monitoring, interest and fee calculations, lender reporting, and coordination of required deliverables with Accounting, FP&A, and Legal
  • Manage foreign exchange exposures and recommend practical risk-mitigation or hedging strategies appropriate for Neo4j's international revenue, operating costs, and intercompany balances
  • Oversee the investment of excess cash in accordance with company policy, balancing preservation of capital, liquidity, counterparty risk, and yield
  • Structure and administer intercompany funding, loans, settlements, and repatriation in partnership with Tax, Accounting, and Legal
  • Own treasury policies and controls, including dual approvals, payment and wire controls, bank portal access reviews, fraud prevention, and support for acquisition integration and financing activities

Cross-Functional

  • Drive systems and process improvements across NetSuite, tax applications, and banking platforms, and prepare concise reporting for finance leadership as needed

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with indirect tax issues affecting enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, professional services, cloud marketplace transactions, and cross-border digital services

  • CPA or advanced degree in taxation preferred; CTP or relevant treasury experience is a plus
  • Experience working across multiple international legal entities within a global, high-growth software company; acquisition integration experience is a plus
  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a lean team, moving fluidly between strategy, technical analysis, process design, and hands-on execution
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience with NetSuite, tax compliance and provision tools, and global banking platforms is preferred
  • Excellent communication and project-management skills, with the ability to translate complex tax and treasury matters for finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable, well-controlled processes and maintain audit-ready documentation in a rapidly evolving environment

jobs.title: 2014 Senior Embedded Software Engineer - Test OS
jobs.excerpt: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (SP1 - RVT): ¿Qué es?
jobs.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer (SP1 - RVT):

¿Qué es?

Es un profesional especializado en el desarrollo, integración y adaptación de sistemas operativos embebidos (como Embedded Linux o RTOS) para ECUs (Unidades de Control Electrónico), con enfoque en la replicación y optimización de un Test OS en plataformas automotrices.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.

Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.

Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.

Automatiza pruebas (SIL, HIL y a nivel vehicular) para validar el comportamiento de las ECUs y los componentes conectados.

Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.

¿Por qué es crucial?

Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).

Requirements

Habilidades:

Lenguajes: C (avanzado +5 años), C++ (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), Python (intermedio 2-5 años), Bash (intermedio 2-5 años).

Sistemas operativos embebidos: Embedded Linux (avanzado +5 años), RTOS (avanzado +5 años).

Protocolos de comunicación: CAN, CAN FD, UDS (avanzado +5 años), DoIP, Automotive Ethernet (intermedio 2-5 años).

Herramientas: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape (avanzado +5 años), GDB, JTAG (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).

Pruebas automatizadas: GoogleTest, pytest (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), SIL, HIL (avanzado +5 años).

CI/CD y control de versiones: Git (avanzado +5 años), Jenkins, GitLab CI (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).

Firmware para ECUs: Integración, flasheo, diagnósticos (DIDs, DTCs) (avanzado +5 años).

Estándares: ASPICE, MISRA C (avanzado +5 años).

Visa (Obligatorio) - Viajaran a USA por el equipo de cliente

Actividades del puesto:

Análisis y adaptación del Test OS:

Analizar la arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue del Test OS implementado en vehículos Gen2.

Portar el Test OS a las ECUs Gen1 de RVT, asegurando compatibilidad con el hardware existente.

Desarrollo de software embebido:

Desarrollar capas de abstracción de plataforma para facilitar la comunicación, control y monitoreo de las ECUs.

Implementar módulos de software para integración de diagnósticos, flasheo de firmware y adquisición de datos.

Integración de funcionalidades clave:

Integrar diagnósticos de ECU (DIDs, DTCs) usando protocolos como UDS y DoIP.

Implementar rutinas de flasheo de firmware para actualizaciones seguras en las ECUs.

Configurar sistemas de logging y monitoreo de salud para registrar y analizar datos en tiempo real.

Automatización de pruebas:

Diseñar y desarrollar pruebas SIL (Software-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en entornos simulados.

Crear pruebas HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en conjunto con hardware real.

Implementar pruebas a nivel vehicular para validar el comportamiento del sistema en condiciones reales.

Depuración y resolución de problemas:

Depurar problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) en las ECUs.

Colaborar con equipos de ECU, eléctrica, sistemas, validación y hardware para identificar y resolver brechas de plataforma.

Colaboración y documentación:

Trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios para asegurar la integración y validación del Test OS en Gen1.

Documentar procesos, cambios y resultados de las pruebas y adaptaciones realizadas.

Cumplimiento de estándares:

Asegurar que el desarrollo del software cumpla con estándares como ASPICE y MISRA C.

Validar que las soluciones implementadas cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y calidad del cliente.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

jobs.excerpt: Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well.
jobs.description:
Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

About The Role

Facet is seeking an experienced Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to step into a high-touch, member-facing role as a Senior Tax Associate. If you love the strategic advisory side of public accounting or private wealth management—but dread tax season, compliance filings, and timesheets—this is the ideal next step in your career.

In this consultative position, you will be on the frontline, leading weekly virtual tax strategy sessions directly with Facet members. You will translate complex tax laws into actionable, high-impact strategies without ever filing a tax return. Partnering closely with our CFP® Lead Planners, you will apply Facet’s modern tax planning framework to empower members to make confident, tax-optimized life decisions.

Key Highlights:

  • No Tax Return Preparation or Compliance: 100% focused on forward-looking planning, education, and member advisory.
  • Direct Member Impact: High-cadence consultation environment leading 10–15 video strategy sessions per week.
  • Modern Wealth Management: Operate as the subject matter expert within a modern, tech-enabled RIA structure.
  • Balanced Work Load: NO BUSY SEASON!

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Direct Member Consultations: Lead 10–15 virtual strategy sessions per week, delivering tailored tax advice, answering complex real-time questions, and guiding members through high-stakes financial decisions.
  • Continuous Member Engagement: Serve as the primary tax sounding board for members by delivering clear, plain-English answers to day-to-day inbound questions via our secure messaging platform (covering withholdings, life events, IRS notices, and tax projections).
  • Proactive Tax Plan Diagnostic: Review member tax returns (Form 1040s and schedules) to diagnose multi-year optimization opportunities, including Roth conversions, equity vesting events, real estate transactions, and executive compensation.
  • Custom Modeling & Scenario Analysis: Build, model, and present customized tax strategies using modern planning tools—focusing on bracket management, withholding adjustments, and estimated tax schedules.
  • Technical Research & Analysis: Perform deep-dive research into complex federal and multi-state tax scenarios to architect compliant, creative strategies across diverse household profiles.
  • Planner Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our Lead Planners and Director of Specialized Advice to integrate tax optimization seamlessly into overall holistic financial plans.

Commonly Advised Strategies & Domains

  • Roth Conversion & Income Optimization: Evaluating income streams for multi-year Roth conversion strategies while managing downstream impacts on IRMAA brackets, ACA subsidies, and Social Security taxation.
  • Real Estate & Rental Assets: Advising on cost recovery, depreciation, Passive Activity Loss (PAL) rules, short-term rental strategies, and Section 1031 exchanges.
  • Charitable Giving Strategies: Structuring high-impact options, including Donor-Advised Funds (DAFs), Qualified Charitable Distributions (QCDs), and appreciated stock gifting.
  • Small Business & Entity Structuring: Advising business owners on entity selection (Sole Prop, S-Corp, LLC), Section 199A QBI optimization, pass-through taxation, and exit planning.
  • Equity Compensation: Navigating tax impacts of ISOs, NSOs, RSUs, and ESPPs, including Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) strategies and liquidity event planning.

Requirements

  • Active Credential:Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license required.
  • Relevant Experience: 5–7+ years of professional experience specializing in personal tax planning, private client tax advisory, high-net-worth tax consulting, or wealth management.
  • Member-Facing Excellence: Demonstrated history of managing a regular client meeting cadence (e.g., 10–15 client consultations weekly) with exceptional empathy, active listening, and strong presentation skills over video.
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Expert ability to analyze Form 1040s and supporting schedules rapidly to spot tax inefficiencies, missed opportunities, and exposure risks.
  • Deep Technical Knowledge: Strong expertise in individual federal and state tax codes, pass-through entities, retirement distribution strategies, and executive compensation planning.
  • Fiduciary Ethos: Uncompromising integrity and a dedication to delivering objective, member-first advice.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation or active pursuit of the credential.
    • Prior experience delivering advisory services within a fee-only RIA, multi-family office, or wealth management firm alongside CFP® professionals.
    • High proficiency with modern tax modeling tools (Holistiplan, BNA, Corvee) and CRM/digital workflow tools.

Benefits

  • $110,000 – $150,000 base salary: Determined by experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Equity (ISO): It is important to us that all employees are shareholders in our mission.
  • Flexible PTO
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, short/long-term disability (paid by Facet), life insurance, and paid parental leave.
  • Certification and wellness reimbursement programs
  • Work from anywhere in the US

*Facet was ranked #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY in April 2025 who partnered with Statista to rank the top 500 RIAs. Recommendations were collected via an independent survey among over 30,000 individuals. Self-recommendations were prohibited, and no compensation was provided for the ranking. Facet has been Accredited with the Better Business Bureau® since June 2025, and as of February 2026 holds an A+ BBB Rating. This Accreditation does not imply BBB approval or endorsement. Plant-A Insights Group and Newsweek partnered to identify America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. This analysis was performed with data as of September 2024 and reviewed over 15,000 financial advisories registered with the SEC. These rankings prepared by Plant-A reflect editorial content and no compensation was provided by Facet in connection with America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. As of February 25, 2026; Facet has a 4.8 star rating with TrustPilot.com. TrustPilot uses a formula for calculation that considers three factors: time span, frequency, and Bayesian average. After the calculation, a TrustScore is then visualized into a star rating from 1 to 5 stars, including half stars. Facet’s star rating is calculated from reviews from January of 2022 to present day. Daily star rating may fluctuate. Companies on Trustpilot aren't allowed to offer incentives or pay to hide reviews and Facet has not made any payments in offer or receipt of any reviews.

jobs.title: Mobile Application Business Analyst (Employed or freelance)
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésVous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux. Dans le cadre de la refonte complète d’une application mobile, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins métier en éléments fonctionnels clairs, cohérents et exploitables par les équipes UX/UI et de développement.

Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de définition fonctionnelle jusqu’à la préparation du développement, avec une attention particulière portée à la cohérence entre parcours utilisateurs, écrans, backlog et critères d’acceptation.

Description de mission

Le rôle consiste à faire le lien entre :

  • les besoins métier,
  • l’expérience utilisateur (UX),
  • les équipes design,
  • les équipes de développement,
  • l’architecture,
  • la QA et la gestion de projet.

Vous êtes garant de la structuration des parcours utilisateurs, de la transformation des besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et de la traçabilité entre les différentes étapes de conception et de delivery.

Responsabilités principales

1. Analyse métier et cadrage fonctionnel

  • Recueillir les besoins métier et utilisateurs.
  • Challenge les demandes afin d’en clarifier les objectifs réels.
  • Structurer les User Journeys et formaliser les parcours détaillés.
  • Identifier les pain points, les cas complexes et les dépendances.
  • Prioriser les besoins avec les parties prenantes du projet.

2. Structuration des parcours utilisateurs

  • Définir les parcours de bout en bout.
  • Décomposer chaque parcours en étapes détaillées.
  • Prendre en compte les variantes, exceptions, cas d’erreur, scénarios offline, dépendances temps réel et besoins d’accessibilité (PMR).
  • Garantir une couverture complète des scénarios critiques et des edge cases.

3. Transformation des besoins en éléments exploitables

Vous structurez et maintenez la traçabilité complète entre :

User Journey → Features → Screens → User Stories → Acceptance Criteria

  • Transformer les besoins métier en fonctionnalités détaillées.
  • Réaliser le screen mapping et contribuer au screen inventory.
  • Formaliser des wireflows fonctionnels clairs.
  • Veiller à l’exhaustivité des écrans et à la cohérence des comportements attendus.

4. Préparation du travail UX/UI

  • Préparer les éléments nécessaires au travail des designers.
  • Définir le maillage des écrans et les comportements fonctionnels.
  • Documenter les différents états : loading, error, empty, offline et edge cases.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les UX/UI Designers pour assurer la cohérence des parcours.

5. Gestion et structuration du backlog

  • Rédiger les Epics et les User Stories.
  • Définir des Acceptance Criteria précis et exploitables.
  • Structurer les dépendances et préparer les refinements.
  • Maintenir un backlog complexe clair, priorisé et actionnable dans un cadre Agile / Scrum.

6. Coordination avec les équipes de delivery

  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques afin de clarifier les comportements attendus.
  • Participer aux ateliers UX/UI et aux refinements Agile.
  • Apporter un support aux équipes QA/UAT.
  • Faciliter l’alignement entre les besoins métier, la conception et l’implémentation.

7. Documentation et gouvernance fonctionnelle

  • Maintenir la documentation fonctionnelle dans Confluence.
  • Utiliser des outils de modélisation tels que Draw.io lorsque pertinent.
  • Structurer les référentiels fonctionnels avec rigueur.
  • Garantir la cohérence documentaire et la traçabilité entre besoins, parcours, écrans, stories et tests.
  • Assurer une rédaction fonctionnelle de haut niveau, adaptée à des projets mobiles complexes.

Livrables attendus

  • User Journeys détaillés
  • Mapping fonctionnel
  • Screen Inventory
  • Wireflows fonctionnels
  • Epics
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Documentation Confluence
  • Support aux scénarios UAT
  • Matrices de traçabilité

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Senior Business Analyst, idéalement dans des environnements digitaux et sur des projets mobiles complexes.

Compétences essentielles :

  • Business Analysis digitale
  • Structuration de backlogs complexes
  • Rédaction fonctionnelle
  • User Journeys
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Screen Mapping
  • Wireflows
  • Gestion des edge cases et des scénarios critiques
  • Méthodologies Agile / Scrum
  • Confluence
  • Draw.io

Soft skills recherchés :

  • Excellente capacité de structuration et grande rigueur documentaire
  • Très bonne communication avec des interlocuteurs variés
  • Esprit analytique et vision systémique
  • Capacité à travailler dans des environnements transverses et à faciliter des ateliers
  • Approche pragmatique, orientée solution, utilisateur et delivery

Langues :

  • Néerlandais ou français
  • Anglais

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.description:
About AppFollow

    AppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers. Support teams use it to handle reviews at scale, product teams turn user feedback into insights, and marketing and ASO teams grow app store visibility. We're a B2B SaaS company serving SMB, mid-market and enterprise clients, with a remote team based mostly in Europe.

Role overview

    We're hiring our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager. You'll own how AppFollow's products are positioned, launched and explained, both to the market and inside the company.

    You report to the CEO and work with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success teams, each needing something different from you. Product needs you to understand new features early, turn them into a clear market story and bring back what customers say about them. Marketing needs one person who knows the product inside out and produces the source of truth for campaigns, webinars and landing pages. Sales and Customer Success need positioning against competitors, a current deck and proof they can use in a demo.

    This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. There's nobody to delegate to, and most of the workflows described below don't exist yet. You'll build them.

Key responsibilities

    Positioning and messaging. Own who we're for, what we do better than competitors, and how that shows up in our messaging. You run this work with the leadership team and carry the result onto the website's product pages and everywhere else the product is described.

    Product launches. Lead every feature launch from the marketing side, from the start of development rather than the week before release. Understand the use cases with the product manager, define the message, build the launch plan and run the campaign to prospects and existing accounts together with Sales. Then measure it: opportunities created, accounts activated.

    Product feedback loop. Join sales and CS calls during betas and launches. Aggregate what prospects and customers say about a new feature (Fathom, AI tooling, your own system), define the questions the sales team should be asking, and feed the findings back to Product and Marketing: what's not landing, what needs to change in messaging or on landing pages, which use cases we're missing.

    Case studies and proof. Own the customer story pipeline: first use cases after each launch, case studies, testimonials. If a key use case has no proof yet, go get it.

    Internal source of truth. For every product and feature, keep a current, plain-language description of what it does, who it's for, why it beats the alternatives, proof points and customer quotes (we use Guru). Marketing, Sales, CS and Growth all work from it. This is not technical documentation.

    Sales and CS materials. Own the master sales deck as a modular set of approved slides and review it with the Head of Sales roughly every quarter. Help Sales find the "wow moment" for demos of new features. Translate features into business outcomes. Sales training and one-off pitch preparation stay with the Head of Sales.

    Cross-sell and upsell. Run announcement campaigns to existing and free accounts around new features and products, and coordinate with Growth on in-product channels.

How we measure success

  • Feature adoption after launch (accounts using a new feature or add-on)

  • Case studies published and launch materials ready on launch day (source of truth, deck, landing page copy)

  • Qualified pipeline (MQLs/SQLs) from product launches and launch campaigns

  • Cross-sell and upsell opportunities from campaigns to the existing base

Who we're looking for

    Experience. 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, most of it in startups where you did the work yourself. You've launched products, owned positioning and worked side by side with sales. Experience in mobile apps, ASO or gaming is a strong plus, as is knowing how both product-led and sales-led motions work.

    Way of working. Proactive. You pick up what's broken without waiting for a launch date or a request from Sales, and you're comfortable saying "this is what we're not doing."

    AI-native. You use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools daily and build your own workflows on top of them: aggregating call feedback, maintaining product knowledge, drafting content. We expect you to plug into our internal integrations (Fathom, HubSpot, Guru, Salesforce, Amplitude, Canny) and keep the product knowledge base the most current thing in the company.

    Data. Comfortable reading funnel and campaign data, building a spreadsheet and defending a conclusion.

    Communication. Fluent English, strong writing. Another language (Spanish, Portuguese, Russian) is a plus. Comfortable presenting at webinars and events as a public face for the product.

    Video production skills (Screen Studio, CapCut) are a plus, not a requirement.

What we offer

  • Remote role anywhere in Europe; hubs in Spain, Portugal, Serbia and Finland

  • Colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil

  • Conference participation in app, gaming and product marketing events

  • Equity options after probation, quarterly performance bonuses

  • Annual offline team meetup and company all-hands

  • Monthly coworking budget, laptop and home office equipment

  • Internal hackathons 2–3 times a year

  • Direct work with the CEO and leadership team; you build a function from zero

Hiring process

  • Applications open: mid-Sept

  • Screening call (30 min): second half of Sept

  • Take-home assignment and panel interview with Sales, Marketing and Product (60 min): early Oct

  • Offer: by 15 Oct

    • Dates are our target and may shift. We move fast and interview as applications come in, so early applicants hear back sooner.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser

  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

The Technical Project Manager will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technical initiatives supporting the GrantSolutions contract. Efforts may include application and platform modernization, system enhancements, new capabilities, integrations, cloud adoption, cybersecurity initiatives, and operational improvements. The role requires strong project leadership and sufficient familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications to engage technical teams, understand delivery dependencies and risks, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The Technical Project Manager will coordinate cross-functional and multi-vendor teams; manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and change; and partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, engineering and operations leads, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

What You Will Do:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of technical efforts, including modernization initiatives, system and application enhancements, new capability delivery, platform improvements, integrations, and technology upgrades. This role will manage delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, coordinating work across multiple workstreams, vendors, and agile teams while maintaining service continuity and alignment with business priorities.

The Technical Project Manager will establish delivery baselines and governance, manage requirements and change, track performance and financials, facilitate technical and business decisions, and coordinate quality, security, release, operational readiness, and stakeholder adoption. This individual will support initiatives involving cloud-hosted applications, integrations, shared services, data exchanges, infrastructure, and emerging capabilities. Success requires sound judgment, technical curiosity, concise executive communication, and the ability to create accountability without displacing the responsibilities of Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, or Technical Leads.

  • Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition to operations, and closeout, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

  • Define and maintain project charters, scope, objectives, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps, and governance cadence.

  • Manage day-to-day execution across multiple agile teams, technical workstreams, vendors, and shared services; clarify roles, commitments, interfaces, and decision rights.

  • Partner with Product Owners and technical leads to translate business and technical requirements into prioritized, achievable release plans while maintaining traceability from objectives through delivered capabilities.

  • Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, procurement and vendor commitments, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions using appropriate controls.

  • Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, and timely escalation of financial risks.

  • Establish and administer integrated change control, assessing proposed changes for business value and impacts to architecture, scope, cost, schedule, security, operations, and contractual commitments.

  • Coordinate architecture, application development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, data, testing, configuration management, and operations stakeholders to meet delivery and governance requirements.

  • Drive release and operational readiness, including environment and integration dependencies, test completion, defect disposition, data migration, deployment planning, rollback and contingency planning, training, communications, support readiness, and production handoff.

  • Track technical dependencies across applications, cloud services, APIs, data exchanges, security components, environments, and shared platform capabilities.

  • Coordinate delivery planning for AWS-hosted environments and Java-based applications, working with technical leads to understand architecture, security, integration, deployment, and operational considerations.

  • Proactively manage implementation and transition risks, including workflow continuity, system-of-record decisions, overlapping capabilities, data synchronization, technical debt, testing scope, deployment sequencing, and operational impacts.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics and key performance indicators, such as milestone performance, forecast accuracy, throughput, cycle time, quality trends, defect leakage, dependency aging, and risk exposure; use data to drive recovery plans and continuous improvement.

  • Prepare concise executive dashboards, weekly and monthly status reports, decision briefs, and forecasts that clearly communicate progress, financial status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

  • Facilitate planning sessions, technical reviews, risk reviews, stakeholder forums, retrospectives, and decision meetings; document actions, owners, due dates, and outcomes.

  • Manage vendor performance against plans, deliverables, service expectations, quality criteria, and contractual obligations, escalating gaps and coordinating remediation.

  • Maintain complete, audit-ready project records, including baselines, plans, RAID logs, decisions, approvals, change records, status reports, meeting outcomes, and lessons learned.

  • Build trusted relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, architects, delivery teams, and operations partners while promoting accountability, constructive conflict resolution, team empowerment, and a culture of continuous improvement.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD Public Trust; approved adjudication is required before onboarding. An active Public Trust or suitability determination is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, project management, or a related field.

  • Minimum of Twelve (12) years of prior relevant experience

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience managing complex software development, cloud, systems integration, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology initiatives.

The Clinical Consultant provides clinical and application support for both customers and internal sales force related to the Baxter vital sign and cardiology product line delivered in a hospital or clinic setting.   • Excellent oral, written, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

jobs.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less.
jobs.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. As far as we know, we are the only true scaling research advisory firm in the world. Not “growth,” but scale.

We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue (With many of our clients between $100M and $1B+) who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales.

Our creative library includes multiple NYT best-selling books, large podcast appearances, keynotes, live events, client/member interviews, case studies, client/member training material, webinars, founder content, and hundreds of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of hooks each week. When the market tells us a hook is working, this role turns that signal into a larger family of direct-response video ads. We are looking for someone who has already written high-performing video creative and scripts at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will not begin with a blank page. You will receive a winning hook, a proven video ad, or a clear performance signal. Your job is to understand why it worked, find the strongest evidence and source material connected to it in our media library, develop the angle, write new versions, and hand the production team a clear creative direction that can become a finished ad.

This is primarily a video-ad strategy and scriptwriting role. It combines direct-response strategy, AI-assisted research, source mining, writing, creative iteration, and performance learning. You should also be capable of handling other direct-response copywriting needs when required, but video scripts are the center of the job.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

  • Receive winning hooks, proven video ads, winners and losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests from our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Diagnose why it worked: the audience, pain, belief, promise, proof, curiosity, identity, or objection it activated. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Use AI to search our content database for supporting material across testimonials, founder podcasts, books, posts, keynotes, trainings, member stories, and excerpts from our twice-yearly live events. Stay deeply current by regularly consuming our books, every founder podcast appearance and keynote, live-event content, trainings, and the weekly case-study podcast produced for our members.
  • Build an evidence bank around the angle. This may include dozens of testimonials, short proof points, founder clips, book lines, customer language, objections, and supporting stories.
  • Write three or four new hook options, develop the body, choose the proof sequence, and create a clear flow for the video ad.
  • Package the developed angle for a Creative Producer and Editor. Give them the message, key lines, source material, intended flow, and what the ad must accomplish without prescribing every visual decision.
  • Review the finished ad to protect the strategy and clarify anything that was lost in execution.
  • When an ad wins, create new variations by changing the hook, body, proof, order, framing, or CTA, and by recombining elements from multiple winners.
  • When the paid-media team flags a winning ad for refresh, identify what should be preserved and what should change so the next version can beat it.
  • Repeat the cycle quickly. Some ads may only perform for a few weeks because we intend to scale spend aggressively.

What You Own

  • Winning-hook expansion
  • Angle development
  • AI-assisted source research
  • Testimonial and proof mining
  • Video ad scripts and copy
  • Hook and body variations
  • Creative briefs and source packages
  • Winner iteration
  • Winner refreshes
  • Performance learning
  • Claim and source accuracy

What Success Looks Like

  • A dependable flow of strong, evidence-backed angles keeps the production team moving.
  • New video ads come from proven market signals without becoming minor copies of the original.
  • Winning video ads produce useful creative families as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Research is fast, deep, traceable, and materially improves the writing.
  • Editors and designers receive enough direction to protect the message while still owning the execution.
  • The work produces qualified demand, not merely clicks or internal enthusiasm.

What We Need to See

  • Direct-response video-ad work with clear personal ownership and measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, booked calls, conversion, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.
  • The ability to explain why a hook or ad worked and how you turned that learning into the next test.
  • Experience selling a complex, intangible, high-consideration offer. Expert-led, education, or information businesses are strongly preferred.
  • Strong research judgment across transcripts, testimonials, long-form content, books, customer language, and performance data.
  • A real AI-enabled research and writing workflow that increased speed or creative range without producing generic work.
  • Fast, decisive collaboration with producers, editors, and designers.
  • Excellent judgment around claims, testimonials, attribution, and source accuracy.

This Role Is Not

  • Brand copy without a measurable action
  • Generic content strategy
  • Starting every assignment from a blank page
  • Prompt output passed off as thinking
  • A writer who disappears after handoff
  • A project-management layer between strategy and production

How to Apply

Send one direct-response video ad or campaign you personally shaped. Explain the original signal or insight, the audience, the hook, the angle, the proof, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and your exact ownership.

Then show us how you use AI to search, organize, and turn a large body of source material into a stronger ad. We want to see the workflow and the finished result, not a list of tools.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

Strategic Segment Manager — Petrochem, Mining & Metals (REMOTE TX)

US Remote - TX

The Company

PerkinElmer is a global analytical services and solutions provider with offerings including the leading OneSource Field and Laboratory services business that serve the biopharma, food, environmental, safety and applied end markets to accelerate scientific outcomes. Purpose

PerkinElmer is seeking a Strategic Segment Manager to own the full go-to-market strategy for Petrochemicals, Mining & Metals. This is a market-facing, intelligence-led role that sits at the intersection of product strategy and commercial execution.

The Strategic Segment Manager is the organisation's foremost expert on their assigned market: the customer workflows, competitive dynamics, regulatory environment, and purchasing patterns that determine how PerkinElmer wins or loses in that segment. They translate this expertise into Market Requirements Documents that shape product roadmaps, go-to-market playbooks that guide commercial execution, and value propositions that give the sales organization a compelling story to tell.

This is a cross-product-line role. The Strategic Segment Manager sees the segment horizontally — understanding how customers in their market use the full range of PerkinElmer's analytical capabilities, and identifying where the portfolio wins, where it loses, and where it needs to evolve.

Responsibilities:

Market Intelligence & VOC

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the assigned segment: customer workflows, buying behaviour, regulatory and compliance requirements, competitive landscape, and technology adoption trends

  • Execute a structured VOC program, covering current users, competitive users, and prospective customers across the segment's key geographies and sub-verticals

  • Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, industry associations, regulatory bodies, and academic partners in the segment — establishing PerkinElmer as a credible, trusted partner in the relevant scientific community

  • Conduct systematic competitive intelligence: tracking competitor product launches, pricing, application claims, and go-to-market moves — translating intelligence into actionable competitive response recommendations

Market Requirements Documents (MRDs)

  • Own the segment's Market Requirements Document — the structured, evidence-based articulation of customer needs, competitive gaps, and product investment priorities for the assigned segment across all relevant PerkinElmer product lines

  • Update and maintain the MRD on a structured annual cadence, with interim updates when significant market events (competitive launches, regulatory changes, customer feedback patterns) require immediate revision

  • Present MRD findings and recommendations to the VP Product Line teams, VP Marketing, and Sr. Director — defending investment priorities with customer evidence and commercial data, not assumption

  • Ensure MRD inputs are formally adopted into at least one VP Product Line roadmap planning cycle per year, tracking implementation of MRD-driven product decisions

Go-to-Market Strategy & Commercial Enablement

  • Develop the segment go-to-market strategy: target customer profiles, channel priorities, campaign themes, value proposition hierarchy, and commercial messaging that positions PerkinElmer's portfolio competitively in the assigned segment

  • Produce commercially actionable segment enablement tools: competitive battlecards, segment application guides, customer workflow maps, and sales playbooks that Regional Marketing Managers and the field sales organisation can deploy immediately

  • Partner with the Portfolio marketing team to brief and review segment-specific campaign content — ensuring technical accuracy, commercial relevance, and strategic alignment with the segment's priority themes

  • Drive annual growth planning for the assigned segment — identifying the highest-priority growth initiatives, the product line actions required to capture them, and the commercial resources needed to win

Thought Leadership & External Presence

  • Develop segment-specific thought leadership content: white papers, application note series themes, scientific conference presentations, and regulatory commentary that establishes PerkinElmer as a knowledgeable, credible voice in the segment

  • Represent PerkinElmer at segment-specific conferences, trade shows, and customer advisory events — speaking, networking, and gathering market intelligence

  • Contribute to PerkinElmer's customer advisory board programming for the segment — designing agendas, facilitating discussions, and translating advisory input into commercial and product management action

Success Metrics

  • MRD completion and adoption — annual MRD delivered on schedule and formally adopted in at least one VP Product Line roadmap planning cycle

  • VOC coverage — minimum 25 documented in-depth customer conversations per year

  • Segment growth contribution — revenue growth in the assigned segment vs. prior year and vs. market growth rate

  • Enablement asset quality and utilization — Portfolio marketing content briefed, commercial tools produced, and field adoption rate of segment playbooks and battlecards

  • Competitive win rate in the segment — tracked through win/loss analysis

Qualifications & Experience:

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, segment marketing, market intelligence, or applications science within analytical instrumentation, life sciences tools, or a closely adjacent scientific or industrial technology business

  • Deep domain expertise in the assigned segment — sufficient to engage credibly with customer scientists, interpret regulatory requirements, and identify commercially significant technical developments without specialist support

  • Demonstrated experience conducting structured VOC programmes and translating customer insight into rigorous, commercially actionable product strategy inputs

  • Experience producing strategic documents — Market Requirements Documents, market assessments, or competitive analyses — used to drive product investment decisions

  • Strong communication skills: able to write and present at a high standard for both technical and commercial audiences

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) providing peer-level scientific credibility with customers and with the product line PM teams the Segment Manager must influence

At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. As a Customer Success Engineer at Algolia, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers adopt, implement, and scale our agentic, generative, search & discovery platform successfully. You’ll partner closely with customers to deliver high-quality technical onboarding, solution design, best-practice guidance, and hands-on implementation support.

This role is ideal for someone who is deeply curious, loves solving complex technical problems, and is energized by learning and applying new technologies including modern development patterns, cloud infrastructure, and emerging AI capabilities. You’ll work across a variety of customer architectures and use cases, helping teams design performant, scalable solutions while championing technical excellence.

You will also support our Professional and Expert Foundation offerings, acting as a Technical Owner for assigned accounts and ensuring smooth delivery through clear communication, rigorous documentation, and thoughtful stakeholder alignment.

Success in this role means being proactive, reliable, and collaborative, balancing customer-facing delivery with internal best practices such as strong documentation habits and ongoing knowledge sharing.

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping customer outcomes, diving into new tools and technologies, and working in a team that values craftsmanship, curiosity, and continuous learning, we’d love to meet you.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE

  • Excellence in time management, task prioritization, and evaluation of situational urgency
